dbce7bcb.title: Service Delivery Manager
dbce7bcb.description:
**Hello,**
**FCM part of FCTG**
is one of the world’s largest travel management companies and a trusted partner for nationals and multinational companies. With a 24/7 reach in 97 countries, FCM’s flexible technology anticipates and solves client needs, supported by experts who provide in-depth local knowledge and duty of care as part of the ultimate personalised business travel experience.
  
  
As part of the ASX-listed Flight Centre Travel Group, FCM delivers the best market-wide rates, unique added-value benefits, and exclusive solutions.
  
  
**Winner of the World's Leading Travel Management Company Award at the WTM for nine consecutive years (2019-2011),**
FCM is constantly transforming the business of travel through its empowered and accountable people who deliver 24/7 service and are available online and offline. FCM has won the coveted
**Great Place to Work certification for the fifth time**
! FCM Travel India is one of India’s Top 100 Great Mid-size Workplaces 2024 and the Best in Professional Services.
  
  
A leader in the travel tech space, FCM has proprietary client solutions. FCM provides specialist services via FCM Consulting and FCM Meetings & Events.
  
  
**Summary**
The Service Delivery Manager is the local manager for Techlab team members and is responsible for service delivery governance across assigned technology business units, local people processes, recruitment, and the transition of services or modules to the local team. Global stakeholders (Product Managers, Product Owners, Technical Leads and Engineering Managers) own delivery priorities, work assignment and day-to-day direction, and treat global and local members as one team. The role ensures services are delivered with high quality, strong stakeholder engagement, effective resource utilisation and consistent operational governance, risks and issues are proactively managed, team members are well supported, and agreed service and delivery outcomes are achieved.
  
  
**Day In The Life**
**Service Delivery Leadership**

* Own service delivery governance across assigned business units, ensuring delivery commitments, priorities and outcomes are clearly understood and achieved. Priorities and work assignment for work directed by global stakeholders remain with those stakeholders; the SDM is accountable for operational delivery of services fully transitioned to the local team.
* Establish effective delivery governance, operating rhythms and performance reporting across multiple teams and workstreams.
* Ensure delivery is aligned with business objectives, customer expectations and agreed service commitments.
* Support accountability across delivery teams by proactively raising blockers, dependencies, risks and issues with the responsible stakeholders and escalating where needed.

**Stakeholder Management**

* Build strong, trusted relationships with business stakeholders, technology leaders, product owners, project managers and delivery teams.
* Act as a key point of contact for service and delivery-related matters, providing clear and transparent communication on progress, capacity, risks and priorities.
* Facilitate regular stakeholder reviews, QBRs and delivery forums, ensuring actions and decisions are documented and followed through.
* Understand stakeholder needs and translate them into clear local actions, resourcing requirements and actionable outcomes, without altering task priorities set by global stakeholders.
* Run a fortnightly or monthly cadence with global stakeholders (Product Managers, Product Owners, Technical Leads and Engineering Managers); collect, consolidate and track feedback on local team members.
* Attend sprint demos and reviews to understand what and how the team is delivering, so that feedback and coaching are well informed.
* Align with stakeholders on workforce and capacity risks (attrition, planned absences, hiring needs) and remain reliably available for cross-time-zone calls and escalations.
* Partner with vendors and outgoing teams during transitions, managing expectations on timelines, scope and handover quality.

**Project & Delivery Management**

* Support delivery of projects and initiatives across multiple technology teams through demos, reviews and Jira dashboards (read-only), ensuring scope, timelines, dependencies, risks and outcomes are visible and actively managed with the responsible stakeholders.
* Coordinate local capacity, availability and resourcing across multiple concurrent initiatives, working with global stakeholders who own prioritisation and work assignment.
* Apply Agile, Lean and appropriate project management practices to improve predictability, flow and delivery outcomes.
* Monitor delivery milestones, capacity and key performance indicators and drive corrective action through the responsible stakeholders where required.

**Resource & Capacity Management**

* Plan and optimise local team capacity, availability and rosters across competing priorities and workstreams, in partnership with global stakeholders who direct work allocation.
* Identify resource constraints, capability gaps and emerging capacity requirements and work with leadership to address them.
* Support workforce planning, recruitment requirements and effective utilisation of delivery resources.
* Work with team leaders and managers to ensure appropriate skills, coverage and succession plans are in place.

**Service Quality, Governance & Risk**

* Establish and maintain delivery governance, standards and controls to ensure consistent and high-quality outcomes.
* Track KPIs, service performance, delivery health, risks, issues and dependencies, providing timely escalation and resolution.
* Drive effective risk and issue management, ensuring mitigation and recovery plans are established for material delivery risks.
* Ensure appropriate documentation, SOPs, knowledge transfer and operational readiness are maintained.

**Continuous Improvement & Transformation**

* Drive continuous improvement initiatives that improve delivery efficiency, quality, customer experience and team effectiveness.
* Identify opportunities to simplify processes, improve automation, reduce operational friction and strengthen delivery maturity.
* Promote adoption of Agile, Lean, DevOps and other relevant delivery practices where appropriate.
* Use delivery data, stakeholder feedback and operational insights to identify and implement measurable improvements.
* Use Jira workflows and dashboards (as a read-only observer) to understand team flow, workload and delivery health.
* Model responsible use of AI tools and apply them to feedback summarisation, reporting, documentation and pipeline tracking.

**Team Leadership & Development**

* Lead, coach and mentor delivery professionals and team leaders, fostering a culture of collaboration, accountability and continuous learning.
* Develop high-performing teams through regular feedback, capability development and clear performance expectations.
* Create an environment that encourages ownership, innovation, knowledge sharing and customer-centric behaviour.
* Support effective change management and help teams adapt to evolving business and technology priorities.
* Coach team members on productivity and effectiveness, particularly when the need arises from stakeholder feedback, in partnership with the stakeholders concerned.

**Transition to Operations and Service / Module Transition**

* Ensure projects and technology initiatives have appropriate transition plans before moving into production or ongoing service operations.
* Coordinate with service operations and support teams to ensure effective handover, documentation, training and knowledge transfer.
* Ensure operational readiness, support ownership and post-implementation activities are clearly defined.

*Where a service or module moves from a vendor or global team to the local team for full ownership, the SDM owns the transition end to end.*

* Plan: Define scope with the outgoing party, build the transition plan (knowledge transfer, shadowing, reverse shadowing, handover) and align contractual aspects with vendor management, procurement and legal where relevant.
* Resourcing: Assess skills and capacity, identify owners, plan hiring ahead of need, arrange training, and manage key-person dependencies and workload impact on individuals.
* Governance: Run regular checkpoints, track milestones and risks, hold the outgoing party to its obligations, and ensure access, environments, tooling and compliance are in place.
* Readiness: Agree objective readiness criteria and sign-off gates, plan hypercare, and set up Jira workflows, queues and escalation paths for the service.
* Steady state: Remain accountable for SLA performance, incident trends, capacity and key-person risk; hold 30/60/90-day reviews and capture lessons learned. Daily work direction sits with a designated local service owner or tech lead.

**People Process Governance & Performance Support**
*Global stakeholders own the evaluation of work, performance judgements and day-to-day development conversations. The SDM drives the process, ensures it runs on time and with quality, and supports both sides.*

* Appraisals: Drive the calendar, briefings, templates and follow-up for goal setting, mid-year check-ins, stakeholder input, ratings and calibration; quality-check inputs for gaps, bias and missing evidence; facilitate delivery of final feedback.
* PIPs: Ensure stakeholder-defined expectations are specific, measurable and time-bound; set review cadence, track progress, keep records and coordinate outcomes with HR.
* Probation: Track timelines, trigger checkpoints, consolidate evidence-based assessments and coordinate confirmation or extension.
* 1:1s: Ensure stakeholders hold regular 1:1s. Hold local check-ins focused on wellbeing, workload, aspirations and concerns, not task direction.
* Growth: Run promotion and role-change processes; shape development plans and coordinate stretch opportunities with stakeholders.

**Recruitment & Talent Acquisition**
*Global stakeholders define requirements and decide technical and team fit. The SDM runs the end-to-end process and keeps everyone informed.*

* Intake: Initiate new and replacement requisitions; run calibration calls with stakeholders on scope, must-have skills, seniority, fit and working hours; convert them into a hiring brief.
* Sourcing and screening: Work with talent acquisition, screen profiles against calibrated requirements (including a first-level technical fit check), and share shortlists with a fit-and-gap summary.
* Interviews: Coordinate panels across time zones, brief interviewers, chase timely evidence-based feedback, and monitor pipeline health.
* Reporting and closure: Share regular progress updates (pipeline, time-to-hire, risks), facilitate the selection discussion, and coordinate offer, negotiation, notice-period tracking and joining.

**Local Operations & Onboarding**

* Manage WFH/WFO rosters and ensure availability during business hours and overlap windows with global teams.
* Approve and track leave in the local system, and communicate planned absences to stakeholders to avoid delivery impact.
* Own the pre-joining and first-30-days experience for new hires, and coordinate access, equipment, offboarding and vendor-related administration with HR, IT and admin.
* Ensure compliance with local policy and code of conduct.

**Wellbeing, Engagement & Conflict Resolution**

* Be the first point of contact for team members' concerns; monitor workload, morale and burnout risk and raise issues with stakeholders.
* Represent team aspirations (career, projects, learning) to global stakeholders.
* Mediate conflicts or misalignment between global stakeholders and local members, including cross-location cultural friction.

Escalate risks, attrition signals and systemic issues to senior leadership with recommendations
  
  
**You'll Be Perfect For The Role If You Have**

* Proven experience managing multiple concurrent initiatives and leading multi-disciplinary technology teams. Proven experience running appraisal cycles, PIPs, probation reviews and leave management; driving end-to-end recruitment or hiring coordination for technology roles; and leading a service, module or knowledge transition, including vendor or cross-team handovers.
* 15+ years of total professional experience, including 5+ years of delivery management and/or project management experience and 4+ years managing people in technology or engineering teams.
* Degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business, Engineering or a related field (or equivalent experience). Relevant certifications such as PMP, PRINCE2, Scrum/Agile, SAFe, ICAgile, ITIL, CIPD or equivalent are advantageous.
* Normal business hours, with flexibility required to support global stakeholders and delivery requirements, including cross-time-zone calls, overlap windows and escalations.

**Work Perks! - What’s in it for you:**
FCTG is renowned internationally for having amazing perks and an even better culture. We understand that our people are our most valuable asset. It is the passion and dedication of our teams that keep the company on top of the industry ladder. It’s also why we offer some great employee benefits and perks outside of the norm.
  
  
You will be rewarded with competitive market salary. You will also be equipped with relevant training courses and tools to set you up for success with endless career advancement and job opportunities all over the world.
  
  
**Market Aligned remuneration structure**
and a highly competitive salary
  
  
**Fun and Energetic culture**
: At the heart of everything we do at FCM is a desire to have fun and be yourself
  
  
**Work life Balance**
: We believe in “No Leave = No Life” So have your own travel adventures with paid annual leave
  
  
**Great place to work**
- Recognized as a top workplace for 5 consecutive years, which is a testimonial of our commitment towards our people
  
  
**Wellbeing Focus**
- We take care of our employee with comprehensive medical coverage, accidental insurance, and term insurance for the well being of our people.
  
  
**Paternity Leave:**
We ensure that you can spend quality time with your growing family
  
  
**Travel perks**
: You'll have access to plenty of industry discounts to ensure you continue to broaden your horizons
  
  
**A career, not a job**
: We believe in our people brightness of future. As a high growth company, you will have the opportunity to advance your career in any direction you choose whether that is locally or globally.
  
  
**Reward & Recognition**
: Celebrate the success of yourself and others at our regular Buzz Nights and at the annual Global Gathering - You'll have to experience it to believe it!
  
  
**Love for travel**
: We were founded by people who wanted to travel and want others to do the same. That passion is something you can’t miss in our people or service.
  
  
**We value you...**
Flight Centre Travel Group is committed to creating an inclusive and diverse workplace that supports your unique identity to create better, safer experiences for everyone. We encourage you to come as you are; to foster inclusivity and collaboration. We celebrate you.
  
  
**Who We Are...**
Since our beginning, our vision has always been to open up the world for those who want to see.
  
  
As a global travel retailer, our people come from all different backgrounds, and our connections spread to the far reaches of the globe - 20+ countries and counting! Together, we are a family (we call ourselves Flighties).
  
  
We offer genuine opportunities for people to grow and evolve. We embrace new experiences, we celebrate the wins, seize all opportunities, and empower all of our people to find their
**Brightness of Future.**
We encourage you to
**DREAM BIG**
through collaboration and innovation, and make sure you are supported to make incredible ideas a reality. Together, we deliver quality, innovative solutions that delight our customers and achieve our strategic priorities.
  
  
**Irreverence. Ownership. Egalitarianism**

3a4bcfab.description:
**Job Title: AI Program Manager - Collections – Implementation Team - BFSI Domain**

**Location:**
Bengaluru | Full-time | Work From Office

**Department:**
Implementation Team

**About Convin**

Convin is building AI that turns customer conversations into measurable business outcomes. Founded by IIT Delhi alumni, Convin develops proprietary AI products that help B2C businesses engage customers across phone calls, WhatsApp, SMS, and website voice widgets. Convin’s AI products understand customer intent and determine the right channel, timing, message, and next action for every interaction.

Convin helps businesses turn customer interest into qualified leads, booked appointments, renewals, and completed payments. Convin is building for two demanding B2C markets, India and the United States. In India, we serve leading EdTech, retail, and BFSI businesses. In the United States, we help home service businesses turn more inquiries into booked jobs.

At Convin, every team contributes to solving real business problems. Whether you are building our products, taking them to market, growing customer relationships, or strengthening the organization behind them, your work will directly influence Convin’s growth and customer outcomes.

As Convin scales, you will have the opportunity to take ownership, work across India and US markets, and help shape the products, teams, and systems behind our growth. Convin is trusted by leading brands including Physics Wallah, SBI Life, Shaadi.com, Bajaj, Niva Bupa, Aditya Birla & RBL.

**Highlights:**

* Raised $6.5 million in Series A funding in 2024
* Ranked No. 6 on LinkedIn’s Top Startups 2025 list in India
* Ranked the 19th Best Software Company in India by G2

**Role Overview**

As an
**AI Program Manager - Collections**
, you will own the end-to-end delivery of SaaS implementation projects for enterprise customers in BFSI domain. You will be responsible for planning and executing complex implementations, managing client stakeholders, coordinating cross-functional teams, and ensuring projects are delivered on time, within scope, and to the expected quality standards.

The role requires strong project management expertise, hands-on experience in
**BFSI B2B SaaS implementations**
, excellent stakeholder management, and the ability to lead and manage project teams. You will work closely with Sales, Product, Engineering, Customer Success, and Support teams to ensure a seamless customer onboarding and implementation experience.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Project Planning & Execution**

* Own the
  **end-to-end implementation lifecycle**
  from project kickoff to go-live and handover.
* Define project scope, timelines, milestones, dependencies, and success criteria.
* Create and maintain detailed project plans and ensure timely execution.
* Manage multiple enterprise implementation projects simultaneously.
* Track project progress and ensure delivery within agreed timelines and scope.

**Client & Stakeholder Management**

* Act as the
  **primary point of contact for clients**
  throughout the implementation journey.
* Manage relationships with business and technical stakeholders across customer organizations.
* Conduct regular project reviews, status meetings, and stakeholder updates.
* Understand customer requirements and translate them into actionable implementation plans.
* Handle escalations, manage expectations, and ensure a positive client experience.

**Team Management & Leadership**

* Lead and manage a team of project managers/implementation resources.
* Allocate resources, track team performance, and ensure effective project execution.
* Mentor team members and establish best practices for project delivery.
* Drive accountability across internal teams and ensure timely resolution of dependencies.
* Build scalable processes and frameworks for the implementation team.

**SaaS Implementation & Technical Coordination**

* Drive implementation of
  **B2B SaaS products**
  across enterprise customers.
* Coordinate with Product and Engineering teams for integrations, configurations, APIs, deployments, and technical requirements.
* Understand technical dependencies and proactively identify implementation blockers.
* Work with internal teams to troubleshoot issues and drive them to resolution.
* Ensure successful transition from implementation to Customer Success/Support post go-live.

**Risk, Issue & Escalation Management**

* Identify project risks, dependencies, and potential delays proactively.
* Develop mitigation and contingency plans to keep projects on track.
* Own critical implementation issues and drive resolution across teams.
* Escalate risks appropriately while maintaining clear communication with stakeholders.

**Process & Operational Excellence**

* Build and standardize implementation processes, SOPs, templates, and playbooks.
* Identify opportunities to improve implementation efficiency, quality, and scalability.
* Establish project governance and reporting mechanisms.
* Drive continuous improvement across the implementation lifecycle.

**Reporting & Metrics**

* Track project health, timelines, milestones, risks, and key implementation metrics.
* Prepare regular project status reports for internal and leadership stakeholders.
* Monitor implementation KPIs and identify areas requiring intervention.
* Ensure projects meet defined customer success and delivery objectives.

**Cross-functional Collaboration**

* Work closely with
  **Sales, Product, Engineering, Customer Success, Support, and Operations**
  teams.
* Ensure smooth handover from Sales to Implementation.
* Align internal stakeholders on customer requirements, timelines, and dependencies.
* Drive cross-functional collaboration to ensure successful customer go-live.

**Key Qualifications & Skills**

**Must-Have**

* **3–8 years of overall experience in Project Management / Program Management / Implementation.**
* Strong hands-on experience in BFSI
  **B2B SaaS implementation**
  or enterprise software delivery.
* Proven experience managing
  **Indian enterprise clients**
  and customer stakeholders.
* Prior experience in
  **team management**
  , including leading and mentoring project/implementation teams.
* Strong experience managing
  **end-to-end implementation projects**
  with multiple stakeholders and dependencies.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong stakeholder management and client-facing capabilities.
* Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities in a fast-paced environment.
* Strong problem-solving, analytical, and decision-making skills.
* Comfortable working
  **full-time from the Bengaluru office**
  .

**Good to Have**

* Experience working with
  **BFSI clients**
  or exposure to Banking, Financial Services, Insurance, or related domains.
* Experience managing large enterprise accounts and complex implementations.
* Exposure to
  **AI/ML-powered SaaS, Conversation Intelligence, Contact Center, or CX platforms**
  .
* Technical understanding of
  **APIs, integrations, databases, cloud platforms, and software deployment**
  .
* Experience with tools such as
  **JIRA, Asana, Monday.com, Trello, Salesforce, HubSpot**
  , or similar project/CRM platforms.
* Familiarity with
  **Agile/Scrum methodologies**
  .
* Basic understanding of
  **SQL, scripting, or data analytics**
  for troubleshooting and project execution.

**What We’re Looking For**

We’re looking for someone who can
**own projects end-to-end**
, confidently manage enterprise customers, lead internal teams, and ensure implementations move from kickoff to go-live without losing momentum.

The ideal candidate is a
**strong communicator, structured project manager, hands-on problem solver, and people leader**
who can operate effectively in a fast-paced B2B SaaS environment.

a0545c3e.title: Engagement Manager
a0545c3e.description:
**Engagement Manager/Senior Engagement Manager – Data Analytics & AI**

**Location- PAN India |Data, Analytics & AI | Full-time| AI Consulting & Client Engagement**

**About Us**

Straive is a global leader in data analytics and AI operationalization, helping enterprises embed advanced AI and data capabilities into core business workflows to deliver measurable business outcomes and ROI. With a workforce of ~20,000 professionals serving 350+ clients across 30+ markets, Straive combines technical scale with deep domain expertise. A key differentiator is its network of over 6,000 subject matter experts who specialize in managing and enriching complex, unstructured data enabling organizations to build AI systems grounded in accuracy, context, and business relevance.

Named a Leader in AIM's 2026 Generative AI and Data Engineering PeMa Quadrants and backed by EQT, Straive is positioned as a high-value alternative to traditional IT services providers, combining domain-led intelligence with execution at scale.

**About the Role**

Straive is seeking a strategic and driven Engagement Manager / Senior Engagement Manager to lead and coordinate data analytics and AI engagements for strategic enterprise clients across global markets. As a trusted AI consulting partner, this is a high-impact, client-facing role with significant exposure to senior client stakeholders and Straive leadership.

You will be responsible for translating complex business challenges into scalable AI/analytics solutions, acting as the primary bridge between business leaders and technical delivery teams. The role requires fluency in AI concepts (ML, GenAI, LLMs) and a track record of owning end-to-end delivery. You will oversee project execution, drive account growth, manage P&L, and shape strategic programs in an AI-first organization.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Engagement Planning & End-to-End Delivery**

* Define engagement charters, delivery plans, and milestones across concurrent AI and data workstreams.
* Oversee successful execution of analytics and AI initiatives from inception to completion.

**2. Client & Stakeholder Management**

* Engage with CXO / VP-level stakeholders to understand objectives, constraints, and success metrics.
* Build trusted-advisor relationships, managing expectations and delivering exceptional client experiences.

**3. Strategic Translation & Solutioning**

* Translate unstructured client questions into clear problem statements, hypotheses, and analytical workplans.
* Develop AI roadmaps aligning with client vision and business objectives.

**4. Account Growth & Business Development**

* Proactively identify new opportunity areas where AI and analytics can deliver incremental value.
* Drive proposal creation, RFP responses, SOWs, and executive presentations clearly articulating business value.

**Required Experience and Qualifications**

* 10+ years of total professional experience across strategy consulting, analytics consulting, or technology-enabled transformation roles.
* Minimum of 7+ years of relevant experience managing and delivering data analytics, data science, and AI-driven projects.
* Proven track record of leading end-to-end AI/ML solution delivery across global enterprise clients.
* Strong fluency in AI terminology and concepts (e.g., classical AI/ML, GenAI, LLMs).
* Excellent stakeholder management skills, with demonstrated experience interfacing with C-suite and VP-level executives.
* Experience managing account-level P&L and contributing to RFPs and business development efforts.

**Recognition & Achievements**

Recognized as a Star Performer in Data & AI Services Specialists - Everest's North America PEAK Matrix 2025, and as a Leader in AIM's PeMa Quadrant of Agentic AI Service Providers - 2025.

Straive enhanced its AI capabilities by acquiring Gramener in Nov 2023 and SG Analytics in June 2025. For more information, visit https://www.straive.com/

**Equal Opportunity Employer**

Straive is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All employment decisions are based on business needs, job requirements, and individual qualifications, without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran, or disability status.

78f6f1b9.title: Program Manager, ACES, OPTIMA, OPTIMA
78f6f1b9.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

The OPTIMA team is seeking an experienced Program Manager to drive scalable and streamlined continuous improvement initiatives across multiple sites.
  
  
In this role, you will drive a continuous improvement roadmap, lead and facilitate Kaizen events, and implement continuous improvement tools with an aim to improve operational efficiency and enhance annotation quality, directly contributing to CX improvement. You will support stakeholders’ build, test, and deploy cross-functional solutions to address a wide variety of critical business problems. You will take complex opportunities and break them down into manageable pieces, then ensure timely delivery of solutions in time. You will identify technical/resource options to successfully deliver and drive adoption of solutions. You will assess costs, benefits and ROI, identify/mitigate risks, manage escalations, and balance business needs with technical constraints.
  
  
Key job responsibilities  
As an ACES Program Manager, you will:
  

* Lead Improvement Projects / Kaizen events (Lean, DMAIC, DFSS, etc.) to bring together cross-functional teams to identify opportunities and achieve targeted performance improvement in a compressed timeframe
* Bring your expertise, problem solving skills, and creativity to add value to our team
* Unify distributed efforts and own the plan to deliver quality outcomes for our customers
* Work across orgs to ensure we continue integrating internal support capabilities with best-in-class customer experience as new services and features are launched
* Manage programs to continuously improve our organizational efficiency
* Promote the use of Lean and Six Sigma principles
* Provide thought leadership and influence change at all levels of the organization
* Manage projects ensuring on-time delivery of commitments through planning, execution, engagement, documentation, and monitoring of project/program work
* Serve as process guardian in assigned process areas for the change management process
* Partner with tech organization on business requirement documents (BRD)
* Develop, implement, and govern KPI reporting for a portfolio of programs, providing visibility to the milestones and performance across all projects
* Audits completed projects to verify sustained impact

  
About the team  
OPTIMA is a global team and enables Amazon to deliver a superior shopping experience to customers worldwide. Our mission is to empower Amazon's LLMs through Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF) across various categories at high speed. We aspire to provide an end-to-end data solution for the LLM lifecycle, leveraging advanced technology alongside our operational excellence. We enable shopping feature teams to deliver superior CX quality by providing them with reliable and comprehensive insights and ground truth data to measure and train ML (Machine Learning) models and handle annotation and Root Cause Analysis (RCA) across 10+ different languages

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Bachelor's degree
* 3+ years of defining and implementing process improvement initiatives using data and metrics experience
* 3+ years of driving end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership experience
* Experience in creating process improvements with automation and analysis, or experience delivering results for large, cross-functional initiatives/projects
* Lean Six Sigma Green Belt or Black Belt certification

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Advanced degree, or MBA
* Experience with high-level negotiation and successful internal and external relationship management
* Independently manages workstreams while collaborating across teams
* Assisting teams in presenting data and conclusions clearly

  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. ---------------

Amazon.com – a place where builders can build. We hire the world's brightest minds and offer them an environment in which they can invent and innovate to improve the experience for our customers. A Fortune 100 company based in Seattle, Washington, Amazon is the global leader in e-commerce. Amazon offers everything from books and electronics to apparel and diamond jewelry. We operate sites in Australia, Brazil, Canada, China, France, Germany, India, Italy, Japan, Mexico, Netherlands, Spain, United Kingdom and United States, and maintain dozens of fulfillment centers around the world which encompass more than 26 million square feet.  
  
We want you to help share and shape our mission to be Earth's most customer-centric company. Amazon's evolution from Web site to e-commerce partner to development platform is driven by the spirit of invention that is part of our DNA. We do this every day by inventing elegant and simple solutions to complex technical and business problems. We're making history and the good news is that we've only just begun.  
  
About the Role Program Manager  
We are looking for high-potential, flexible, innovative, and forward-thinking professional to join Amazon. Are you ready to drive high-visibility and strategic programs as well as leverage Lean methodologies to lead process improvement initiatives? Are you equally comfortable digging into business requirements as you are driving operational efficiencies?  
  
Join Amazon Transparency team as a Program Manager, we are looking for candidates with a strong record of owning and executing strategic, cross-functional projects as well as partnering with other teams to drive key process improvement programs.  
  
This role requires working with business teams across the company to provide data driven operations support key to the success of the initiative. You will also analyze operations’ data and processes to identify key customer issues/challenges that will help us improve our processes and provide higher value to our customers. This is an opportunity that requires a critical thinker with strong organizational, problem-solving, and communication skills. At the core of the position is passion for protecting Amazon’s reputation and the customer experience and trust.
  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Work with product management teams to understand program requirements and jointly develop a solution which solves a larger business problem

  

* Develop team goals and metrics that allow for accurate measurement and traction towards solving a business problem, achieve buy-in from a broad spectrum of stakeholders and actively report progress on the goals

  

* Continuously perform data based analysis to identify issues and report key insights, subsequently building data backed business cases

  

* Use industry proven tools such as lean/six sigma to drive operational efficiencies and quality improvement in the operations team under your purview

  

* Develop and maintain key relationships with internal stakeholders locally and around the world

  

* Own, help set up and scale new operations’ programs/launches, defining processes, KPI, goals, governance and reporting

  

* Experience working cross functionally with tech and non-tech teams

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 2+ years of program or project management experience
* Knowledge of Excel at an intermediate level (e.g., pivot tables & charts, multiple criteria lookups, nested logical/IF formulas, data cleansing, array formulas, etc.)
* Knowledge of Lean principles and DMAIC methodology
* Experience in requirement gathering and ability to write clear and detailed requirement document
* Bachelor's degree in relevant field, or 2+ years of Amazon RME (BB/3P) full time experience

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience in MS Access and SQL
* Experience with Six Sigma tools and Lean techniques

56914fd5.title: Senior Technical Program Manager
56914fd5.description:
**Job Description**

This role is based in
**PayPay India**
and focuses on technical program management across PayPay's product and platform portfolio. You will drive programs spanning payment processing, regulatory compliance, and platform integrations. The role requires close collaboration with India-based engineering teams and stakeholders across PayPay's headquarters in Japan.

**MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES :**

**Program Execution & Delivery**

* Independently drive technical programs of varying complexity, from well-defined projects to programs with multiple dependencies and cross-functional impact.
* Establish and maintain program governance: risk registers, dependency maps, milestone tracking, and status reporting aligned to PayPay KPI framework (Predictability, Governance, Technical Health, Architecture).
* Monitor program health across progress, risks, blockers, and timelines. Communicate transparently with stakeholders and escalate proactively.
* Make program-level decisions on scope, schedule, and trade-offs with increasing autonomy.

**Technical & Product Engagement**

* Contribute to and influence technical design discussions, architecture reviews, and TDD (Technical Design Document) reviews with focus on security, compliance, and payment integrity.
* Engage with AI/ML applications in FinTech (fraud detection, risk scoring, recommendation engines) as they relate to program scope.
* Ensure completion of non-functional requirements (Security, Performance, Compliance, Regulatory Requirements) prior to release milestones.
* Partner with Engineering Managers and Product Managers to translate business goals into actionable execution plans aligned with financial services standards.

**Agile & Process Leadership**

* Champion Agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban) within assigned teams, fostering transparency, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
* Tailor PayPay SDLC practices to team context while maintaining alignment with organizational standards.
* Facilitate planning, retrospectives, and cross-team coordination meetings as needed.
* Leverage generative AI tools appropriately to enhance productivity in documentation, analysis, and communication task.
* Identify and drive process improvements that benefit program delivery and team effectiveness.

**Stakeholder Management & Communication**

* Manage stakeholder alignment across Engineering, Product, Design, QA, and business partners.
* Build strong working relationships across teams and geographies (India, Japan headquarters.
* Represent programs in leadership forums and cross-functional planning sessions.

**Mentorship & Collaboration**

* Mentor junior TPMs and new team members on program management fundamentals, PayPay processes, and best practices.
* Contribute to the TPM community knowledge base and process documentation.
* Foster an inclusive, collaborative environment within programs and teams.

**MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related technical field.
* 10+ years professional experience, including 5–7 years in technical program management.
* Experience in FinTech, payments, banking, or financial services with exposure to payment processing or regulated product development.
* Strong understanding of software architecture, payment systems, and SDLC.
* Proven experience managing complex technical programs with multiple dependencies and cross-functional teams.
* Understanding of security and compliance requirements in financial services.
* Practical use of generative AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Copilot) for program management productivity.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
* Experience with Agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban).

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS :**

* Deep knowledge of security and compliance frameworks in financial services (e.g., data protection, transaction security, regulatory standards.
* Experience managing third-party integrations (payment gateways, banking systems, settlement platforms.
* Experience managing AI/ML-driven programs in FinTech (fraud detection, risk models, transaction monitoring) with ability to identify AI-specific risks (data quality, model drift, bias, explainability.
* Technical depth: working knowledge of programming languages, cloud platforms, CI/CD pipelines.
* Business-level English fluency for global collaboration.
* Experience mentoring TPMs or leading process improvement initiatives.
* **Leverage AI/LLM-based tools in daily workflows (e.g., code development, reviews, testing, debugging, documentation), while ensuring human oversight, judgment, and accountability drive the final product.**

**Title: Technical Program Manager**

Razorpay is looking for a Technical Program Manager (TPM) to join our central program management team. At Razorpay, the TPM is a highly diversified and critical role. It includes initiating, defining, planning, and executing intermediate to large scale, cross-functional programs company-wide programs. The TPM will be responsible for the strategies, processes, tools, & techniques to drive product development programs across Razorpay products.

As a TPM, you will independently drive programs, influencing the roadmap priorities and technical direction across teams. You will work with stakeholders across the organization and own the communication on all aspects of the program, including surfacing risks and reporting on the progress towards the program goals. You will guide the team towards technical solutions and make trade-off decisions. You will drive program management best practices across the organization and mentor others to effectively deliver their programs.

* Lead planning, dependency resolution and execution of assigned program(s), which constitute multiple projects, and ensuring critical success factors are defined and monitored and the objectives are achieved.
* Drive program definition and scoping, own the program plan and the deliverables required for the program’s success.
* Develop and manage an integrated program schedule, and monitor and report on progress.
* Present program(s) status on a regular basis to stakeholders and senior executives.
* At the heart of this role is delivery. You will be a problem solver on the team, identifying innovative solutions to project deadlocks and resolving issues and constraints through alignment, consensus and sound judgment.
* Be responsible for making decisions, and achieving tactical goals while retaining a strategic focus.
* Prioritize projects, leveraging data to drive decisions.
* Define, refine, and continuously improve processes and practices to drive efficiency and scale.
* Establish excellent working relations with all internal and external partners, with an emphasis on removing roadblocks to program success.

**Mandatory Qualifications:**

* Total 6+ years, with 4+ years in a technical role and 2+ years working as a project manager or program manager in software or related industries.
* A Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent in Engineering, or a related field. PGDM/ MBA would be a big plus.
* Strong verbal & written communication and presentation skills with a high degree of comfort speaking with executives, product and technical leaders, external partners, and developers.
* Demonstrated ability to adapt to new environments and new technologies and learn quickly.
* Possess an in-depth technical understanding of the agile software development lifecycle.
* Ability to traverse both vertically and horizontally in a large organization.
* Extensive experience defining programs and implementing them across a team focused on delivering outcomes that meet rapidly evolving customer needs.
* Proven ability to bring clarity to ambiguous situations.
* Ability to handle multiple competing priorities in a fast-paced environment.
* Ability to interact with diverse technical and non-technical groups, spanning all organizational levels.
* Knowledge of project management elements, life cycles, tools, and reporting.

2b6b38dc.description:
Technical Program Manager – Job Description

Technical Program Manager (Delhi/Gurgaon/Noida) to drive program execution at a deep-tech semiconductor company and represent it, alongside the founder and CTO, to key stake holders in Government, industry partners and customers.

About Ananant Systems

Ananant Systems Pvt. Ltd. is a Noida-based fabless semiconductor company building AI-native DSP SoCs and systems for 5G wireless infrastructure, Edge and Vision AI, and cellular IoT. We work with Government, defence, international partners, customers and investors, and are scaling from silicon and product development into programs and deployments.

The role

The Technical Program Manager owns execution of Ananant's programs end to end and is the founder's and CTO's right hand in external engagements. You will split your time between running internal programs and representing the company to key stakeholders in Government, partners, vendors and customers.

Item

Detail

Title

Technical Program Manager

Location

Delhi NCR (Noida/Gurgoan/Delhi), on-site with regular travel

Reports to

Founder and CTO

Works with

Engineering, product, finance, and external stakeholders

Travel

Frequent: state capitals, partner and customer sites; occasional international

Key responsibilities

**Internal program execution**

* Own program plans, milestones, dependencies and risk registers across systems, silicon, hardware, software and product teams; run weekly reviews and escalate early.
* Track deliverables, budgets and schedules for funded programs and customer engagements, and report status to the founder and CTO.
* Coordinate with foundry, EMS, IP and tool vendors on schedules, deliveries and commercial terms.
* Build and maintain processes, templates and dashboards that bring discipline to a fast-moving engineering organization.

**External stakeholders**

* Manage/co-ordinate engagement with key stake holders in Government, industry partners, customers and investors; prepare briefs, follow up and close action items.
* Write and manage technical proposals, grant applications, project reports and presentations for Central and state Government and defence agencies.
* Negotiate with vendors and partners on pricing, timelines, scope and agreements, with support from the founder.
* Manage compliance, reporting and milestone-linked disbursements for grants and sponsored programs.
* Maintain the stakeholder map and relationship history so that no commitment is dropped.

Qualifications

**Education**

* Engineering and/or management degree (B.Tech, M.Tech, MBA or equivalent) from a Tier 1 institution such as the IITs, IIMs, IISc or BITS, or an equivalent global institution.
* Education and/or work experience outside India is preferred.

**Domain knowledge**

Working understanding of products, applications and markets in:

* Wireless and telecom infrastructure (4G/5G, small cells, RAN)
* Industrial and IoT systems
* Edge AI, camera and vision systems
* Semiconductors and SoC development flow
* Drones and robotics

**Skills and experience**

* Strong technical documentation: proposals, project reports, grant applications, briefing notes and executive presentations.
* Proven vendor and partner negotiation, covering pricing, contracts and delivery terms.
* Experience working with Government entities (ministries, state agencies, PSUs) and defence organizations, including grant, tender and procurement processes.
* Track record managing cross-functional technical programs with multiple external dependencies.
* Prior experience in a startup, semiconductor, telecom or deep-tech environment is an advantage.

Personal attributes

* **Very high energy:**
  thrives in a fast-paced environment with many parallel threads and frequent travel.
* **Ownership:**
  takes a task from assignment to closure without being chased, and flags problems early.
* **Relationship builder:**
  earns trust quickly with senior officials, executives and founders, and keeps relationships warm over time.
* **Clear communicator:**
  writes crisp, accurate documents and speaks credibly with both engineers and non-technical stakeholders.
* **Negotiator:**
  firm on outcomes, fair on terms, and conscious of long-term partnerships.
* **Judgment and discretion:**
  handles sensitive Government, defence and commercial information with care.

5c1c891f.title: Domain Pre Sales AP
5c1c891f.description:
**FICO (NYSE: FICO)**
is a leading global analytics software company, helping businesses in 100+ countries make better decisions. Join our world-class team today and fulfill your career potential!
  
  
**The Opportunity**
As a Business Partner in our Domain Risk Pre-Sales unit, you'll identify and cultivate new opportunities related to credit and fraud risk, combining deep business knowledge across both domains with a consultative, solutions-based approach to selling. This role focuses on building new revenue streams through the expansion of FICO Platform capabilities, working closely with the Asia Pacific sales team to translate client business challenges into compelling and credible solutions.
  
  
**What You’ll Contribute**

* Partner with clients on discovery and scoping sessions to uncover business challenges and growth opportunities, then develop proposals and business cases that demonstrate value.
* Contribute to client account plans and lead deal structuring and negotiations, working with internal teams to shape and position solutions that protect existing business and win new deals.
* Contribute to go-to-market strategy and market sizing, tracking industry trends and maintaining a strong grasp of our products and the competitive landscape.
* Support innovation workshops, quarterly business reviews, and PoC/PoV engagements, acting as a credit and fraud risk subject matter expert for financial services, insurance, retail, and telecommunications clients.
* Apply your knowledge of the risk management lifecycle, including originations, customer management, fraud, collections, and digital transformation, to build platform demos with Key Account Managers, Solution Sales Executives, and Platform Presales teams.
* Develop strategic plans, proposals, business cases, and executive presentations, tailoring content for audiences ranging from technical teams to C-level executives.
* Build FICO Platform brand awareness and thought leadership through social media, case studies, blogs, white papers, webinars, and event presentations.
* Up to 50% travel across the region.

**What We’re Seeking**

* Exceptional executive-level communication and presentation skills, with a proven ability to engage C-suite stakeholders, boards, and senior leadership, translating complex business insights and technical detail into business impact, ROI, and actionable strategy across strategic planning documents, proposals, and business cases.
* Experience in credit and/or fraud risk management, with a proven track record of achieving meaningful loss reduction and/or customer experience improvements, complemented by sales experience as a vendor and demonstrated project leadership and results orientation.
* Comprehensive understanding of the risk management lifecycle across the entire customer journey, with senior-level expertise across multiple credit and fraud risk domains including originations, transactional/payment fraud, online/mobile banking fraud, application fraud, first party fraud, customer management, and collections.
* Extensive experience working with payment processors, payment gateways, payment networks, issuers, and acquirers, including authorization flows, real-time decisioning, and processor, gateway, and network-specific operating models.
* End-user knowledge of credit and fraud risk management solutions, authorization systems, authentication solutions, loan origination systems, and other decision management platforms.
* Bachelor's degree in business, analytics, data science, or a related field of study, or equivalent experience.

**Our Offer to You**

* An inclusive culture strongly reflecting our core values: Act Like an Owner, Delight Our Customers and Earn the Respect of Others.
* The opportunity to make an impact and develop professionally by leveraging your unique strengths and participating in valuable learning experiences.
* Highly competitive compensation, benefits and rewards programs that encourage you to bring your best every day and be recognized for doing so.
* An engaging, people-first work environment offering work/life balance, employee resource groups, and social events to promote interaction and camaraderie.

**Why Make a Move to FICO?**
At FICO, you can develop your career with a leading organization in one of the fastest-growing fields in technology today – Big Data analytics. You’ll play a part in our commitment to help businesses use data to improve every choice they make, using advances in artificial intelligence, machine learning, optimization, and much more.
  
  
FICO makes a real difference in the way businesses operate worldwide:
  
  

* Credit Scoring — FICO® Scores are used by 90 of the top 100 US lenders.
* Fraud Detection and Security — 4 billion payment cards globally are protected by FICO fraud systems.
* Lending — 3/4 of US mortgages are approved using the FICO Score.

Global trends toward digital transformation have created tremendous demand for FICO’s solutions, placing us among the world’s top 100 software companies by revenue. We help many of the world’s largest banks, insurers, retailers, telecommunications providers and other firms reach a new level of success. Our success is dependent on really talented people – just like you – who thrive on the collaboration and innovation that’s nurtured by a diverse and inclusive environment. We’ll provide the support you need, while ensuring you have the freedom to develop your skills and grow your career. Join FICO and help change the way business thinks!
  
  
Learn more about how you can fulfil your potential at www.fico.com/Careers
  
  
FICO promotes a culture of inclusion and seeks to attract a diverse set of candidates for each job opportunity. We are an equal employment opportunity employer and we’re proud to offer employment and advancement opportunities to all candidates without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, pregnancy, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. Research has shown that women and candidates from underrepresented communities may not apply for an opportunity if they don’t meet all stated qualifications. While our qualifications are clearly related to role success, each candidate’s profile is unique and strengths in certain skill and/or experience areas can be equally effective. If you believe you have many, but not necessarily all, of the stated qualifications we encourage you to apply.
  
  
Information submitted with your application is subject to the FICO Privacy policy at https://www.fico.com/en/privacy-policy

b0e6d855.description:
**Meet the Team**
Join Splunk, a Cisco company solution engineering team supporting Public Sector customers and helping organizations address complex security and technology challenges. In this role, you’ll work closely with government and Public Sector organizations, partners, and cross-functional sales teams to deliver innovative Cisco and Splunk security solutions. You’ll serve as a trusted technical advisor, helping customers strengthen their security posture while driving adoption and growth across the portfolio.
  
  
**Your Impact**
**As a Technical Sales Professional, You Will**

* Own the technical relationship with Public Sector customers and partners, serving as a trusted technical advisor and primary technical sales influencer.
* Partner with account and sales teams on strategic account planning, identifying growth opportunities and aligning technical strategies with Public Sector customer objectives.
* Engage with IT and security leaders, technical decision-makers, and lines of business to understand customer environments, security challenges, business priorities, and technical requirements.
* Translate customer business and security needs into innovative Cisco and Splunk Security solutions and lead strategic solution conversations.
* Design and present cross-architecture security solutions, demonstrations, and technical presentations that address complex Public Sector challenges.
* Lead technical engagements throughout the sales cycle, helping move opportunities from technical discovery and validation through closure.
* Leverage strong knowledge of Splunk Security technologies, including Splunk Cloud, Splunk Enterprise Security (ES), SIEM, SOAR, UEBA, Risk-Based Alerting (RBA), Threat Intelligence, Detection Engineering, Mission Control, and security analytics.
* Apply knowledge of security technologies and architectures including SOC, incident response, threat hunting, XDR/EDR, network security, cloud security, Zero Trust, and security operations to develop relevant customer solutions.
* Leverage competitive market insights to position and differentiate Cisco and Splunk solutions against competing security platforms.
* Coordinate and influence virtual teams of sales resources, security specialists, internal stakeholders, and external partners to drive customer success.
* Provide feedback to Business Entities (BEs) and relevant sales teams on strategic Public Sector customer needs, security trends, market opportunities, and competitive tactics.
* Contribute to demand-generation, technical enablement, and education initiatives that strengthen Cisco and Splunk security capabilities across the Public Sector.
* Adapt technical and engagement strategies to evolving Public Sector priorities, cybersecurity threats, technology trends, and market conditions.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree with 7+ years of related experience, or Master’s degree with 4+ years of related experience, or PhD with 1+ year of related experience.
* 7+ years of experience in technical sales, solutions engineering, security consulting, cybersecurity, or a related customer-facing technical role.
* Experience engaging with Public Sector customers, IT/security leaders, technical decision-makers, and business stakeholders.
* Experience designing, presenting, and demonstrating security or technology solutions aligned to customer business challenges.
* Experience with security technologies such as SIEM, SOAR, security analytics, threat detection, incident response, or security operations.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience working with Public Sector or government customers, particularly within complex or regulated environments.
* Strong knowledge of Splunk Security, including Splunk Enterprise Security, SIEM, SOAR, UEBA, Risk-Based Alerting, Threat Intelligence, and security analytics.
* Experience across XDR/EDR, Network Security, Cloud Security, Zero Trust, Threat Hunting, SOC, and Incident Response.
* Experience driving cross-sell, up-sell, competitive displacement, or market-share growth within strategic accounts.
* Strong understanding of cybersecurity trends, customer environments, and competitive security technologies.
* Experience influencing technical executives and leading strategic security solution conversations.

Why Cisco?
  
  
At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
  
  
Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
  
  
We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.
  
  
**Disclaimer**
**About**
To ensure that we hire the best talent in the right way, we follow a strict hiring process and recently, Cisco has been made aware of fraudulent recruiters claiming to be from the company. Please be advised that any communication from Cisco about careers will:
  
  

* be in direct response to an application you have submitted through the company career site
* begin with screening or an interview
* originate from a Cisco email address, and
* be conducted across email, phone, or WebEx

Cisco will never make a job offer without conducting an interview process or ask you for money in any way. If you have been requested to apply for a role or have received an offer from a site other than https://careers.cisco.com or cisco.wd5.myworkday.com, do not provide any personal identifying information, including your Aadhaar or other personal identifying number, birth certificate, banking information, driver's license, or passport.
  
  
If you are the target of a recruiting scam, consider filing a report with your local law enforcement authorities. Cisco bears no responsibility, and cannot be held liable, for any claims, damages, expenses, or other inconvenience resulting from or in any way connected to recruiting scams.

99d0737f.title: Head of AI Solutions & Delivery
99d0737f.description:
**About TVARIT:**

TVARIT GmbH specializes in developing and delivering cutting-edge artificial intelligence (AI) solutions for the metal industry, including steel, aluminum, copper, cast iron, and more. Our software products empower customers to make intelligent, data-driven decisions, driving

advancements in Predictive Quality (PsQ), Predictive Maintenance (PdM), and Energy Consumption Reduction (PsE).

With a strong portfolio of renowned reference customers, state-of-the-art technology, a talented research team from prestigious universities, and recognition through esteemed awards such as the EU Horizon 2020 AI Prize, TVARIT is recognized as one of the most

innovative AI companies in Germany and Europe.

We are looking for a self-motivated person with a positive “can-do” attitude and excellent oral and written communication skills in English.

**About the Role:**

We are looking for a senior leader to head TVARIT’s Metals Division, owning customer relationships, solution delivery, and the growth of our industrial AI business with steel, aluminum, copper, cast iron, and other metal producers and processors. The role calls for an engineer who combines first-hand manufacturing plant experience, ideally in metals, with strong data science and AI expertise and a proven record of leading software delivery with a team

The Head of AI Solutions & Delivery will be the senior face of TVARIT to metals customers, from the first discovery workshop through deployment and scaled adoption, and will be accountable for delivering projects on time, within scope, and with measurable impact on

quality, yield, uptime, and energy consumption. The role leads a multidisciplinary team of data scientists, software engineers, and domain experts, and turns successful deployments into reusable, scalable offerings for the metals sector.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Division Leadership & Growth:**

* Lead the Metals Division end to end, including strategy, customer portfolio, revenue and delivery targets, and division-level planning and reporting.
* Build, lead, and mentor a multidisciplinary team of data scientists, ML engineers, software engineers, and metallurgy/process domain experts; set clear goals, hiring plans, and standards of technical excellence.
* Define the division’s solution and product roadmap together with product and business teams, prioritizing use cases with recurring demand across steel, aluminum, and other metal processes.
* Grow existing accounts and win new business through solution design, technical proposals, RFP/RFI responses, proof-of-concept planning, and commercial discussions.

**Customer Engagement:**

* Act as the senior technical and executive point of contact for metals customers, building trusted relationships with plant managers, process and quality engineers, IT/OT teams, and senior decision makers.
* Lead discovery discussions and requirements workshops, on the shop floor and in the boardroom, to understand manufacturing processes, operational challenges, existing systems, and business priorities.
* Translate customer needs into clearly defined use cases, solution concepts, highlevel architectures, implementation scope, and measurable success criteria.
* Present TVARIT’s capabilities through relevant project examples, demonstrations, and workshops, communicating methodology, technical differentiation, limitations, and expected business value credibly to technical and executive audiences

**Delivery Excellence:**

* Own delivery of all Metals Division projects, from scoping and data onboarding through model development, deployment, user adoption, and value realization, ensuring on-time, on-budget, high-quality outcomes.
* Establish delivery governance across projects: plans and milestones, risk and dependency management, customer status reporting, and escalation handling.
* Assess feasibility before commitment, considering data readiness, integration with PLC/SCADA, MES, and historians, deployment constraints, effort, and business impact; align customer commitments with team capacity and technical readiness.
* Track and demonstrate realized value (e.g., scrap reduction, yield, first-pass quality, energy per tonne, unplanned downtime) and use proven results to drive renewals and expansion.

**Technical, Data Science & AI Leadership:**

* Provide hands-on technical direction on data science and ML approaches for metal processes, including time-series modeling, predictive quality, predictive maintenance, process optimization, and hybrid physics-informed models.
* Review solution architectures and engineering practices for robustness, scalability, and maintainability; set standards for software delivery, MLOps, and model monitoring.
* Identify reusable intellectual property across projects, including models, algorithms, software components, and process expertise, and guide its development into configurable, scalable products for the metals sector with minimal incremental development where feasible.
* Stay current on industrial AI, including generative AI and industrial copilots, and evaluate where they add real value for metals customers.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Engineering (Metallurgical, Mechanical, Electrical, Chemical, Computer Science, or a related discipline); a postgraduate qualification in Data Science, AI, or Computer Science is an advantage.
* **10+ years of professional experience,** including substantial experience leading teams and customer engagements in industrial AI, manufacturing technology, industrial software, or technology-led solution delivery.
* **Mandatory manufacturing exposure:** direct experience working in or closely with manufacturing plants and their operations teams. Metals experience (e.g., steel, aluminum, copper, foundry/casting, rolling, forging, extrusion, or heat treatment) is strongly preferred; automotive, heavy engineering, or process manufacturing is also considered
* **Software delivery leadership:** must have led the delivery of software products or solutions with a team, with a solid working understanding of the software development lifecycle (requirements, design, development, testing, release, and maintenance) and agile delivery practices. Hands-on coding exposure (e.g., Python) is mandatory; professional software development experience is an advantage.
* **Mandatory AI modeling experience:** strong understanding of AI/ML modeling (problem framing, feature engineering, model selection, validation, and deployment considerations) and hands-on involvement in AI/ML modeling projects, ideally on industrial, sensor, or time-series data.
* **Proven customer-facing leadership**, including requirements gathering, technical presentations, executive stakeholder management, and managing customer expectations through delivery
* **Proven delivery track record:** leading complex, multi-stakeholder technology projects to successful deployment, with accountability for timelines, scope, quality, and customer satisfaction.
* Experience in solution architecture, presales, technical proposals, or productizing project work into reusable offerings.
* Strong people leadership, with experience building and mentoring high-performing technical teams; excellent written and verbal communication, structured problemsolving, and the ability to represent TVARIT confidently with senior stakeholders.
* Willingness to travel to customer plants as required.

**Technical Skills**

**Strong Haves**

* **Data science and AI:** Strong understanding of machine learning, deep learning, time-series analysis, anomaly detection, predictive and prescriptive analytics, optimization, and hybrid physics-informed modeling, with a clear view of their practical applications and limitations.
* **Metals process understanding:** Ability to relate process parameters in melting, casting, rolling, forging, extrusion, or heat treatment to quality, yield, scrap, energy consumption, equipment health, and operating cost.
* **Software development lifecycle:** Working understanding of how industrial software is planned, built, tested, released, and supported, including agile practices, CI/CD, code quality, and testing, sufficient to lead engineering teams and make sound delivery trade-offs. Hands-on coding exposure in Python is required, along with working familiarity with SQL.
* **Solution architecture and productization:** Translating business and operational requirements into functional specifications, reference architectures, and implementation roadmaps; reusable components, configurable solutions, model generalization, and validation across plants.

Familiarity Needed

* **Industrial data and integration:** Familiarity with PLC/SCADA systems, historians, MES, sensors, lab and quality data, and manufacturing data platforms, including data quality, contextualization, and OT/IT integration
* **Deployment and MLOps:** Cloud, edge, and on-premises deployment, MLOps, model monitoring and retraining, security, and reliability. Familiarity with Azure is preferred; AWS or GCP experience is also relevant.
* **Emerging AI:** Awareness of generative AI, LLMs, and industrial copilots, including their practical applications and limitations in manufacturing

059cca4d.title: Technical System Engineer (Cloud, Data & IoT)
059cca4d.description:
"You care about making a positive impact in the world. You understand greatness requires thinking differently. An inclusive and accepting work environment is important to you.

A job at IKEA is so much more than home furnishings. Together, we work to make a better everyday life for the many. It's the perfect fit if you want to contribute, grow, and share. Join the team and start a better life for yourself."

* Location

  Bengaluru
* Employment type

  Full Time Permanent
* Department

  IT & Digital Solutions
* Deadline

  2026-11-23

  

Candidate profile (text) - Default language We are looking for a hands-on Technical System Engineer to design and build the cloud, data and IoT foundation for our real estate portfolio. You will connect smart building systems, IoT devices and business systems into a scalable data platform that powers insights on energy, occupancy, maintenance and building performance.
  
  
This is a technical role for someone who has delivered large projects end to end, combines a cloud architecture background with full-stack / back-end development, and is strong in data engineering with Databricks and Python.
  
  
As a Technical Systems Engineer in the Group Real Estate, you will be at the heart of a foundational transformation in IWMS.
  
  
This means that you will:
  

* Cloud architecture: implement and maintain secure, scalable cloud architectures for real estate and smart building solutions on GCP, Azure or AWS.
* Data platform: Build and operate the data lake / lakehouse (e.g. Databricks, Delta Lake) for building, IoT, IWMS and business data, including ingestion, modelling and governance.
* Data pipelines: Develop batch and streaming pipelines in Python / PySpark and SQL for time-series sensor data, BMS data and system integrations.
* IoT & smart buildings: integrate IoT device connectivity and smart building systems (BMS, energy meters, occupancy and environmental sensors) using protocols such as MQTT, BACnet and OPC UA.
* Back-end & full-stack development: Build APIs, microservices and, where needed, web front-ends that expose building data and insights to users and other systems (including the IWMS / Planon).
* Large projects: Lead the technical workstream on large, multi-site projects – from solution design and estimation through build, rollout and handover to operations.
* DevOps & quality: Set up CI/CD, infrastructure as code, monitoring and automated testing; ensure security, reliability and cost efficiency.
* Analytics & AI enablement: Enable dashboards, KPIs and advanced analytics/ML use cases such as energy optimisation, predictive maintenance and space utilisation.
* Follow engineering best practice specified within Ikea Digital organisation

Key responsibilities (text) We believe you bring:
  

* 4–7 years’ experience in software, cloud and data engineering, including large-scale projects
* Data platform - Databricks, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, data lake / lakehouse architecture
* Programming - Python, PySpark, SQL; plus a back-end language such as Java, Go or Node.js
* Back-end / full-stack - REST / GraphQL APIs, microservices, event-driven architecture; React / Angular / Vue
* Data engineering - Advanced: Batch & streaming pipelines, Kafka / Pub/Sub, time-series data, data modelling, data quality
* IoT & smart buildings - MQTT, IoT gateways, edge computing, BMS integration (BACnet, Modbus, OPC UA), digital twin concepts
* DevOps - CI/CD (GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, GitLab), Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform
* Security & governance - IAM, network security, secrets management, data governance, GDPR

This is our wish list!
  
  
The must-haves we see for this role are:
  

* Hands-on experience in software and data engineering, with a track record of delivering large, complex projects.
* Cloud architecture: background in cloud architecture on GCP and/or Azure / AWS (compute, storage, networking, security, serverless, managed data services).
* Software engineering: Full-stack experience with back-end focus – designing and building APIs, services and integrations.
