eeae227a.title: Technical Support Engineer (Cloud), India
eeae227a.description:
At AlgoSec, what you do matters!
  
  
AlgoSec helps the world’s leading organizations secure application connectivity across hybrid and multi-cloud environments. Trusted by more than 2,200 global organizations, our platform delivers visibility, security policy management, risk reduction, and compliance automation across complex enterprise networks.
  
  
AlgoSec is looking for an experienced Technical Support Engineer to join our global Support organization.
  
  
For this position, we are specifically looking for a candidate with strong Cloud, Linux, and automation experience who can complement the networking and firewall expertise already existing within the team and support AlgoSec's continued evolution toward SaaS, cloud-based capabilities, and AI integrations.
  
  
**Reporting to:**
Support Team Leader / Support Manager
  
  
**Location:**
Gurgaon, India – office-based preferred; remote work may be considered
  
  
**Employment:**
Direct employment
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Provide technical support to AlgoSec customers and partners worldwide via email, phone, and web sessions.
* Troubleshoot technical issues related to product installation, configuration, operation, cloud infrastructure, applications, networking, and security environments.
* Guide customers, partners, and Sales Engineers through technical issues and product-related questions.
* Investigate complex technical problems across cloud, Linux, application, and network environments.
* Work closely with global Support teams, R&D, Delivery, and Product Management to drive issues to resolution.
* Take ownership of customer issues and manage them through resolution.
* Develop and maintain operational scripts and automations to improve Support efficiency, reduce manual effort, and increase service reliability.
* Document technical findings and maintain and improve the AlgoSec knowledge base.
* Contribute to the continuous improvement of Support processes, methodologies, tools, and automation.

**What We're Looking For**

* At least 3 years of experience in Technical Support or a similar customer-facing technical role within a software company.
* Practical experience with cloud platforms such as AWS and/or Microsoft Azure, including troubleshooting cloud infrastructure, networking, security, and platform services.
* Strong hands-on experience administering and troubleshooting Linux/Unix environments.
* Experience with scripting and automation using Bash, Python, PowerShell, Shell scripting, or similar technologies.
* Experience building or maintaining operational automations to improve efficiency, reduce manual effort, or enhance service reliability.
* Experience supporting network security, infrastructure, or other complex enterprise software products.
* Good understanding of networking and security concepts.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to diagnose complex technical issues across cloud and application environments.
* Ability to independently investigate technical issues and take ownership through resolution.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
* Ability to perform effectively in a fast-paced environment while managing multiple priorities.
* Willingness to work flexible hours as part of a 24x7 global Support organization.

**Nice-to-have**

* Experience with Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform, CloudFormation, or Bicep.
* Experience with containerization and orchestration technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes.
* Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and automation platforms such as GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, or Jenkins.
* Experience implementing AI-powered operational workflows, predictive analytics, intelligent alerting, or GenAI-based Support automation solutions.
* Experience with SaaS products or cloud-native application environments.
* Experience with firewall technologies such as Check Point, Palo Alto, Cisco, Juniper, Fortinet, or similar platforms.
* Experience working directly with R&D, Product, or Delivery teams on complex customer issues.
* Experience creating technical documentation or Knowledge Base content.

**Personal attributes**

* Independent, resourceful, and results-oriented.
* Strong analytical and troubleshooting mindset.
* Fast learner with a strong interest in emerging technologies, cloud platforms, automation, and AI-driven operations.
* Strong team player with high integrity and a customer-first mindset.
* Comfortably operating under pressure and handling multiple technical issues simultaneously.

AlgoSec is an Equal Opportunity Employer (EEO), committed to creating a friendly, diverse and inclusive company culture.

1b5b2443.description:
**Discover your future at Citi**
--------------------------------

Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.

**Job Overview**
----------------

The **Lead Technical Program Manager, Fraud Technology** is responsible for driving end-to-end technology governance, architectural alignment, and delivery execution for Citi’s Enterprise Fraud Prevention initiatives. In this role, you will serve as a technical authority navigating critical cross-functional dependencies across distributed engineering squads, data science teams, core platform services, and risk/compliance partners. You will blend deep systems acumen with executive presence and crisp, diplomatic communication to guide multi-million-dollar programs from architectural discovery through production rollout. This position requires an in-depth understanding of how sub-functional units integrate end-to-end, as well as the ability to coordinate across diverse groups to achieve broad organizational objectives.

**Key Responsibilities**

**End-to-End Program Delivery & Strategic Roadmap Execution**

* Lead end-to-end technology planning, execution, and delivery governance across complex, mission-critical programs within Citi’s Fraud Technology Book of Work.
* Define, baseline, and track program milestones, critical paths, and deliverable commitments across multiple agile squads and hybrid legacy/modernized distributed platforms.
* Proactively manage complex cross-program dependencies, identifying technical bottlenecks, architectural conflicts, and resource constraints early to formulate and execute effective mitigation plans.
* Establish rigorous Definition of Done (DoD), release readiness criteria, and robust operational cutover strategies tailored for high-throughput, ultra-low-latency financial transaction systems.

**Architecture Alignment, Dependency Management & Systems Integration**

* Guide stakeholders and engineering squads through complex trade-off evaluations, balancing business priorities, customer experience, platform strategy, performance benchmarks, and long-term maintainability.
* Facilitate technical architecture reviews, interface design agreements (REST/SOAP APIs, Kafka/event-driven streaming), and binding cross-team integration contracts.
* Apply deep technical domain knowledge across core software engineering disciplines, including microservices architectures, distributed API protocols, hybrid cloud and on-premise infrastructure, and resilient data layers.

**AI-Augmented Program Management & Operational Excellence**

* Champion and integrate modern Generative AI (GenAI) and automated tooling to streamline and modernize traditional program management workflows:
  + Automate the synthesis of complex technical discussions, action items, and Architectural Decision Records (ADRs).
  + Accelerate the generation of executive dashboards, release notes, and milestone variance analytics.
  + Standardize AI-driven delivery best practices, prompts, and reporting templates across participating engineering teams.

**Executive Presence & Stakeholder Communication**

* Serve as the primary strategic liaison between engineering teams and executive leadership, articulating delivery health, technical trade-offs, blockers, and architectural risks with clarity, precision, and business context.
* Influence, negotiate, and align cross-functional stakeholders across organizational boundaries without formal line authority.
* Author and deliver high-impact executive collateral (executive one-pagers, steering committee presentations, risk heatmaps) and crisp briefings to Senior Leadership (MD/C-suite level).
* Cultivate strong collaborative partnerships across business units, external technology vendors, operations, internal audit, and technology peers.

**Risk, Governance, and Control Management**

* Proactively identify, evaluate, track, and remediate technical program risks, architectural vulnerabilities, and control deficiencies across all delivery tiers.
* Ensure strict compliance with Citi’s Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) governance, architecture review board standards, data governance policies, and relevant regulatory mandates (e.g., OCC, Federal Reserve, PCI-DSS, Model Risk Management).
* Champion operational resilience and release integrity, enforcing zero-unauthorized-change policies, comprehensive automated rollback strategies, and stringent incident management protocols.

**Qualifications & Competencies**

**Experience & Domain Expertise**

* **10+ years of experience** in Technical Program Management, Technology Project Management, Engineering Delivery, or related technology leadership roles managing large-scale enterprise initiatives.
* **2+ years of experience** supporting payments, fintech, fraud prevention, risk management, or other highly regulated technology environments utilizing Agile, Scrum, SAFe, or Hybrid delivery frameworks.
* Strong technical fluency in modern software architecture patterns, including microservices, REST/SOAP APIs, event-driven architectures (Kafka/MQ), hybrid cloud/on-prem environments, and distributed database systems.
* Experience coordinating cross-functional teams, managing dependencies, tracking critical-path milestones, and supporting vendor integrations in matrixed organizations.
* Demonstrated ability to deliver complex technology initiatives from planning through production deployment.

**Project Management & AI Tooling**

* PMP, PMI-ACP, CSM, SAFe, or comparable project/program management certification preferred.
* Hands-on experience with enterprise delivery, portfolio, and collaboration tools including Jira, Confluence, Jira Align, MS Project, and ServiceNow.
* Experience utilizing AI-enabled productivity tools (e.g., Copilot, LLMs, or enterprise AI platforms) to support reporting, documentation, meeting synthesis, and delivery management activities.

**Leadership & Communication**

* Demonstrated ability to facilitate stakeholder discussions, drive consensus, and influence technical and business partners in a cross-functional environment.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to translate technical concepts into clear business-focused messaging.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to manage competing priorities and navigate ambiguity.

**Education**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, Business Technology, or a related discipline. Master's degree preferred.

**Other Relevant Skills** Delivery Management, Project Management, Stakeholder Management

---------------------

-

--------------

Full time

------------------------

e60432ed.description:
Technical Program Manager – Firmware and SecurityThis role has been designated as ‘Remote/Teleworker’, which means you will primarily work from home.

**Who We Are:**

Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge-to-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today’s complex world. Our culture thrives on finding new and better ways to accelerate what’s next. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good. If you are looking to stretch and grow your career our culture will embrace you. Open up opportunities with HPE.

**Job Description:**

**Compute** at **HPE** helps organizations power their edge-to-cloud platform with proven, workload-optimized products, solutions, and services. Our leading supercomputing technologies enable customers to transform and modernize their IT infrastructure, solve complex problems and support new business opportunities with purpose-built infrastructure and software. Join us redefine what’s next for you.

**What you'll do:**

  

* Manages and leads a program involving multiple functions and project teams to drive the engineering development and implementation process for a product or service offering.
* Develops and directs development of schedules, critical deliverables, budget, resource allocation plan, and other support requirements for assigned program.

5c60d19e.title: Principal Technical Program Manager
5c60d19e.description:
Works with management and stakeholders to align priorities and goals using technical know-how in a fundamental engineering area or technical domain. Establishes scope and milestones for each aspect of a technical program, aligning to the broader program plan and company strategies and goals. Manages technical programs and complex, cross-organizational initiatives impacting products and business. Manages highly complex issues, bottlenecks and/or risks, escalating issues when appropriate. Leads technical program improvement, implementing best practices and driving cross-team process optimizations to improve processes. Leads efforts to integrate continuous improvement within technical programs, driving insights across many workstreams to generate recommendations that deliver operational efficiencies. Facilitates collaboration across multiple teams, driving technical discussions that align priorities and program goals. Provides technical expertise, direction and mentorship to cross-functional teams. Creates and automates reporting, partnering with development teams to continue improving reports, dashboards, forecasts, and models to help manage technical program execution. Acts as a technical liaison with or between stakeholder teams, driving effective collaboration for customer success within Oracle commitments.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

**Technical Management and Execution - Technical Management:**

– Leverages technical knowledge to identify risks, manage scope, estimate program timelines, request feasibility, testing requirements, and determine appropriate resources.

– Ensures that product or service delivery meets the third party, security, export, and accessibility compliance requirements.

– Drives rapid response to security escalations, coordinating across teams and communicating to executives to assess risk, determine mitigation strategies, and align and execute optimal proposed path to resolution.

– Forecasts program demands and resourcing to identify risks and ensure that goals are achievable.

– Leads the development and implementation of evolving processes to ensure that organizational SLAs are met.

**Technical Management and Execution - Technical Strategy and Execution:**

– Utilizes technical knowledge to identify, track, and manage program dependencies and risks.

– Supports rapid response to escalations, coordinating within team and communicating to senior team members to assess risk, determine mitigation strategies, and execute the optimal proposed path to resolution.

– Supports planning by identifying dependencies and risks.

– Develops delivery standards and guidelines in alignment with Oracle best practices.

– Identifies and quantifies opportunities for process automations and advocates for prioritization.

– Contributes to incident management efforts and identifies opportunities to improve processes, as applicable.

**Program Oversight - Strategy and Decision-Making:**

– Aligns priorities with customers, service, and stakeholder teams through regular reporting to senior leadership.

– Establishes scope and milestones for each program, aligning to the broader program plan and company strategies and goals.

– Assists in defining key performance indicators (KPIs) and measurement methods for program performance against established goals (e.g., scope, timelines, deliverable quality).

– Builds, maintains, and executes a clear communication strategy of objectives to partners and customers, influencing decision-making regarding best practices for Oracle systems.

**Program Oversight - Program and Operations Management:**

– Manages both technical and non-technical programs and complex, cross-organizational programs impacting products and business.

– Guides the work of program staff (e.g., development, release management, customer success) while providing technical support and direction on removing barriers, including risks and issues in workflows.

– Maintains comprehensive program documentation (e.g., status reports, program plans) and documents risks and issues.

– Ensures attention to detail in program management from planning to execution and reporting.

– Leads regular program status meetings and keeps teams and leadership informed.

– Leads initiatives within the team to improve operational efficiency and enhance adherence to service level agreements (SLAs) and productivity targets.

– Ensures ownership and accountability for forecasting program demands, funding, and resourcing.

– Guides the deployment of change management for programs, such as priority, scope, scheduling, or requirement changes.

**Program Oversight - Risk Management:**

– Manages highly complex issues, bottlenecks and/or risks, escalating issues when appropriate.

– Conducts comprehensive assessments of costs, benefits, and return on investment (ROI) to inform decision-making and risk mitigation strategies.

– Manages critical issues while making trade-offs between business needs and technical constraints.

– Removes blockers for the program and identifies new technical and resource options to efficiently deliver solutions and drive adoption.

**Process Efficiency - Process Optimization:**

– Leads program improvement, implementing best practices and driving cross-team process optimizations to improve processes.

– Organizes and develops program objectives and workflows, while testing and deploying cross-functional solutions to address critical business problems.

– Collaborates with management to initiate and maintain processes and procedures that guide and assist teams in reaching their goals.

**Process Efficiency - Continuous Improvement:**

– Leads efforts to integrate continuous improvement within programs, driving insights across many workstreams to generate recommendations that deliver operational efficiencies.

– Develops and standardizes data-driven decision-making frameworks, ensuring insights drive efficiencies.

– Identifies and addresses gaps to facilitate business-critical improvements to the solution's availability and reliability.

– Iterates processes based on feedback and KPIs, analyzing results through retrospectives.

– Defines requirements and configurations of existing and new development tools, where applicable.

**Collaboration and Program Leadership - Cross Functional Collaboration:**

– Facilitates collaboration across multiple teams, driving discussions that align priorities and program goals.

– Leads medium-scale efforts to optimize processes, identifying and implementing solutions that enhance team efficiency.

– Delivers program updates, risks, and opportunities to managers and leadership, influencing decision-making.

– Develops relationships with key stakeholders, ensuring their perspectives are integrated into program planning and execution.

**Collaboration and Program Leadership - Program Leadership:**

– Leads programs to continuously improve organizational efficiency.

– Provides technical direction and mentorship to cross-functional teams.

– Influences and guides change at all levels of the group from initiation through delivery.

– Ensures that the program team and other stakeholders are aligned with the program goals and motivated, identifying and addressing conflicts and issues.

**Data and Analysis:**

– Creates and automates reporting, partnering with development teams to continue improving reports, dashboards, forecasts, and models to help manage program execution.

– Utilizes data to solve moderately complex problems impacting the success of the program(s), including adherence to SLAs.

– Conducts analysis on a small number of data sources with moderate complexity, which may include competitive analysis, trend analysis, and KPI analysis, to drive data-informed decisions to support the program goals, presenting findings with immediate teams stakeholders.

**Stakeholder Engagement:**

– Acts as a liaison with or between stakeholder teams, driving effective collaboration for customer success within Oracle commitments.

– Manages relationships with internal and external stakeholders to align program priorities and commitments.

– Identifies and documents stakeholder needs and works cross-functionally to implement solutions that enhance satisfaction.

– Identifies risks to customer satisfaction and advocates for improvements or mitigation.

– Assesses risks to customer satisfaction and evaluates mitigation efforts, providing solutions to the immediate team and related teams to ensure alignment on resolving these risks.

– Helps balance team priorities and Oracle commitments to ensure optimal coverage and response to key customer needs, minimizing risks to the program.

**Core Responsibilities**

**Planning & Execution:**

– Manages and coordinates moderately complex tasks, monitoring timelines and deliverables to ensure timely completion and adherence to requirements for a moderately sized project or initiative. Efficiently delegates, monitors, and prioritizes work across multiple projects, providing technical oversight and adjusting plans to address shifts in resources or timelines.

**Collaboration & Partnership:**

– Collaborates across the organization to align on expectations and achieve shared objectives. Leverages understanding of business leaders, stakeholders, and/or customers to ensure proposed solutions meet their needs. Supports inclusivity by actively seeking and listening to diverse perspectives, ensuring others feel heard and respected.

Proactively escalates unresolved or critical issues with a thorough assessment and suggests potential solutions. Reviews, contributes to, and documents problem solving strategies.

**Continuous Learning:**

Proactively seeks and leverages ongoing feedback and training to improve skills. Coaches and mentors junior team members, fostering continuous learning and knowledge sharing within and across teams.

348dbbb2.description:
**Job Description**

Position Vice President – Trade Finance Solutions

Experience 10–15 years

Grade- VP Location Mumbai

Project-Fuel

**Mandatory**
-MBA-Tier 1

About FuEL

FuEL is Intellect's Flagship program designed to develop the next generation of transformation leaders for the global Fintech/Insuretech industry. Created for high-potential professionals, the program equips participants to help financial institutions reimagine business models, accelerate digital and AI transformation, and deliver exceptional customer experiences.

**The Opportunity**

This role is for a Trade Finance leader who combines deep domain expertise with hands-on technology and process experience. You will shape solution propositions for banks, actively demonstrate Intellect’s Trade Finance capabilities, and work closely with Engineering and Delivery to evolve the solution in response to market needs and client requirements. The role spans consultative engagement, product solutioning, sales support, and ongoing product

development—not just domain advisory or relationship management.

You will engage business, product, operations, and technology leaders to understand their objectives, diagnose process and business challenges, and translate them into practical, differentiated solutions. You should be equally comfortable leading a client workshop, running a product demonstration, developing a solution approach, and working with internal teams on the changes needed to deliver it.

**Role Definition**

The Vice President – Trade Finance Solutions owns domain-led solutioning and supports growth across Intellect’s Trade Finance portfolio. The role combines customer discovery, process analysis and reengineering, product demonstrations, solution design, bid support, and collaboration with Product, Engineering and Delivery to ensure that proposed solutions are credible, differentiated, feasible, and aligned with customer needs.

**Key Responsibilities**

● 1. Prospect Understanding and Process Reengineering: Engage bank and financial-institution executives, business heads, product owners, operations and technology leaders to understand business models, workflows, pain points and strategic priorities. Analyse existing processes and identify opportunities for simplification, automation, control improvement and business transformation.

● 2. Domain Expertise and Solutioning: Apply strong Trade Finance knowledge to translate business requirements

into practical solution propositions. Map customer processes and requirements to product capabilities, identify

gaps, distinguish standard product functionality from client-specific changes, and define appropriate solution options, assumptions and dependencies.

● 3. Product Demonstrations and Client Workshops: Personally lead high-quality demonstrations of Intellect’s Trade

Finance solution across the trade lifecycle, solution walkthroughs, discovery workshops, use-case discussions, proof-of-concept sessions and technical/business presentations. Tailor demonstrations to the prospect’s requirements and articulate business value, product capabilities and competitive differentiation.

● 4. Solution Design and Proposal Development: Develop customer-specific solution approaches, scope documents, functional solution notes, implementation considerations, effort-estimation inputs, assumptions, exclusions and proposal content. Ensure that proposed solutions are commercially sound, implementable and aligned with the client’s objectives.

● 5. RFP/RFI and Deal Support: Lead or contribute to RFPs, RFIs, questionnaires, bid responses and presentations. Work with Sales and Pre-sales teams to qualify opportunities, articulate value propositions, address objections and support deal progression and closure.

● 6. Product and Engineering Collaboration: Work hands-on with Product, Business Analysts, Engineering, Architecture and QA teams to assess requirements, clarify business rules, prioritize enhancements and guide solution changes. Participate in solution reviews and relevant agile ceremonies; help ensure that requirements and acceptance criteria are clear and that changes address the underlying business need.

● 7. Delivery and Implementation Collaboration: Partner with Delivery, Implementation and Support teams to validate feasibility, integrations, dependencies, customization needs, effort assumptions and delivery risks. Support transition from sales to delivery and help resolve domain or solution issues during implementation where required.

● 8. Market and Customer Feedback Loop: Capture feedback from prospects, clients, demonstrations, implementations and competitive situations. Convert insights into actionable recommendations for product enhancements, roadmap priorities, solution assets and market positioning.

● 9. Commercial and Market Development: Support new sales, cross-sell and upsell across new and existing accounts. Engage senior stakeholders, contribute to pipeline development, and build trusted-advisor relationships

by connecting domain knowledge and technology capabilities to measurable business outcomes.

● 10. Sales Enablement and Knowledge Management: Develop and maintain reusable demo flows, solution notes, product collateral, proposal content, case studies, FAQs and competitive insights. Enable Sales, Pre-sales,

Product and Delivery teams through knowledge sharing and product training.

● 11. Innovation and Industry Awareness: Track market, regulatory and technology developments relevant to Trade Finance, including opportunities to apply AI and automation. Recommend practical enhancements and differentiated capabilities based on client needs and competitive trends.

**Experience and Qualifications**

● Extensive experience in Trade Finance, with a strong track record in one or more of technology development, technology sales, pre-sales/solution consulting, product consulting, business analysis, process transformation or implementation roles. Domain knowledge alone, without meaningful process or technology solutioning experience, is not sufficient.

● Deep working knowledge of Letters of Credit, Guarantees, Documentary Collections, Open Account, trade loans/financing, amendments, limits, document handling, settlement and reporting, plus relevant SWIFT/ICC and regulatory requirements, with the ability to understand end-to-end business processes, operating models, controls, products and client-specific requirements.

● Demonstrated experience in process analysis, reengineering or transformation, and translating business challenges into functional/technology solutions for banks or financial institutions.

● Proven ability to personally conduct product demonstrations, lead customer discovery and workshops, explain solution design, and respond confidently to business and technology questions from senior stakeholders.

● Experience working directly with Product, Engineering, Architecture and Delivery teams to define requirements, evaluate feasibility, shape enhancements and support implementation.

● Strong commercial acumen and experience contributing to complex sales pursuits, RFP/RFI responses, solution proposals, executive presentations and deal conversion.

● Excellent communication, presentation and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to engage CXOs, business leaders, operations teams and technology stakeholders.

● Experience in banking technology, fintech or financial-services transformation is strongly preferred. Familiarity with agile product development and APIs/integrations is an advantage.

● Bachelor’s degree required; MBA or equivalent post-graduate qualification preferred.

**Why This Role**

You will work at the intersection of banking domain expertise, process transformation and technology—helping financial institutions solve real business problems while shaping the evolution of Intellect’s Trade Finance solutions.

The role offers direct customer exposure and the opportunity to influence solution design, product enhancements, sales outcomes and successful delivery.

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and

. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

9ff2fe58.title: Solution Architect - Senior
9ff2fe58.description:
The Solution Architect – Senior is responsible for defining and developing solution architectures that align with enterprise architecture strategies, principles, policies, standards, and business requirements. This role evaluates and applies solution designs for specific systems in collaboration with project and product teams and ensures solutions meet business, technical, security, governance, compliance, scalability, and performance requirements. The role involves translating complex business and technical requirements into scalable solution designs, evaluating multiple architectural options, conducting cost-benefit analysis, and recommending optimized solutions. The Solution Architect – Senior also stays current with emerging technologies and supports pilots and proof-of-concept initiatives to validate new technology capabilities.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Define solution and system architectures in alignment with enterprise architecture strategies, standards, reference architectures, and technology principles.
* Decompose systems into components, perform functional allocation, and establish interfaces between systems and system components.
* Develop and evaluate multiple solution options, conduct cost-benefit analysis, and recommend optimized solutions based on business and technical requirements.
* Design scalable architecture solutions for cloud-based platforms, enterprise applications, data and analytics platforms, and integrated systems.
* Develop and maintain architecture deliverables, including conceptual and logical models, solution diagrams, architecture patterns, and technical documentation.
* Apply enterprise architecture standards, frameworks, technology stacks, architecture patterns, and reference models to solution designs.
* Architect and integrate enterprise applications, data platforms, APIs, and other technology systems to deliver end-to-end solutions.
* Translate complex business requirements, industry requirements, and governance considerations into practical and scalable technical solutions.
* Ensure solution designs address security, governance, compliance, performance, scalability, buildability, and operational requirements.
* Collaborate with project, product, engineering, data, security, and business teams to drive successful solution development and delivery.
* Provide technical leadership and influence architecture decisions across cross-functional teams and stakeholders.
* Facilitate and support pilots, proof-of-concept activities, and technology evaluations to validate emerging technologies and architectural approaches.
* Analyze infrastructure and technology capacity and provide recommendations to support current and future business needs.
* Maintain awareness of emerging technologies, software trends, tools, and industry practices and assess their applicability to business solutions.
* Support the adoption of Agile, DevSecOps, CI/CD, automation, and modern software delivery practices.
* Identify, assess, and manage technical risks and issues and drive appropriate mitigation actions.
* Build strong relationships with customers, business stakeholders, technology teams, and peers to promote effective solution development and delivery.
* Apply effective Business Relationship Management practices to ensure technology solutions deliver measurable business value.
* Drive changes in technical architecture and standards into solution designs when business or technology needs evolve.

**Mandatory Skills**

* Enterprise Architecture and Solution Design
* Cloud Architecture – AWS, Azure, or GCP
* Solution and System Architecture
* Strong proficiency in Python and SQL
* Data Architecture, Data Modeling, Data Warehousing, ETL, and Data Pipeline Design
* System Integration and API Architecture
* Enterprise Application Architecture
* Analytics and AI/ML Platform Architecture
* Machine Learning Lifecycle Management / MLOps
* CI/CD, Build Automation, and Version Control
* Security, Governance, and Compliance in Architecture Design
* Architecture Documentation, Design Patterns, and Reference Architectures
* Stakeholder Management and Technical Leadership
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and influencing skills

**Preferred Skills And Experience**

* Experience with IoT technologies and connected systems.
* Experience with Agile software development methodologies.
* Knowledge of DevSecOps practices and automation frameworks.
* Experience with cost optimization and performance engineering.
* Experience architecting and integrating complex enterprise systems and data platforms.
* Experience designing AI/ML-enabled solutions and modern analytics platforms.
* Experience with agentic lifecycle management / AIOps.
* Familiarity with architecture frameworks, enterprise technology reference models, and architecture governance.
* Experience working with cross-functional and geographically distributed teams.

**Nice to Have**

* Hands-on experience with Databricks, Snowflake, or Neo4j.
* Experience designing Azure-native solutions.
* Familiarity with ML frameworks such as TensorFlow and PyTorch.
* Knowledge of advanced analytics, predictive modeling, and AI-driven decision systems.
* Experience with IoT and connected product ecosystems.
* Experience with modern cloud-native application and data platform architectures.

**Experience**

* Intermediate to advanced experience in solution architecture, enterprise systems, cloud architecture, or a related technical discipline.
* Demonstrated experience designing architectures for cloud-based platforms and enterprise applications.
* Proven ability to translate complex business requirements into scalable, secure, and sustainable technical solutions.
* Experience designing enterprise data, analytics, AI/ML, and integration solutions.
* Experience architecting integrations across enterprise applications, APIs, and data platforms.
* Experience developing solution designs, architecture models, technical documentation, and reference patterns.
* Experience evaluating technology options and recommending solutions based on technical feasibility, business value, cost, performance, and scalability.
* Experience leading or influencing cross-functional technical teams and architecture decisions.
* Experience managing technical risks, issues, dependencies, and architectural trade-offs.
* Experience working in Agile and/or DevSecOps environments is preferred.

**Key Competencies**

* Balances Stakeholders
* Collaborates Effectively
* Communicates Effectively
* Decision Quality
* Persuades and Influences
* Strategic Mindset
* Change Management
* Values Differences
* Architecture System Design
* Solution Design
* Solution Functional Fit Analysis
* System Solution Architecture
* Project Issue and Risk Management
* Technical Leadership
* Business Relationship Management

**Qualifications**

* College, university, or equivalent degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or another relevant technical discipline.
* Relevant equivalent experience may be considered in place of a formal degree.
* Strong understanding of enterprise and solution architecture principles, methodologies, and frameworks.
* Strong understanding of cloud-based platforms and enterprise application architecture.
* Ability to analyze complex business and technical requirements and translate them into scalable solution architectures.
* Strong understanding of data, analytics, AI/ML, integration, security, governance, and enterprise technology concepts.
* This position may require licensing or compliance with applicable export controls or sanctions regulations.

556c26d8.title: Sr. Solutions Architect - Workday
556c26d8.description:
**Company Overview**
At Zuora, we do Modern Business. We’re helping people subscribe to new ways of doing business that are better for people, companies and ultimately the planet. It’s an approach resulting from the shift to the Subscription Economy that puts customers first by building recurring relationships instead of one-time product sales and focuses on sustainable growth. Through our leading expertise and multi-product suite, we are transforming all industries and working with the world’s most innovative companies to monetize new business models, nurture subscriber relationships and optimize their digital experiences.
  
  
**THE TEAM & ROLE**
Zuora’s Corporate Operations organization serves as the backbone of our internal technology ecosystem, building digital experiences that connect teams, align business priorities, and strengthen collaboration company-wide. Taking a cloud-first, AI-enabled approach, we empower our global ZEOs with modern tools and self-service solutions that drive productivity, scalability, and agility - all while upholding the highest standards of security and compliance.
  
  
Within Corporate Operations, the G&A Business Applications team designs, implements, and optimizes the systems that power all of Zuora's core General & Administrative functions, including Finance, FP&A, Procurement, ZEO Success (HR), and Legal. Reporting to the Senior Business Systems Manager of Digital Workplace Experience, this team works closely with system analysts, administrators, project managers, data architects, and developers to deliver robust, scalable business solutions.
  
  
The Sr, Solutions Architect - Finance Systems is a senior technical expert and data architect responsible for designing, building, and securing enterprise-grade data structures and integrations across our corporate systems ecosystem. This role functions as a critical cross-functional data and system integration specialist, ensuring seamless data flow, robust security governance, and scalable automation across diverse business platforms (e.g., Coupa, Workday, NetSuite, Navan, Lattice, Greenhouse, and more).
  
  
You’ll join a collaborative, high-performing team that values innovation, continuous improvement, and professional growth. Your work will directly impact the efficiency, quality, and scalability of Zuora’s enterprise systems and digital transformation initiatives.
  
  
**YOUR MISSION**
As a senior technical anchor supporting all G&A functions, the Sr, Solutions Architect - Finance Systems collaborates closely with leaders across Finance, FP&A, Procurement, ZEO Success, and Legal to establish a cohesive enterprise data architecture. You will build robust system integrations and leverage cutting-edge AI frameworks to drive efficiency, maximize data reliability, and enforce strict compliance across all internal platforms in alignment with strategic goals.
  
  
**YOUR OPPORTUNITY**
As the Sr, Solutions Architect - Finance Systems, you will play a vital role in the development, data architecture, and integration of Finance, FP&A, Procurement, ZEO Success, and Legal systems. Combining your expertise as a data architect and multi-platform integration specialist, you’ll ensure seamless data flow, scalable automation, and cross-system reliability without being tied to a single core vendor. You’ll work closely with functional BSAs to prioritize initiatives, refine user stories, and deliver enhancements through agile sprints, while supporting testing and deployment activities.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities Include**

* Lead integration support and comprehensive data architecture across core Finance, FP&A, Procurement, ZEO Success, and Legal business systems, ensuring cross-platform data consistency and process efficiency.
* Define and maintain end-to-end data models, data lineage, and integration patterns across all G&A applications, establishing a unified "single source of truth" bridging corporate finance, workforce analytics, and legal operations.
* Design, build, and optimize secure, high-performing API-based integrations, microservices, and file-based data flows (REST API, Webhooks, OAuth 2.0, SQL) across Coupa, Workday, NetSuite, Navan, Lattice, Greenhouse, and more tools.
* Architect and implement AI-driven automation workflows; evaluate and integrate AI productivity tools and emerging standard frameworks—such as Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers—to safely expose internal tools and secure data layers to AI agents.
* Enforce strict data security policies, field-level encryption, masking, and access controls across integrated systems to protect sensitive workforce metrics (ZEO Success/PII), legal records, and financial data.
* Collaborate with cross-functional BSAs, business cross functional teams, and security teams using RACI frameworks to clearly map out data ownership, system accountability, and technical execution roles across different departments.
* Ensure configuration standards, technical architecture diagrams, and SOPs are up to date and fully compliant with internal controls, SOX, and global privacy standards (GDPR/CCPA).

**OUR TECH STACK:**
REST API, Webhooks, OAuth 2.0, SQL, JavaScript/Python, Coupa, Workday, NetSuite, Navan, Lattice, Greenhouse, AI Automation Tools, and MCP Server frameworks.
  
  
**What You’ll Accomplish**

* Deliver Modern Data Architecture: Transition fragmented cross-system data points from disparate G&A tools into a beautifully mapped out, resilient, and highly secure enterprise data model.
* Excellence in System Integrations: Establish scalable, automated data connections that allow Finance, FP&A, Procurement, HR, and Legal tools to communicate without operational friction, keeping sync latencies low and reliability high.
* Next-Gen Tech Adoption: Successfully implement secure AI extensions or MCP servers to optimize everyday business workflows and scale manual reporting processes down to self-service models.
* Advance Automation & Data Reliability: Develop solutions that strengthen data accuracy, eliminate manual tasks, reduce operational overhead, and increase system reliability across end-to-end business workflows.
* Promote Secure & Compliant Operations: Collaborate with IT, Security, and Audit teams to uphold field-level data protection, access controls, and strict compliance (SOX/GDPR) across all integration data layers.
* Establish Sustainable System Practices: Maintain clear documentation, SOPs, and configuration standards to ensure long-term scalability and consistent cross-functional operational excellence.

**What You’ll Need To Be Successful**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Architecture, or a related technical field (or equivalent practical experience).
* 8+ years of experience in system integrations and backend development (Proficient in REST APIs, SQL, JavaScript/Python, OAuth, and web services).
* Deep hands-on exposure to data structures and integration patterns within modern G&A systems—specifically covering tools across Procurement (Coupa), HR/ATS (Workday, Lattice, Greenhouse), and ERP/Expense (NetSuite, Navan).
* Proven understanding of LLM application patterns, AI integration tools, and modular protocol concepts like Model Context Protocol (MCP).
* Solid understanding of data security standards, encryption practices, access control models, and IT/SOX compliance frameworks required when handling sensitive employee, financial, and legal records.
* Strong familiarity with project governance frameworks, including using RACI matrices to clarify cross-team responsibilities.
* Exceptional cross-functional collaboration and communication skills; the ability to elegantly translate complex technical and data architecture blueprints to functional business partners across completely different business disciplines.

**#ZEOLife at Zuora**
As an industry pioneer, our work is constantly evolving and challenging us in new ways that require us to think differently, iterate often and learn constantly—it’s exciting. Our people, whom we refer to as “ZEOs" are empowered to take on a mindset of ownership and make a bigger impact here. Our teams collaborate deeply, exchange different ideas openly and together we’re making what’s next possible for our customers, community and the world.
  
  
As Part Of Our Commitment To Building An Inclusive, High-performance Culture Where ZEOs Feel Inspired, Connected And Valued, We Support ZEOs With
  
  
Competitive compensation, corporate bonus program and performance rewards, company equity and retirement programs
  
  
Medical, dental and vision insurance
  
  
Generous, flexible time off
  
  
Paid holidays, “wellness” days and company wide end of year break
  
  
Learning & Development stipend
  
  
Opportunities to volunteer and give back, including charitable donation match
  
  
Free resources and support for your mental wellbeing
  
  

* Specific benefits offerings may vary by country and can be viewed in more detail during your interview process.

Location & Work Arrangements
  
  
Organizations and teams at Zuora are empowered to design efficient and flexible ways of working, being intentional about scheduling, communication, and collaboration strategies that help us achieve our best results. In our dynamic, globally distributed company, this means balancing flexibility and responsibility — flexibility to live our lives to the fullest, and responsibility to each other, to our customers, and to our shareholders. For most roles, we offer the flexibility to work both remotely and at Zuora offices.
  
  
Our Commitment to an Inclusive Workplace
  
  
Think, be and do you! At Zuora, different perspectives, experiences and contributions matter. Everyone counts. Zuora is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to creating an inclusive environment for all.
  
  
Zuora does not discriminate on the basis of, and considers individuals seeking employment with Zuora without regards to, race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.
  
  
We encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply. Applicants in need of special assistance or accommodation during the interview process or in accessing our website may contact us by sending an email to assistance@zuora.com.

d72ebe3d.title: Principle Integration Solution Architect
d72ebe3d.description:
**About Us**
Dyson is a global technology company powered by ingenuity and relentless curiosity. We reimagine everyday products through radical innovation—from vacuums and hair care to air purification and robotics. Our teams thrive on challenge and continuous improvement.
  
  
As we expand into new markets, our technology function is central to Dyson’s future—ensuring every solution scales securely and delivers best-in-class experiences for millions of people. Here, architecture isn’t just about systems. It’s about unleashing ideas, shaping outcomes, and making a real difference.
  
  
Join a community that celebrates disruption, values diverse perspectives, and empowers you to lead at the edge of possibility.
  
  
**About The Role**
As a Principle Integration Solution Architect, you’ll be a senior technical leader within Dyson’s Solution Architecture team, reporting to the Head of Solution Architecture. You’ll set the direction for enterprise integration and interface solutions across a varied technology landscape, lead architects and engineers through complex delivery, and ensure our integration capabilities support Dyson’s global growth.
  
  
You’ll own integration solution architecture from discovery through delivery, designing secure, reusable interfaces across APIs, events, messaging, data exchange and batch or file-based patterns. Supporting communication across platforms including SAP Commerce, Salesforce, Adobe, SAP and other enterprise services, you’ll turn complex requirements into pragmatic roadmaps and high-quality solutions that deliver measurable outcomes.
  
  
Beyond individual solution design, you’ll provide technical leadership across the integration community: chairing design reviews, guiding delivery teams, coaching architects and engineers, and raising standards through clear governance. You’ll champion appropriate integration patterns, reusable assets, automation, observability and responsible innovation across MuleSoft and other integration technologies, while communicating trade-offs and recommendations confidently to senior technical and business stakeholders.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Define and evolve Dyson’s enterprise integration strategy, reference architecture, standards and roadmap across integration technologies – owning and running our Integration Centre of Excellence.
* Lead solution architecture for complex integration initiatives from discovery and options assessment through implementation and operational handover.
* Design scalable interfaces using the most appropriate patterns, including APIs, events, messaging, data synchronization, managed file transfer and batch integration.
* Establish reusable patterns and assets for security, error handling, logging, monitoring, data transformation, versioning and lifecycle management.
* Lead architecture and design reviews, challenge constructively, document key decisions and ensure solutions comply with enterprise, security and data standards.
* Provide technical direction to architects, engineers, partners and suppliers; remove ambiguity, resolve complex design issues and maintain delivery quality.
* Coach and mentor others through pairing, design critique and knowledge sharing, building a strong and inclusive integration engineering community.
* Partner with business and technology stakeholders to translate outcomes and non-functional requirements into pragmatic architecture decisions and delivery plans.
* Drive the reliability, performance and cost effectiveness of integration services through observability, capacity planning, automation and continual improvement.
* Manage architectural risks, dependencies and technical debt, escalating decisions clearly and supporting delivery against agreed scope, quality and timelines.

**About You**

* Prerequisite: significant hands-on experience designing and delivering enterprise integrations using MuleSoft Any point Platform in complex, large-scale environments.
* Broad knowledge of enterprise integration patterns, including RESTful and asynchronous APIs, event-driven integration, messaging, data transformation, managed file transfer, batch processing and hybrid integration.
* Practical experience across relevant MuleSoft capabilities such as Any point Design Center, API Manager, Exchange, Runtime Manager and Cloud Hub or equivalent runtime models.
* Experience selecting and applying appropriate integration technologies and patterns based on business outcomes, architecture principles and non-functional requirements.
* A strong grasp of security, identity, resilience, performance, observability, CI/CD and automated testing for integration solutions.
* Proven leadership of architects and engineers, including setting direction, delegating effectively, providing constructive challenge and developing others.
* Experience governing solution designs and working with delivery partners or suppliers to achieve consistent engineering standards and outcomes.
* The judgement to balance strategic architecture with pragmatic delivery, making clear decisions when requirements are incomplete or priorities compete.
* Confident communication with senior stakeholders, with the ability to explain complex technical choices, risks and trade-offs in accessible language.
* Experience integrating major enterprise platforms such as Salesforce, SAP, Adobe or comparable applications.
* Experience in migrating integration platforms.
* MuleSoft certification is desirable; equivalent evidence of deep MuleSoft expertise will also be considered.
* A collaborative, inclusive and improvement-focused leadership style, with curiosity about automation, AI and emerging integration approaches.

Dyson is an equal opportunity employer. We know that great minds don’t think alike, and it takes all kinds of minds to make our technology so unique. We welcome applications from all backgrounds and employment decisions are made without regard to race, colour, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, protected veteran status or other any other dimension of diversity.

638a94f7.title: Multiple Opportunity For Architects.
638a94f7.description:
**1. Job Description Senior Architect**

**Location:** Thane & Vikhroli, Mumbai  
**Experience:** 12-15 Years  
**CTC:** Up to 32 LPA  
**Industry:** Real Estate / Property Development  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time  
**Joining:** Immediate / Short Notice Preferred

Job Overview

We are looking for an experienced Senior Architect with a strong background in real estate development, particularly in residential, PMAY (Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana), and affordable housing projects. The candidate should have experience in architectural design, planning, consultant coordination, construction documentation, and end-to-end project execution.

Key Responsibilities

* Lead architectural design and planning for residential, PMAY, and affordable housing projects.
* Prepare, review, and manage architectural layouts, plans, elevations, sections, working drawings, GFC drawings, and construction details.
* Coordinate with structural, MEP, landscape, liaison, and other consultants, along with project managers, contractors, and site teams.
* Ensure compliance with building codes, development regulations, project specifications, and quality standards.
* Monitor site execution, conduct site visits, and resolve design and construction-related issues.
* Review and approve drawings prepared by junior architects and ensure timely issuance of accurate, updated drawings.
* Support design optimization, value engineering, statutory documentation, and effective resource utilization.
* Lead and mentor junior architects while ensuring project timelines and design intent are maintained.

  

**Qualifications & Required Skills**

* B.Arch / M.Arch from a recognized institution.
* 12-15 years of relevant architectural experience, preferably with a real estate developer.
* Strong residential project experience; PMAY / affordable housing exposure is strongly preferred.
* Expertise in working drawings, GFC drawings, construction detailing, residential planning, and execution coordination.
* Proficiency in AutoCAD; knowledge of Revit and SketchUp is an advantage.
* Strong team leadership, consultant coordination, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills.

  

**2. Job Description Junior Architect**

**Location:** Vikhroli, Mumbai  
**Experience:** 3-4 Years  
**CTC:** 7-8 LPA  
**Industry:** Real Estate / Property Development  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time  
**Joining:** Immediate / Short Notice Preferred

  

**Job Overview**

We are looking for a Junior Architect to support architectural design, drawing development, documentation, and project coordination for residential, PMAY, and affordable housing projects. Candidates with experience in a real estate developer or property development company will be preferred.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

* Prepare and modify architectural layouts, plans, elevations, sections, working drawings, and construction details using AutoCAD.
* Assist in design development, presentation drawings, GFC drawings, and project documentation.
* Coordinate with structural, MEP, and other consultants, along with contractors, vendors, and site teams.
* Conduct site visits, verify site conditions, and resolve drawing and execution-related discrepancies.
* Assist with statutory approval drawings, project submissions, and construction documentation.
* Ensure drawing accuracy, timely revisions, and compliance with approved designs and project requirements.
* Maintain drawing registers, revision records, and documentation.
* Support senior architects in design coordination and timely project delivery.

  

**Qualifications & Required Skills**

* B.Arch / Bachelor's degree in Architecture from a recognized institution.
* 3-4 years of relevant experience in architectural design, documentation, and coordination.
* Strong working knowledge of AutoCAD and good knowledge of SketchUp.
* Understanding of architectural plans, elevations, sections, GFC drawings, and construction detailing.
* Knowledge of residential construction and real estate development processes.
* PMAY / affordable housing exposure and familiarity with Mumbai/MMR development regulations are preferred.
* Strong communication, coordination, and problem-solving skills.

  

**3. Job Description Architect (Junior & Senior Levels)**

**Location:** Andheri, Mumbai  
**Experience:** 3-16 Years, depending on designation  
**CTC:** 6-14 LPA  
**Industry:** Architecture / Commercial Real Estate / Design Consultancy  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time

  

**Job Overview**

We are seeking Architects at Junior and Senior levels with experience in commercial and mixed-use projects. Responsibilities include design development, architectural drawing management, construction documentation, and coordination with clients, consultants, vendors, project managers, and site teams.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

* Understand client requirements and develop feasibility studies, design concepts, and architectural proposals.
* Prepare and manage schematic designs, layouts, elevations, sections, working drawings, and detailed construction drawings.
* Select appropriate materials and prepare material boards and design presentations.
* Ensure drawing accuracy, compliance with applicable building codes and project requirements, and timely delivery of project documentation.
* Coordinate with clients, project managers, structural and MEP consultants, vendors, and site teams.
* Conduct site visits to monitor progress, resolve design-related issues, and ensure execution aligns with the approved design intent.
* Manage drawing revisions and coordinate deliverables from the design stage through construction documentation.
* Senior Architects will lead and mentor architectural teams, review drawings, manage project deliverables, and oversee design quality and execution coordination.

  

**Qualifications & Required Skills**

* B.Arch / five-year Bachelor's degree in Architecture from a recognized institution.
* Proficiency in AutoCAD, Google SketchUp, and MS Office.
* Strong understanding of architectural design, working drawings, construction detailing, building regulations, and consultant coordination.
* Good communication, project management, and problem-solving skills.
* Experience in architectural consultancy, particularly commercial and mixed-use projects, is preferred.

  

**Experience Requirements**

**Junior Architect**

* 3-7 years of experience in an architectural consultancy firm.
* Commercial and mixed-use project exposure preferred.
* Ability to support design development, drawing preparation, and project coordination.

**Senior Architect**

* 10-16 years of overall architectural experience, including at least 6 years in commercial or mixed-use projects.
* Prior experience leading an architectural team.
* Must have completed at least one project of 300,000 sq. ft. or more from inception to completion.

  

**4. Job Description for Design Manager**

**Location:** Andheri, Mumbai  
**Experience:** 15-18 Years, including at least 10 years leading commercial or mixed-use projects  
**CTC:** Up to 30 LPA (including 10% PLI)  
**Reporting To:** Principal Director  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time | Monday to Friday

Job Overview

We are looking for an experienced Design Manager with a strong background in architectural consultancy and commercial/mixed-use projects. The candidate will lead large-scale architectural projects, manage design teams, strengthen client relationships, and contribute to business development, particularly in Bangalore and Chennai.

Key Responsibilities

* Lead multiple architectural projects from concept to completion, ensuring quality, timelines, and budget adherence.
* Manage and mentor a team of 8-10 senior architects, architects, and technicians.
* Strengthen existing client relationships, ensure client retention, and identify new business opportunities.
* Interpret client briefs and develop feasibility reports, design proposals, and innovative, functional, sustainable design solutions.
* Oversee schematic and working drawings, ensuring compliance with building codes, regulations, and company standards.
* Coordinate with structural and MEP consultants, vendors, and project managers during design and execution.
* Manage client communication, site coordination, periodic site visits, and project progress reporting.

  

**Qualifications & Requirements**

* B.Arch or equivalent five-year Bachelor's degree in Architecture.
* Proficiency in AutoCAD, Revit, Google SketchUp, and MS Office.
* Minimum 15-18 years of experience in architectural consultancy, with at least 10 years leading commercial or mixed-use projects.
* Must have successfully completed at least **two full-cycle projects of a minimum of 1 million sq. ft. each**.
* Strong leadership, communication, client management, and multidisciplinary team coordination skills.
* Willingness to travel outstation for site visits, including stays exceeding two days.
* Flexibility to work extended hours when required to meet project deadlines.

  

**5. Draughtsman**

**Location:** Andheri, Mumbai  
**Experience:** 3-9 Years  
**Industry:** Architectural Consultancy  
**Project Type:** Commercial and Large-Scale Mixed-Use Projects.

**Lead Technical Program Manager, Fraud Technology**
is responsible for driving end-to-end technology governance, architectural alignment, and delivery execution for Citi’s Enterprise Fraud Prevention initiatives. In this role, you will serve as a technical authority navigating critical cross-functional dependencies across distributed engineering squads, data science teams, core platform services, and risk/compliance partners. You will blend deep systems acumen with executive presence and crisp, diplomatic communication to guide multi-million-dollar programs from architectural discovery through production rollout. This position requires an in-depth understanding of how sub-functional units integrate end-to-end, as well as the ability to coordinate across diverse groups to achieve broad organizational objectives.

**End-to-End Program Delivery & Strategic Roadmap Execution**

* Lead end-to-end technology planning, execution, and delivery governance across complex, mission-critical programs within Citi’s Fraud Technology Book of Work.
* Define, baseline, and track program milestones, critical paths, and deliverable commitments across multiple agile squads and hybrid legacy/modernized distributed platforms.
* Proactively manage complex cross-program dependencies, identifying technical bottlenecks, architectural conflicts, and resource constraints early to formulate and execute effective mitigation plans.
* Establish rigorous Definition of Done (DoD), release readiness criteria, and robust operational cutover strategies tailored for high-throughput, ultra-low-latency financial transaction systems.

**Architecture Alignment, Dependency Management & Systems Integration**

* Guide stakeholders and engineering squads through complex trade-off evaluations, balancing business priorities, customer experience, platform strategy, performance benchmarks, and long-term maintainability.
* Facilitate technical architecture reviews, interface design agreements (REST/SOAP APIs, Kafka/event-driven streaming), and binding cross-team integration contracts.

+ Automate the synthesis of complex technical discussions, action items, and Architectural Decision Records (ADRs).
+ Accelerate the generation of executive dashboards, release notes, and milestone variance analytics.
+ Standardize AI-driven delivery best practices, prompts, and reporting templates across participating engineering teams.

**Executive Presence & Stakeholder Communication**

+ Serve as the primary strategic liaison between engineering teams and executive leadership, articulating delivery health, technical trade-offs, blockers, and architectural risks with clarity, precision, and business context.

+ Author and deliver high-impact executive collateral (executive one-pagers, steering committee presentations, risk heatmaps) and crisp briefings to Senior Leadership (MD/C-suite level).

+ Strong technical fluency in modern software architecture patterns, including microservices, REST/SOAP APIs, event-driven architectures (Kafka/MQ), hybrid cloud/on-prem environments, and distributed database systems.
+ Experience coordinating cross-functional teams, managing dependencies, tracking critical-path milestones, and supporting vendor integrations in matrixed organizations.
+ Demonstrated ability to deliver complex technology initiatives from planning through production deployment.

a9ec8758.title: Technical Program Manager
a9ec8758.description:
**Join our India Tech Hub – Be among the first hires!**
Kobie, a 35-year veteran of the loyalty industry, a multi-year Forrester Leader, and USA Top Workplace is expanding its global footprint by establishing a Tech Hub in India. Kobie partners with global brands to build deep connections with their customers through personalized, data-driven loyalty experiences and has a mission of growing enterprise value through loyalty. The Tech Hub will serve as a Global Capabilities Center for a broad range of technology roles, and this is your chance to play a pivotal role in shaping our presence in India. Join us as we continue to lead in loyalty, delivering innovative customer experiences for some of the world’s most recognized brands while working alongside some of the best and brightest in loyalty.
  
  
**About The Team And What We’ll Build Together**
Kobie is seeking a dynamic and highly organized Technical Program Manager (TPM) to drive the successful execution of our product portfolio and optimize delivery across Data Science teams supporting our AI Product Set. The TPM plays a critical part in ensuring our Product and our Data Science teams operate efficiently, meet delivery goals, and align work with broader business objectives. The TPM is not a developer, but a process leader who is focused on driving innovation, improving operations, managing workflows, and enabling delivery through visibility, structure, and collaboration.
  
  
**About Kobie**
Named a Top Workplace in the USA and Top Remote Workplace, Kobie is where the best minds in loyalty come together, driven by passion and innovation. We’re always looking for talented individuals ready to join a collaborative, growth-focused culture.
  
  
As a trusted partner to some of the world’s most recognized brands, we are loyalty leaders, helping brands build lasting emotional connections with their consumers.  We do this with a strategy-led technology approach that uncovers the truth behind what drives consumers on an emotional level.As we launch our India Tech Hub, we are excited to bring our award-winning culture to a new region - creating an environment where collaboration, flexibility, and career growth come together to build something truly special.
  
  
We are proud to be the only loyalty provider to be externally recognized for their culture. We believe people thrive when they feel valued, supported, and empowered to be their authentic selves. Our commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion ensures every teammate has a voice and the opportunity to be heard.
  
  
Giving back is in our DNA at Kobie,through an annual fundraiser, charitable partnerships, and volunteer opportunities, we encourage our teammates to make a difference in their communities.
  
  
To support our teammates beyond just their careers, we offer highly competitive benefits, comprehensive health coverage, and well-being perks that support our teammates and their dependents. We understand the importance of time for life outside of work - recognizing public holidays,offering flexible time off, and prioritizing work-life balance.
  
  
As we expand into India, our new teammates will be fully integrated with our U.S. teams, working on global projects and gaining exposure to top industry leaders. With continued growth, we will establish a physical office in Bengaluru, India, giving teammates aspace for collaboration and fostering connection.
  
  
Now is the perfect time to join Kobie. Be part of something big and help shape the future of our global capabilities center, the Kobie India Tech Hub.
  
  
We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

35b9999e.title: Architect
35b9999e.description:
Thoughtful Natives Architects is a design practice dedicated to creating meaningful, sustainable, and human-centered architecture. We believe in thoughtful, context-sensitive design that enhances communities and the environment. Our work spans residential, commercial, and cultural projects, each approached with innovation, craftsmanship, and a deep respect for place. Job Description: We are seeking a talented and passionate Architect to join our collaborative studio. The ideal candidate will have strong design sensibilities, technical expertise, and a commitment to thoughtful, sustainable architecture. You will work closely with our team to develop innovative design solutions from concept through construction, ensuring projects align with our firm’s ethos of purposeful and enduring design. Key Responsibilities: - Lead and contribute to the design development of architectural projects across various scales and typologies. - Produce schematic designs, detailed drawings, 3D models, and construction documents using industry-standard software. - Collaborate with clients, consultants, and contractors to ensure design integrity and project success. - Conduct site visits, surveys, and construction administration to oversee project execution. - Research materials, building systems, and sustainable practices to integrate into design solutions. - Present design concepts to clients and stakeholders with clarity and confidence. - Mentor junior team members and contribute to a culture of creativity and excellence. We are currently seeking a BFS solution architect to join our team in India (hybrid/remote), reporting to the Global Head of BFS Solutions, Agentic AI and BPS.

At NTT DATA Services, we know that with the right people on board, anything is possible. We’re building the next era of Business Process Services—AI-native, agentic BPaaS that fuses deep process expertise with LLMs, AI agents, and data-first design. Join our founding team and reinvent how banks and financial services lend, serve, and grow, with AI native operations built to be faster, smarter, and more adaptive than anything the market has seen.

You will design AI native solutions for lending and banking operations within the BFS solutioning team. :

:
