7ed7abc4.title: Technical Program Manager, Stores Application Security
7ed7abc4.description:
**Description**
Amazon Application Security is looking for a security-focused Technical Program Manager who wants to make a difference and support Amazon builders to ensure that protecting customer data is at the forefront of all development.
  
  
Our team approaches security challenges with empathy and curiosity to help Amazon builders identify areas of improvement and learn how to navigate the highly dynamic space of application security. Amazon Application Security focuses on enabling our builders to provide a secure and trustworthy experience to our customers without compromising the overall customer experience.
  
  
In this role you will work directly with security teams and Amazon builders providing direct front line support and security expertise to Amazon teams.
  
  
You’ll also find this role will routinely challenge your background in technical product ownership, process development, operational and management skills, project management, critical thinking, relationship-building, and problem-solving. You’ll also find yourself challenged in unique ways when operating at the massive scale of Amazon, unique to a select few corporations in the world. You must be self-directed and open to new challenges, adept at prioritization, innovation, and collaborating with others.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Plan, organize, and manage all phases of the project lifecycle ensuring successful delivery. This includes defining success criteria, developing and managing project governance plans, project schedules, team goals, communication strategies and project milestones.
* Collaborate with internal customers (senior business leaders, development teams, application security engineering teams and other partner security teams) to understand their needs, their business and how we can improve their security posture.
* Architect and manage internal scope of work documents with the customer clearly defining success criteria and timelines. Hold all stakeholders accountable to these documents through the project lifecycle, escalating as necessary.
* Build and manage relationships with key internal stakeholders and security teams and while advocating on behalf of our customers to deliver on their security goals.
* Guide the evolution and adoption of internal security support solutions, at times with complex priorities, prioritizing the work most beneficial to Amazon builders.
* Use knowledge of software system design to scope architecture, review associated threat models, educate customers on potential severity of security findings and guide developer and security engineering teams through remediation.
* Define and implement best practice methods, processes, tools and continuous improvement initiatives aimed at scaling and increasing the efficiency of Amazon’s security guidance and builder support processes.
* Own the creation and delivery of business proposals (growth, new areas of focus, etc) and metrics to security leadership.
* Proactively identify and manage program risk, identifying paths to overcome risks, and escalating when necessary
* Work effectively and make sound decisions in a dynamic environment with changing priorities.
* Influence, negotiate, resolve conflicts and achieve results through others who are not direct reports.
* Foster a positive work environment leveraging existing skills in active listening, encouraging diverse perspectives and adapting to a variety of personality types.

**About The Team**
Diverse Experiences
  
  
Amazon Security values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  
  
Why Amazon Security
  
  
At Amazon, security is central to maintaining customer trust and delivering delightful customer experiences. Our organization is responsible for creating and maintaining a high bar for security across all of Amazon’s products and services. We offer talented security professionals the chance to accelerate their careers with opportunities to build experience in a wide variety of areas including cloud, devices, retail, entertainment, healthcare, operations, and physical stores.
  
  
Work/Life Balance
  
  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.
  
  
Inclusive Team Culture
  
  
In Amazon Security, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Ongoing DEI events and learning experiences inspire us to continue learning and to embrace our uniqueness. Addressing the toughest security challenges requires that we seek out and celebrate a diversity of ideas, perspectives, and voices.
  
  
Mentorship and Career growth
  
  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, training, and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 3+ years of technical product or program management experience
* 3+ years of project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management experience
* Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules
* 5+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience working with security teams

890e6ee9.title: Program Manager – Data Governance, LMAQ
890e6ee9.description:
**Description**
Amazon.com’s success is built on a foundation of customer obsession. Have you ever thought about what it takes to successfully deliver millions of packages to Amazon customers seamlessly every day like a clock work? To make that happen, behind those millions of packages, billions of decision get made by machines and humans. Last Mile Technology team make this happen. The Last Mile Analytics and Quality team (LMAQ) works within Last Mile Tech to bridge the automation gaps on problems where no technology exists or the tech solution is in the works. The team has an eco-system of quality specialists, program managers and BI Engineers working together to improve geo-spatial data quality and support the driver lifecycle & experience programs.
  
  
As the team expands, we need a Data Governance Framework to identify and eliminate data and information security risks (current and future). The program manager will define the framework working with the program and tech teams, benchmarking and adopting the best practices from different teams across Amazon. Individual will own the framework and conduct the audits at regular cadence.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
**The Successful Candidate Will**

* Be a custodian of the data usage risks when liaising with internal teams to help drive tools and process improvements that affect secure management workflows
* Proactively identify pain points and opportunities for continual secure process simplification and improvement to create program efficiencies
* Monitor existing metrics, analyze data, and partner with other internal teams (e.g., engineering, finance, Business Operations, technical operations, Business Intelligence, Product management, Partnership, legal & public policy) to identify process and system improvement opportunities.
* Create compliance frameworks for use of AI technologies enabling stakeholders to understand and implement compliance requirements.
* Conduct AI reviews and audits to identify risks and implement risk mitigation measures. Collaborate with stakeholders to implement risk mitigation measures and monitor risks.
* Monitor AI and Data privacy regulations and advise business leaders and tech teams on emerging regulatory challenges.
* Create and publish Data Privacy risk review reports for leaders detailing the risks, root causes, impacts, risk mitigation measures, action owners and risk closure timelines. Monitor all the identified risks.
* Work towards improving the data privacy risk review process, improving the quality of the risk register, and identifying opportunities for automation and tools improvements.
* Drive the "Data Governance Training and Awareness Program," in collaboration with LMAQ Learning & Development Team, providing data handling training and data security Do's and Don'ts to the employees.
* Provide privacy-by-design and AI use guidance to business teams creating new use cases for analyzing customer data.

cd38b6c8.title: ORACLE - Solution Architect
cd38b6c8.description:
**About The Role**
As an Oracle Solution Architect, you will make an impact by solutioning Oracle and Oracle AI opportunities and leading pre-sales for the EMEA region, shaping AI-enabled transformation propositions and translating business priorities into secure, scalable and value-led solution roadmaps. You will be a valued member of the Oracle Centre of Excellence for Global Growth Markets team and work collaboratively with Oracle SLS teams, market CP/CRMs, and clients.
  
  
In this role, you will
  
  

* Lead initial customer conversations for Oracle modernization and AI-enabled transformation, identifying priority business outcomes, high-value use cases and adoption considerations.
* Lead Oracle and AI readiness assessments to build a phased modernization roadmap covering applications, data, integration, cloud platform, security, governance and change adoption.
* Design differentiated Oracle solutions that embed AI into business workflows across ERP, HCM, SCM and CX, with clear value realization, architecture and delivery plans.
* Lead multi-disciplinary teams across Testing, Legacy Integrations, Cloud Enablement and Change Management as solution lead for RFPs, bringing Oracle AI capabilities and Cognizant accelerators to customer opportunities.
* Establish responsible AI and security-by-design guardrails covering identity and access, data privacy, model risk, prompt and output controls, auditability and regulatory requirements.

Work model
  
  
At Cognizant, we strive to provide flexibility wherever possible, and we are here to support a healthy work-life balance through our various wellbeing programs. Based on this role's business requirements, this is an onsite position requiring 3 days a week in a client or Cognizant office in Pan India.
  
  
The working arrangements for this role are accurate as of the date of posting. This may change based on the project you're engaged in, as well as business and client requirements. Rest assured; we will always be clear about role expectations.
  
  
What you must have to be considered
  
  

* Experience leading mid to large-size Oracle programs as a Solution Architect in transformation programs, with a deep understanding of the customer journey to Oracle and the various options available.
* Experience in pre-sales activities, including leading RFP/RFI responses as Solution Lead, and managing multiple streams within a program such as functional, integration, data migration and change management.
* Breadth of understanding of the overall Oracle landscape, interdependencies between modules and cross-functional integration, with strong awareness of the Oracle product roadmap and market trends across Fusion Cloud Applications, OCI, data platforms, generative AI and agentic AI.
* Hands-on understanding of Oracle Fusion Cloud embedded AI capabilities and Oracle AI Agent Studio, including agent design, orchestration, tools, security and lifecycle management.
* Working knowledge of OCI AI services and enterprise AI architecture patterns, including generative AI, retrieval-augmented generation, vector databases, APIs and integration services.

These will help you succeed
  
  

* Ability to act as a trusted advisor to customer program teams, represent Cognizant during Steering Committee meetings and engage with CXOs and department heads.
* Ability to assess AI use-case feasibility, data readiness, risk, operating model and total cost, and convert findings into a prioritized roadmap and business case.
* Experience defining responsible AI, security, privacy, compliance, observability and human-in-the-loop controls for enterprise solutions.
* Ability to create and present AI-enabled solution demonstrations, reference architectures and executive-level value propositions for business and technology stakeholders.
* Strong industry domain and process leadership skills, building trust in customer conversations.

We're excited to meet people who share our mission and can make an impact in a variety of ways. Don't hesitate to apply, even if you only meet the minimum requirements listed. Think about your transferable experiences and unique skills that make you stand out as someone who can bring new and exciting things to this role.

**Job Title: Architect (Junior)**

**Location:** Gurugram, Haryana (India)  
**Department:** Engineering  
**Reports To:** Yash Jain (yash.jain@jainallc.com)

**About Orchestra Life Sciences**

Orchestra Life Sciences, a leading technical consultancy, provides strategic support and scientific expertise to accelerate the development of pharmaceutical therapies for cancer and rare diseases. Specializing in nuclear medicine, radiation oncology, cell and gene therapies, regenerative medicines, and biotechnology, we offer unparalleled expertise to help clients navigate the complexities of these advanced therapeutic areas. By collaborating closely with our clients, we aim to speed time to market, driving innovation and ensuring the success of cutting-edge medical solutions. **To learn more about Orchestra Life Science, visit our website at www.orchestralifesciences.com**

**Position Summary**

**Role Overview**

A Junior Architect supports interior planning, layout design, and visual mockups for client/vendor facilities, including laboratory, manufacturing, and office environments. Working under the direction of senior design staff who guide the full concept-to-execution process, this role collaborates directly with leadership to ensure facilities are both functional and visually compelling. You will assist with layout standards, develop construction drawing sets, support code and ADA compliance, and help create visual materials for both internal stakeholders and external partners. Work is performed in a support role and is closely guided by the supervising architect.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Assist with the architectural vision, layout planning, and design standards for facilities and locations.
* Develop and manage architectural drawing sets, including floor plans, equipment layouts, interior elevations, and finish plans.
* Coordinate with engineers, general contractors, and vendors on design and construction details.
* Be present for site evaluations, field verifications, and progress oversight during buildouts.
* Ensure all designs meet applicable codes, standards, accessibility and life-safety requirements, and company design guidelines.
* Maintain an organized library of equipment standards, templates, and layout best practices.

**Required Qualifications**

* Professional Degree in Architecture (B.Arch or M.Arch)
* 2+ years of experience in commercial architecture or interior planning
* Proficiency and speed with Revit, SketchUp, or comparable rendering and modeling software
* Working knowledge of ADA and relevant accessibility and life-safety codes
* Portfolio demonstrating both technical documentation and 3D visualization capabilities.
* Ability to travel locally and/or fly out for site visits as needed.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in life sciences, laboratory, healthcare, cleanroom, or other regulated or high-traffic environments
* Familiarity with cGMP-regulated facility design, ISO cleanroom classifications, or GMP building requirements.
* Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams, including engineering and external partners.

**Why Join Orchestra Life Sciences**

* Be part of a mission-driven organization advancing innovative therapies.
* Gain hands-on experience in architecture and facility design within a growing biotech company.
* Work alongside experienced leaders and cross-functional teams.
* Opportunities for professional growth and development

This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training.

0ad0298e.title: Salesforce Technical Architect
0ad0298e.description:
**Description**
Technical Architect successfully designs and manages the delivery of complex Salesforce solutions for our customers. These technologies include—but are not necessarily limited to Salesforce products and APIs, Apex/Visualforce, Lightning, mobile development technologies, and integration/ETL technologies.
  
  
You are both a big picture thinker and in-depth problem solver, your knowledge and skills are both broad and deep. You take pride in designing systems that stand up to high volumes and won't fail at critical points. You have a good mix of technical and enterprise skills when it comes to architecting a solution, including knowing how to leverage AI development tools like Claude and GitHub Copilot to optimize code quality and accelerate design cycles. The solutions you design are built for the long-term and will scale with the customer's growth plans seamlessly. You have proven experience integrating systems via API's as well as a strong development background.
  
  
What You'll Actually Be Doing
  
  

* Collaborate with client stakeholders to define requirements, deliverables, and set and manage expectations
* Translate business requirements into well-architected solutions that best leverage the Salesforce platform, including identifying opportunities to embed autonomous AI capabilities using Agentforce
* Drive Enterprise AI Architecture by designing and integrating scalable predictive and generative AI solutions within custom Salesforce environments, optimizing performance, resource consumption, and platform governor limits
* Lead technical design sessions; architect and document technical solutions aligned with client business objectives; identify gaps between client's current and desired end states, using advanced LLMs like Claude to review architectural assumptions and simulate system edge cases
* Provide oversight and governance of Salesforce projects, championing an AI-First Delivery & Engineering methodology by utilizing advanced AI tools, developer assistants (e.g., Cursor, Claude), and agentic evaluation frameworks to accelerate implementation
* Follow and help define coding standards. Lead code reviews during projects to ensure quality and appropriate design patterns are followed, utilizing AI coding assistants to help enforce standards and optimize code performance
* Manage the technical delivery of custom development, integrations, and data migration elements of a Salesforce implementation, championing the team's use of tools like GitHub Copilot to accelerate the generation of Apex classes, mock data, and REST integrations
* Focus on Performance Evaluation & ROI by collaborating with customers to develop evaluation frameworks to measure AI performance and business value for their specific use cases
* Maintain a target billable utilization aligned to the role
* Ability to understand a project and deep dive to debug issues, leveraging AI diagnostics to interpret system logs and isolate performance bottlenecks quickly
* From time-to-time, the TA may be expected to partake in other pre-sales activities such as discovery and technical deep-dive sessions, Proof-Of-Concept (POC) development with prospects using AI tools to build prototypes rapidly
* Liaise with Salesforce product teams to support client implementations
* Travels to client sites for projects, estimated 50-75%

You're Our Person If...

f36db3c3.title: Salesforce Technical Architect
f36db3c3.description:
**Description**
*Salesforce India Professional Services partners with enterprise customers to design, implement, and scale transformative Salesforce solutions. With deep platform expertise and a strong focus on business outcomes, we work with some of India's most complex and strategic organisations — making a real global impact from one of Salesforce's highest-priority growth markets.*
The Technical Architect will support the full implementation lifecycle, from scoping to deployment in an evolving ecosystem consisting of clients and partners. The Technical Architect will be responsible for successfully designing and building the Salesforce industry-specific solutions.
  
  
The Technical Architect maintains an ongoing comprehensive understanding of the cloud-computing ecosystem. As a Technical Architect, you will have strong focus on salesforce platform (e.g. Sales, Service, Community, and Einstein Clouds) and work closely with our sales and delivery teams to ensure customer success.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Working closely with Delivery Managers, Functional Solution Architects, and directly with clients and IT development staff to architect technology solutions to meet client needs and ensure the software product is leveraged correctly and the go-forward solution is easy to maintain and meets best practices. This includes a lead role in project discovery and definition workshops, contributing to creating scope and development estimates, and documenting requirements and designs.
* Effective in understanding business needs and distilling the information into business and technical requirements
* Collaborate with internal stakeholders (sales/pre-sales, engineering, other services teams, etc.) to help customers maximize the value of their Salesforce Industry products and services.
* Designing transformational technology solutions and working directly with customers to meet their business requirements in accordance with industry best practices.
* Leading and mentoring the development and QA teams on the project.
* Responsible for the application design, development, and support of Salesforce-related projects. The candidate must demonstrate progressive leadership in the full life cycle of the software development environment.
* Through the use of UML diagrams, design documentation, and best-practice methodologies; the candidate will be responsible for the detailed design of Salesforce-related projects from inception through production support.
* Responsible for ensuring that the system accurately meets the defined expectations of the business unit, ensuring that proper testing is implemented, and performance requirements are closely monitored by working with the development teams.
* Responsible for creating, delivering, in a timely and accurate fashion, CRMs and workflow solutions using Salesforce/Apex, Visualforce, Lightning, LWC, and J2EE technologies.
* Advocate and implement best practice development methodology to drive quality delivery of enterprise solutions.
* Develop POCs or help customers and partners with complex coding tasks.
* Identify and lead internal initiatives to grow the consulting practice; contribute to the overall knowledge base and expertise of the community.

**Experience**

* 10+ years of experience in Salesforce ecosystem developing technology solutions.
* Extensive experience and understanding of the Education/Real-estate/Travel Sector.
* 10+ years of experience working on deployment teams, ideally using Agile development techniques.
* Proven track record of successful delivery of customer projects, preferably enterprise CRM implementations.
* Experience leading teams in the analysis of complex problems, and the design and implementation of related solutions.
* Salesforce.com integration experience, including between different business systems as well as working with integration tools.
* Strong experience with configuration, customization, programming with APEX APIs, APEX Triggers, Apex classes, APEX Web services, API, AppExchange deployment and implementing new instances of Salesforce.com from scratch.
* Strong experience on Omnistudio suite, Business Rules Engine (BRE), Experience Cloud Integration
* Strong practical knowledge of Lightning, VisualForce, Flex, and LWC.
* Ability to define the system landscape, identify gaps between current and desired end-states, and deliver a CRM solution.
* Understanding of DevOps and Release Management for large-scale transformation projects.
* A self-starter, adept at picking up new skills and technologies, and eager to break new ground
* Excellent communication skills to communicate with customers, partners, and internal team members

**Technical Skills**

* DevOps and Release management
* Salesforce/Apex, Triggers, Flows, Community, Lightning, LWC
* Familiarity with modern web and mobile technologies (HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Web Components, others)

**DESIRED CERTIFICATIONS & QUALIFICATION**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Business or a related field
* Certified in Education Cloud, Sales Cloud, Service Cloud
* Experience on Agentforce will be preferred
* Experience on Data Cloud will be preferred
* Familiar and using AI tools to bolster implementation productivity (e.g. Cursor, Claude, NotebookLM etc)

We are seeking an experienced
**End User Support Lead**
to manage and support end-user computing services across Windows and Mac environments. Technical Support & Operations
  
  

* Provide L2/L3 support for desktops, laptops, mobile devices, printers, and peripherals.
* Lead support activities for both Windows and macOS environments.

+ Active Directory
+ Intune and/or Jamf
+ SCCM/MECM
+ VPN and Remote Access Technologies
+ Endpoint Security Platforms

* ITIL Foundation preferred.
* Experience in Incident, Request, Problem, and Change Management processes.
* Strong understanding of ServiceNow or similar ITSM platforms.

* ITIL Foundation Certification.
* Microsoft Modern Desktop Administrator certification.
* Jamf Certified Associate/Admin certification.
* Apple Device Support Certification.

Soft Skills
  
  

* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to manage executive and VIP user support.
* Strong analytical and troubleshooting abilities.
* Team leadership and mentoring capabilities.
* Customer-centric mindset with a focus on user experience.

Global / Regional support operations, including VIP and executive user support.

239db48d.description:
We build a school management platform and smart-board teaching content used by schools across India. We're hiring a Delivery Manager to run large multi-school rollouts from start to finish. - Experience with institutional or public-sector clients is a plus.

**Preferred Experience**

05e2c9bc.title: Product Delivery Manager - ServiceNow - Moveworks
05e2c9bc.description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**EY-ServiceNow – Supervising Associate (Product Delivery Manager – Moveworks)**
**Role Overview:**
The ServiceNow Product Delivery Manager is responsible for the end-to-end management and delivery of one or more ServiceNow technology solutions within EY. The role ensures that solutions are aligned with the overall EY ServiceNow strategy, integrate effectively within the enterprise technology ecosystem, and consistently deliver high-quality business outcomes.
  
  
As the primary representative and advocate of ET ServiceNow, the Product Delivery Manager is accountable for the success of assigned products and services. This includes ownership of product planning, roadmap development, backlog prioritization, stakeholder engagement, and delivery oversight throughout the product lifecycle. The Product Delivery Manager is accountable for evaluating emerging ServiceNow capabilities, aligning them with business objectives, driving stakeholder awareness and adoption through demonstrations and consultations, and establishing a prioritized roadmap and implementation backlog to maximize platform value.
  
  
The Moveworks Product Delivery Manager is responsible for the successful implementation, adoption, and ongoing evolution of the Moveworks platform across the enterprise. The role is responsible for evaluating new Moveworks features and innovations, assessing their applicability to business needs, driving stakeholder awareness and adoption, and prioritizing implementation initiatives that maximize value realization. The Product Delivery Manager ensures that solutions are delivered in accordance with governance standards, within agreed timelines and budgets, and meet quality, security, and user experience expectation.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**
**Product Strategy & Lifecycle Management:**

* Ensure products align with the EY ServiceNow strategy and broader enterprise technology objectives.
* Evaluate new ServiceNow platform capabilities and features, assess business value, and drive adoption opportunities.
* Develop and maintain the product implementation backlog based on business priorities and platform capabilities.

**Stakeholder Management:**

* Serve as the primary point of contact and trusted advisor between ET ServiceNow and business stakeholders.
* Collaborate with business teams to understand requirements, challenges, and strategic objectives.
* Translate business needs into scalable ServiceNow solutions while promoting platform best practices and standardization.
* Work with multiple stakeholders/ vendors to clear business/ technical impediments/ blockers

**Product backlog and Planning:**

* Own and govern the product backlog, ensuring alignment with business priorities and strategic goals
* Work closely with Product Owners to define, prioritize, and refine features, enhancements, and technical requirements
* Balance business demands with platform capabilities, technical constraints, and long-term solution sustainability (strong functional understanding of ServiceNow is a must. Development experience expected).

**Delivery Management:**

* Successfully execute the project to agreed schedule, budget and scope
* Manage the demand process
* Monitor risks, dependencies, and delivery milestones, implementing mitigation plans as required.
* Coordinate with cross-functional teams, including architecture, development, testing, operations, and vendors.
* Coordinate UAT and production go-live

**Governance and Continuous improvement:**

* Establish and maintain governance processes for product performance, quality, and compliance.
* Track product KPIs, adoption metrics, and customer satisfaction measures.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives to optimize business processes and maximize platform value.

**Innovation and Platform enablement:**

* Stay current with ServiceNow roadmap developments and emerging platform capabilities.
* Demonstrate new features and innovations to business stakeholders and leadership teams.
* Identify opportunities to improve user experience, operational efficiency, and business outcomes through ServiceNow.

**Knowledge and Skills Requirements:**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field
* 3+ years of hands-on experience in ServiceNow development.
* Understanding of ITIL processes and HR Services
* Strong understanding of the Move works platform, including enterprise search, conversational AI, natural language understanding (NLU), employee support automation, and AI-driven workflow orchestration.
* Knowledge of Move works integration capabilities with ServiceNow, Microsoft Teams, Slack, HR systems, identity platforms, and enterprise applications
* Understanding of conversational experiences, virtual agents, knowledge management, and self-service adoption strategies.
* Advanced comprehension of agile SAFe project management methodology, tools and templates (includes project planning, schedule development, scope management and cost management)
* Strong problem-solving, analytical, and communication skills
* ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA) certification

**What are we looking for?**

* A team player and leader with strong technical acumen and leadership capabilities
* Proactive problem-solving mindset with a focus on operational excellence
* Ability to manage multiple stakeholders and priorities in a fast-paced environment
* Passion to learn and adapt to new technologies
* Strong functional/ technical understanding of ServiceNow applications (ITSM, ITOM, HRSD).

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

53bbebd9.title: SAP Signavio Architect (REMOTE)
53bbebd9.description:
**SAP Signavio Architect / Techno-Functional Consultant**

**Location:**
Remote

**Budget:**
₹25–35 LPA

**Notice Period:**
Immediate / 1-2 weeks

**Experience:**
10 years overall experience preferred, with at least 5 years of hands-on SAP Signavio implementation experience.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Lead the implementation of SAP Signavio solutions, focusing on Business Process Management (BPM) and Process Mining.
* Utilize Process Manager, Process Insights, and Process Intelligence tools to provide actionable insights and improve business processes.
* Develop and implement BPMN 2.0 and DMN standards for process modeling and decision management.
* Conduct data integration and technical implementation using SAP BTP and SAP Integration Suite.
* Engage in ETL/ELT development, data profiling, data cleansing, and event-log transformation.
* Work with REST/SOAP APIs and JDBC/ODBC connectors to facilitate data exchange between systems.
* Design and manage RDBMS, data warehousing, and schema to support business intelligence needs.
* Integrate SAP Signavio with non-SAP platforms such as Salesforce, ServiceNow, and Oracle.
* Support SAP ECC to SAP S/4HANA migrations by utilizing process mining insights.

**Required Qualifications:**

* Approximately 10 years of relevant professional experience, including 5-10 years in Business Process Management and Process Mining.
* At least 5 years of hands-on experience with SAP Signavio implementations.
* Strong practical experience with SAP Signavio tools, including Process Manager, Process Insights, and Process Intelligence.
* Proficiency in Advanced SQL and SIGNAL query language.
* SAP Signavio certification is preferred.
* Familiarity with Order-to-Cash (O2C), Procure-to-Pay (P2P), or Record-to-Report (R2R) processes.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience supporting SAP ECC to SAP S/4HANA migrations using process mining insights.
* Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work collaboratively in a remote environment.

f8b4ed53.title: Cloud Migration Engineer
f8b4ed53.description:
**Project Role :**
Cloud Migration Engineer
  
  
**Project Role Description :**
Provides assessment of existing solutions and infrastructure to migrate to the cloud. Plan, deliver, and implement application and data migration with scalable, high-performance solutions using private and public cloud technologies driving next-generation business outcomes.
  
  
**Must have skills :**
Infrastructure As Code (IaC)
  
  
**Good to have skills :**
NA
  
  
**Minimum 5 Year(s) Of Experience Is Required**
**Educational Qualification :**
Equivalent education
  
  
**Summary**
As a Cloud Migration Engineer, a typical day involves evaluating current infrastructure and solutions to determine the best approach for transitioning to cloud environments. This role includes planning and executing the migration of applications and data, ensuring that the solutions implemented are scalable and high-performing. The position requires coordinating with various stakeholders to align migration strategies with business goals, while continuously monitoring progress and addressing any challenges that arise during the migration process. The engineer plays a key role in enabling organizations to leverage both private and public cloud technologies to achieve advanced business outcomes.
  
  
**Roles & Responsibilities**

* Expected to be an SME, collaborate and manage the team to perform.
* Responsible for team decisions.
* Engage with multiple teams and contribute on key decisions.
* Provide solutions to problems for their immediate team and across multiple teams.
* Lead the development and implementation of cloud migration strategies to ensure seamless transition.
* Facilitate communication and coordination between cross-functional teams to optimize migration efforts.
* Monitor migration progress and proactively identify risks or issues, proposing effective mitigation plans.

**Professional & Technical Skills**

* Must To Have Skills: Proficiency in Infrastructure As Code (IaC).
* Experience with cloud platforms and automation tools related to Infrastructure As Code.
* Strong knowledge of cloud architecture principles and best practices for migration.
* Ability to design scalable and secure cloud infrastructure using Infrastructure As Code methodologies.
* Familiarity with scripting and configuration management to automate deployment processes.
* Understanding of network, storage, and security considerations in cloud environments.

**Additional Information**

* The candidate should have minimum 5 years of experience in Infrastructure As Code (IaC).
* This position is based at our Gurugram office.
* Equivalent education is required.

e48524af.title: DevOps Architect
e48524af.description:
**Project Role :**
DevOps Architect
  
  
**Project Role Description :**
Assess, design, and engineer DevOps solutions in complex technology environments. Design and build DevOps technical solutions for cloud-native, cloud-enabled, and on-prem infrastructure with microservices or traditional application patterns.
  
  
**Must have skills :**
Cloud Automation DevOps
  
  
**Good to have skills :**
NA
  
  
**Minimum 7.5 Year(s) Of Experience Is Required**
**Educational Qualification :**
15 years full time education
  
  
**Summary**
We re looking for a Infrastructure Auotmation and DevOps Engineer who combines software development expertise with strong DevOps and cloud infrastructure skills. You ll be responsible for designing, developing, deploying, and maintaining scalable web applications while implementing CI/CD pipelines, automating infrastructure, and ensuring high system reliability and performance. You ll work closely with developers, QA engineers, and operations teams to streamline deployment processes and enhance development workflows.
  
  
**Roles & Responsibilities**
IaC Development
  
  

* Design, develop, and maintain Infrastructure Automation using IaC principals and DevOps Skills.
* Develop Predictive automation using Monitoring and Observability tools.

DevOps & Cloud Infrastructure
  
  

* Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines using tools such as GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, or CircleCI.
* Manage infrastructure as code (IaC) using Terraform, CloudFormation, or Ansible, Pulumi and CrossPlane.
* Deploy and monitor applications in cloud environments (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
* Set up automated monitoring, logging, and alerting (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK Stack, Datadog).
* Enhance system reliability, security, and scalability through automation and best practices.

Operations & Collaboration
  
  

* Participate in code reviews and DevOps strategy discussions.
* Troubleshoot and resolve production issues with a focus on uptime and performance.
* Implement security best practices and assist with compliance standards.
* Mentor junior developers and contribute to improving development workflows.

**Professional & Technical Skills**
DevOps & Automation Tools
  
  

* CI/CD Pipelines: Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, CircleCI, Travis CI, ArgoCD
* Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Terraform, Ansible, AWS CloudFormation, Pulumi
* Configuration Management: Chef, Puppet, Ansible, SaltStack
* Monitoring & observability: Splunk, DataDog, Prometheus.

Cloud & Infrastructure
  
  

* Cloud Platforms: AWS, Azure, Google Cloud Platform (GCP)
* Compute & Networking: EC2, Lambda, VPC, Load Balancers, Route 53, DNS, VPNs
* Storage & Databases: S3, RDS, DynamoDB, PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB
* Containerization: Docker, Podman
* Container Orchestration: Kubernetes (K8s), Helm, OpenShift

System Administration & Networking
  
  

* Operating Systems: Linux (Ubuntu, CentOS, Alpine), Bash scripting, basic Windows Server knowledge
* Networking Fundamentals: TCP/IP, DNS, SSL/TLS, HTTP/HTTPS, VPN, firewalls
* Security & Compliance: IAM, Secrets Management (Vault, AWS Secrets Manager), SSH, encryption, vulnerability scanning

Observability & Incident Response
  
  

* Monitoring: Application and system performance metrics
* Alerting & Incident Management: PagerDuty, Opsgenie, Slack integrations
* Logging: Centralized log management (ELK, Fluentd, Splunk)

Bonus / Emerging Skills
  
  

* Serverless architectures (AWS Lambda, Azure Functions)
* GitOps (Flux, ArgoCD)
* AIOps and observability automation
* SRE principles (Service Level Indicators/Objectives)

Cloud Observability Skills: Multi-cloud monitoring, Cloud cost optimization, Cloud performance analysis, Cloud-native troubleshooting, Cloud security observability
  
  
Tools: Azure Monitor, Azure Log Analytics, Azure Application Insights, AWS CloudWatch, AWS X-Ray, GCP Operations Suite, Datadog Cloud Monitoring, Dynatrace Cloud Automation
  
  
Skills: Network flow analysis, Packet analytics, WAN observability, SD-WAN monitoring, Network performance management, Network anomaly detection
  
  
Tools: ThousandEyes, SolarWinds NPM, Cisco AppDynamics Network Monitoring, Riverbed
  
  
Observability: SCOM, SolarWinds, Datadog Infrastructure Monitoring, Dynatrace Infrastructure, VMware Aria Operations, Turbonomic
  
  
**Additional Information**

* Strong problem-solving and debugging skills
* Collaboration with developers, QA, and IT teams
* Understanding agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban)
* Continuous learning and adapting to new tools and cloud services
* Flexible to work in 24\*7 environment

574a40be.title: Enterprise Technology Architect
574a40be.description:
**Project Role :**
Enterprise Technology Architect
  
  
**Project Role Description :**
Architect complex end-to-end IT solutions across the enterprise. Apply the latest technology and industry expertise to create better products and experiences.
  
  
**Must have skills :**
Network Operations & Service Management
  
  
**Good to have skills :**
NA
  
  
**Minimum 15 Year(s) Of Experience Is Required**
**Educational Qualification :**
15 years full time education
  
  
**Summary**
As a Network Architect, you will design, deploy and manage global enterprise networks, automation, observability, reliability engineering, and manage large-scale transformation programs. You will work within defined operating model and processes, implementing technology at the network level across data center, cloud and network areas. This role requires envisioning and articulating a clear and compelling architecture vision, establishing a target state for the enterprise, and developing a detailed transformation roadmap. The position demands continuous engagement with various stakeholders to ensure the architecture supports business objectives and adapts to evolving technological landscapes. The Network Architect plays a pivotal role in guiding the organization through complex changes by fostering innovation and ensuring cohesive integration across multiple domains.
  
  
**Roles & Responsibilities**

* Expected to perform independently and become an SME.
* Required active participation/contribution in team discussions.
* Execution of the project setup (project scheduling, stakeholder analysis, risk assessment, etc.)

b172d3f2.title: Azure Cloud Platform Engineer
b172d3f2.description:
***Job Title:**
Azure Cloud Platform Engineer
**Company**
: Toro Technology Center India*
**Who Are We?**
The Toro Company is a homegrown, Minnesota-based company that has been in business since 1914. We pride ourselves on providing world-class equipment to help maintain the environment that we love, while putting an emphasis on giving back to the communities that surround us. From residential lawns and gardens to Golf Clubs and sports grounds we are a company with a global footprint and a passion for helping people beautify whatever landscape they may be in. With 100+ years of operation under our belt and an average employee tenure of 15 years, come find out what makes The Toro Company the best place to build a career.
  
  
**What Will You Do?**
In order to grow and build a successful career with The Toro Company, you will be responsible for:
  
  

* Collaborate with technical leadership, architecture, security, application, data, and AI teams to design and deliver secure, scalable, reliable, and cost-effective Azure platform solutions.
* Engineer and support enterprise Azure Landing Zones, management groups, subscriptions, resource organization, tagging, policy, logging, and governance patterns.
* Design and implement Azure networking and connectivity patterns, including VNets, DNS, firewalls, private endpoints, routing, and secure hybrid or enterprise connectivity.
* Build and maintain reusable Infrastructure as Code using Terraform as a core engineering tool; use Bicep and Azure Verified Modules where they provide a strong Azure-native fit.
* Develop versioned, tested, reusable IaC modules and platform patterns that standardize cloud provisioning and reduce manual deployment effort.
* Build and maintain CI/CD workflows using GitHub Actions and/or Azure DevOps, including reusable workflows, environment promotion, approvals, testing, and deployment traceability.
* Implement secure cloud identity patterns using Microsoft Entra ID, Azure RBAC, managed identities, Privileged Identity Management, Key Vault, and workload identity or OIDC-based authentication.
* Embed security and governance into engineering workflows using least privilege, Azure Policy, secure defaults, vulnerability and secret scanning, and documented exception handling.
* Build observability and operational readiness using Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, Application Insights, dashboards, actionable alerting, runbooks, and service ownership practices.
* Own platform capabilities across their lifecycle - design, build, deployment, operations, incident response, root-cause analysis, resilience improvement, and retirement.
* Apply cloud FinOps practices including cost allocation, tagging, budgeting, forecasting, rightsizing, utilization analysis, anomaly identification, and optimization recommendations.
* Automate recurring operational and provisioning activities using PowerShell, Python, Bash, or equivalent scripting and automation techniques.
* Partner with application, data, analytics, and AI engineering teams to provide secure cloud foundations, connectivity, compute, storage, and deployment patterns for modern workloads.
* Create clear technical documentation, reference architectures, reusable examples, and knowledge-transfer material that supports consistent adoption across global teams.

**What Do You Need?**
To be considered for this role, an individual should meet the following minimal requirements:
  
  

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant professional experience.
* 5+ years of experience in Cloud, Infrastructure, DevOps, or Platform Engineering, including at least 3 years of hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure.
* Strong hands-on experience with Terraform, including reusable modules, remote state, versioning, environment separation, and production deployment patterns.
* Strong experience with Azure platform services, networking, identity, security, governance, and automation.
* Experience with Azure DevOps and/or GitHub Enterprise, including CI/CD pipelines or GitHub Actions and source-control-based engineering practices.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft Entra ID, Azure RBAC, managed identities, Azure Policy, Key Vault, private endpoints, and enterprise networking concepts.
* Experience with observability, monitoring, incident response, operational support, and reliability practices for production cloud services.
* Proficiency in at least one scripting or automation language such as PowerShell, Python, or Bash.
* Understanding of cloud cost management and FinOps principles, including tagging, cost ownership, budgeting, rightsizing, and optimization.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across global, cross-functional engineering teams.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with Azure Well-Architected Framework, Azure Landing Zone design principles, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), SLOs, or resilience testing.
* Experience supporting cloud foundations for data, analytics, or AI workloads, including secure connectivity, compute, storage, identity, and deployment automation.
* Exposure to multi-cloud engineering patterns or AWS/GCP is beneficial; Azure remains the primary focus of this role.
* Relevant certifications such as Microsoft Azure Administrator Associate (AZ-104), Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ-305), DevOps Engineer Expert (AZ-400), or HashiCorp Terraform Associate are preferred, but equivalent practical experience is valued.
* Experience creating reusable platform services, self-service or 'golden path' capabilities, internal developer platforms, or cloud service catalogs.

**What Can We Give You?**
**Benefits**
At The Toro Company, we are always working to make sure our employees know just how valued they are. In addition to a competitive salary, an affordable and top tier medical insurance plan many other great benefits - The Toro company offers employees , a variety of perks, including:
  
  
***Dress for your day***
- We know you're more productive when you're comfortable, which is why TTC employees are encouraged to take advantage of our casual, corporate environment.
  
  
***Location***
– Conveniently located
**Baner, Pune**
we are centrally located for most commuters!
  
  
***Food***
- Take advantage of our café, which serves both breakfast and lunch. You can grab a snack and a coffee at any time during your day.
  
  
***Wellness***
- The Toro Company offers complimentary use of our onsite fitness facility to employees. In addition to physical wellbeing, TTC offers a variety of mental health and financial health resources to all employees.
  
  
***Volunteerism***
- The Toro Company is proud to provide employees 20 hours of paid time to volunteer in the community.
  
  
***Flexible Work Arrangements***
– This team is currently implementing a hybrid work schedule. The opportunity to collaborate in the office and work from home part-time, has promoted team-building and flexibility.

7368b6c5.description:

We're also associated with breakthrough startups like Amelia.ai, giving our team exposure to cutting-edge AI products at enterprise scale.

**About the Role**

EazyML, recognized by Gartner, EazyML (www.EazyML.com) specializes in Responsible AI. Our solutions facilitate proactive compliance and sustainable automation, and the company is associated with breakthrough startups like Amelia.ai.

This is a full-time Remote role for an experienced
**Senior Platform Architect — Microsoft Fabric**
who enjoys solving complex data problems and takes ownership from design through delivery. You can work from home (anywhere in INDIA, job location is in India).

**Experience Level:**
Senior (10+ years overall, 2+ years hands-on with Microsoft Fabric)
**DO NOT APPLY IF YOU DON'T HAVE AT LEAST 8+ YEARS OF EXPERIENCE. THIS IS A SENIOR POSITION**

This role is ideal for someone who can build scalable data pipelines on
**Microsoft Azure Fabric**
, leverage AI to improve engineering productivity, and work closely with business and technical stakeholders.

**About the Role**

We're looking for a Senior Platform Architect with strong DevOps expertise to design, implement, and operationalize our Microsoft Fabric data platform. You'll own the architecture of our unified data estate — spanning OneLake, Data Factory pipelines, Synapse Data Engineering, Power BI, and Real-Time Analytics — while building the CI/CD, governance, and automation backbone that lets our data teams ship reliably and securely. This is a hands-on architecture role: you'll set technical direction and also build it yourself.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
* **10+ years**
  of experience in Data Engineering, Data Warehousing, or Cloud Data Platform development.
* **4+ years**
  of hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure Data Platform technologies.
* **2+ years**
  of hands-on experience with Microsoft Fabric in enterprise implementations.
* Strong expertise in SQL, PySpark, Python, and Spark optimization.
* Experience with Microsoft Fabric components including OneLake, Lakehouse, Data Warehouse, Data Factory, Power BI, and Real-Time Intelligence.
* Experience with Azure Data Lake Storage (ADLS), Azure DevOps, GitHub, and CI/CD pipelines.
* Strong knowledge of dimensional data modeling, ETL/ELT architecture, and data governance.

**What You'll Do**

* Design and own the end-to-end architecture for Microsoft Fabric, including OneLake data lake structure, workspace and capacity strategy, domain/workspace segregation, and medallion (bronze/silver/gold) layering.
* Define and implement DevOps practices for Fabric: Git integration, deployment pipelines, environment promotion (dev/test/prod), and infrastructure-as-code for Fabric items (lakehouses, warehouses, notebooks, pipelines, semantic models).
* Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions) for Fabric artifacts, including automated testing, validation, and rollback strategies.
* Architect and enforce governance, security, and access controls across Fabric — workspace roles, OneLake data access policies, sensitivity labels, row-level security, and integration with Microsoft Purview.
* Partner with data engineers, analysts, and platform teams to standardize development patterns, reusable templates, and best practices across Fabric workloads (Data Factory, Data Engineering/Spark, Data Warehouse, Real-Time Intelligence, Power BI).
* Lead migration efforts from legacy platforms (Synapse Analytics, Azure Data Factory, on-prem SSIS/SQL Server, or other cloud data warehouses) onto Microsoft Fabric.
* Mentor engineering teams on Fabric architecture patterns, DevOps practices, and operational excellence.

**Roles & Responsibilities: Technical Leadership**

* Lead the end-to-end implementation of Microsoft Fabric solutions across enterprise programs.
* Define technical architecture, engineering standards, and best practices for Microsoft Fabric adoption.
* Provide technical leadership to a team of data engineers and developers.
* Review solution designs, code, and deployment strategies to ensure quality and scalability.

**Microsoft Fabric Architecture**

* Design and implement enterprise data platforms using Microsoft Fabric components including OneLake, Lakehouse, Data Warehouse, Data Factory, Real-Time Intelligence, Data Engineering, and Power BI.
* Architect scalable, cloud-native data solutions supporting analytics, AI, and business intelligence workloads.
* 3 + years of hands-on experience with Microsoft Fabric, or deep equivalent experience with Azure Synapse Analytics, Power BI, and Azure Data Factory with a clear path to Fabric.
* Strong command of OneLake, Lakehouse and Warehouse architecture, Delta Lake/Parquet formats, and medallion architecture design.

**Data Engineering & Integration**

* Design and develop robust ETL/ELT pipelines using Microsoft Fabric Data Factory and Spark Notebooks.
* Integrate structured, semi-structured, and unstructured data from cloud and on-premises systems.
* Implement data transformation, cleansing, validation, and orchestration processes.

4ab94aed.title: Delivery Lead Manager
4ab94aed.description:
**Skill required:**
Record To Report - Financial Consolidation & Close Operations
  
  
**Designation:**
Delivery Lead Manager
  
  
**Qualifications:**
BCom/MCom/Chartered Accountant
  
  
**Years of Experience:**
13 to 18 years
  
  
**About Accenture**
Accenture is a global professional services company with leading capabilities in digital, cloud and security.Combining unmatched experience and specialized skills across more than 40 industries, we offer Strategy and Consulting, Technology and Operations services, and Accenture Song— all powered by the world’s largest network of Advanced Technology and Intelligent Operations centers. Our 784,000 people deliver on the promise of technology and human ingenuity every day, serving clients in more than 120 countries. We embrace the power of change to create value and shared success for our clients, people, shareholders, partners and communities.Visit us at www.accenture.com
  
  
**What would you do?**
You will be aligned with our Finance Operations vertical and will be helping us in determining financial outcomes by collecting operational data/reports, whilst conducting analysis and reconciling transactions. Record to Report (RTR) is the end-to-end finance and accounting process that covers the collection, processing, and reporting of financial data to provide a complete and accurate picture of business performance. It includes general ledger accounting, journal entry processing, account reconciliations, intercompany accounting, fixed assets management, financial close management, and statutory and management reporting. The goal is to ensure accurate, timely, and compliant financial statements in accordance with applicable accounting standards. Effective RTR operations underpin strong financial controls and support informed business decision-making. Keywords include: (“General Ledger”, “Journal Entry”, “Account Reconciliation”, “Financial Close”, “Intercompany Accounting”, “Fixed Assets”, “Financial Reporting”, “Statutory Reporting”, “US GAAP”, “IFRS”) Design, implement, manage and support record to report and general ledger accounting activities for an organization by applying the relevant processes, policies and applications
  
  
**What are we looking for?**
Education: Bcom, M Com, Chartered Accountant
  
  

* Process-orientation with deep expertise in Record to Report and General Ledger accounting operations
* Thought leadership in RTR transformation, financial close optimization, and reporting modernization
* Corporate planning & strategic planning with focus on financial reporting integrity, close cycle efficiency, and controllership excellence
* Risk management covering financial reporting risk, internal controls, audit exposure, and regulatory compliance
* Ability to manage multiple stakeholders including controllership, FP&A, internal audit, external auditors, and senior business leadership
* Should possess strong exposure to the end-to-end Record to Report (RTR) process including general ledger, period-end close, intercompany, fixed assets, and financial statements preparation
* Must have prior experience in managing client relationships and leading large RTR and financial reporting teams effectively
* Should be capable of acting as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) for RTR, providing guidance on complex accounting treatments, close issues, and financial reporting matters
* Well-versed in process controls, including a strong understanding and practical experience with SOX controls related to financial close, journal entries, and account reconciliations
* Strong knowledge of accounting standards including GAAP and/or IFRS, with the ability to interpret and apply standards to complex business transactions
* Experience overseeing intercompany accounting, fixed assets accounting, and lease accounting (ASC 842 / IFRS 16) is highly desirable
* Ability to govern the financial close calendar, drive on-time delivery of period-end close activities, and ensure quality of balance sheet reconciliations
* Familiarity with RTR technology platforms such as SAP S/4HANA, Oracle Cloud Financials, BlackLine, or Cadency (Trintech) is highly preferred
* Demonstrated ability to lead close cycle reduction initiatives, implement automation in journal entry and reconciliation processes, and drive continuous improvement in RTR operations Experience with Airline business will bring added advantage Roles and Responsibilities:
* In this role you are required to identify and assess complex problems for area of responsibility within the Record to Report and Financial Reporting function
* The person would create solutions in situations in which analysis requires an in-depth evaluation of variable factors including accounting policy judgements, complex transaction structures, and multi-entity consolidation requirements
* Requires adherence to strategic direction set by senior management when establishing near-term goals for close cycle efficiency, reporting accuracy, and internal controls effectiveness
* Interaction of the individual is with senior management at a client and/or within Accenture, involving matters that may require acceptance of an alternate approach on accounting treatment, reporting timelines, or audit findings
* Some latitude in decision-making is involved, particularly on accounting policy application, materiality judgements, and escalation of audit or control issues
* You will act independently to determine methods and procedures on new assignments related to RTR process design, financial close governance, and reporting transformation
* Decisions made at this role have a major day to day impact on financial reporting accuracy, regulatory compliance, and the integrity of the general ledger
* Oversee and govern end-to-end general ledger accounting operations including journal entry processing, account reconciliations, intercompany eliminations, and fixed asset accounting across client engagements
* Lead period-end, quarter-end, and year-end financial close processes, ensuring timely delivery of trial balance, financial statements, and management reporting packs in accordance with close calendar commitments
* Drive governance over statutory and regulatory reporting activities, ensuring compliance with applicable GAAP/IFRS standards and timely filing of financial statements
* Engage with senior client stakeholders, internal and external auditors on accounting and reporting matters, providing technical guidance and leading audit readiness and support activities
* The person manages large to medium sized teams and/or work efforts (if in an individual contributor role) at a client or within Accenture
* Please note that this role may require you to work in rotational shifts

d20cf57d.title: Senior Solutions Engineer - BFSI
d20cf57d.description:
**About Neo4j**
Neo4j is the graph intelligence platform that transforms data into knowledge to power the next generation of intelligent applications and AI systems. It includes enterprise-ready knowledge graphs for accurate, explainable, and governed AI; the most comprehensive, trusted, and easy-to-deploy graph capabilities across any environment and data source; and an unmatched ecosystem trusted by 84 of the Fortune 100 and supported by the world’s largest graph community. Intelligence that works. Results that matter.
  
  
Built to work everywhere and integrate with everything across every cloud for dynamic, personalized, and autonomous AI systems. We deliver quicker results, contextual knowledge, and solutions that impact customers and employees across the business.
  
  
**Our Vision**
At Neo4j, we have always strived to help the world make sense of data.
  
  
As business, society and knowledge become increasingly connected, our technology promotes innovation by helping organizations to find and understand data relationships. We created, drive and lead the graph database category, and we’re disrupting how organizations leverage their data to innovate and stay competitive.
  
  
**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 7 years of experience in a pre-sales engineering, professional services, or customer-facing technical architecture role.
* Experience in programming languages (e.g., Java, Python, JavaScript), containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), and cloud infrastructure technologies.
* Experience engaging with, presenting to, and influencing both technical stakeholders and executive leaders (C-level) during complex sales cycles.
* Experience driving technical discovery and value-based selling to map enterprise business goals to technical architectures.
* Location: Candidates based in Mumbai or Bangalore will be prioritised.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related technical field.
* Deep expertise in graph database technologies (e.g., Neo4j) along with knowledge of relational, NoSQL, and data visualization tools (e.g., D3.js, Linkurious).
* Proven experience building joint GTM solutions and co-selling with hyperscalers (AWS, Azure, GCP), strategic ISVs, and global systems integrators.
* Industry expertise within highly regulated sectors such as Banking & Financial Services, Telco, and Government.

**About The Job**
As a Solutions Engineer, you will be a key driver of Neo4j’s growth by shaping technical solutions that address complex enterprise challenges. You will serve as the technical authority during the pre-sales lifecycle, moving beyond standard product demonstrations to architect robust, value-driven graph database solutions. You will engage deeply with BFSI & Enterprise customers and strategic partners—including hyperscalers like AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud—to design interconnected data ecosystems that prove the tangible ROI of the Neo4j portfolio. In this role, you will blend consultative technical prowess, sales acumen, and ecosystem collaboration to accelerate adoption and secure the technical win.
  
  
Neo4j is the world leader in graph technology, helping organizations capture real-world context to drive choices for applications like artificial intelligence, fraud detection, and recommendation engines. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage connection-first data architectures to solve the world's most critical business problems. Turn your technical expertise into impact by helping India’s largest enterprises unlock the value of AI with connected data.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Drive the technical win for complex enterprise accounts, leading technical discovery, product demonstrations, and competitive positioning from evaluation through opportunity conversion.
* Design, build, and deliver proof-of-value (PoV) prototypes, tailored solution architectures, and technical workshops that clearly articulate Neo4j’s unique value proposition.
* Partner closely with hyperscalers (AWS, Azure, GCP), systems integrators, and ISVs to architect joint solutions, execute co-sell initiatives, and deliver technical enablement programs.
* Act as a cross-functional technical orchestrator, collaborating with internal sales teams on deal qualification and ensuring a seamless architectural handoff to Professional Services and implementation partners.
* Champion Neo4j’s technology by contributing to thought leadership, presenting at webinars and industry conferences, and supporting local developer community and marketing events.
* Travel to customer sites and partner events as required to run technical workshops and advance strategic engagements.

Job Title –Solutions Architect – HPC and container Platform.
  
  
**Job Description**
We are seeking an experienced Enterprise Solution Architect with expertise in High Performance Computing (HPC) and Container platforms in Linux-based environments to join our dynamic team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for architecting solutions including but not limited to installation, configuration, integration and implementation of HPC technologies and enterprise-grade container orchestration platform.
  
  
We are looking for a person with very strong technical skills and a proven track record of designing and working with container platforms such as Red Hat OpenShift, SUSE Rancher, CNCF Kubernetes, HPC Schedulers such as Slurm or PBS Pro, HPC/AI Cluster management technologies such as HPCM or BCM and the ability to work in a dynamic customer-focused team that requires excellent interpersonal skills.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
Candidate must have strong proficiency as a Solution Architect in at least three areas and proficiency in other areas.
  
  

* Leadership and Strategy:
* Develop HPC and container platform roadmaps and strategies for growth based on business needs.
* Engage in and enhance the complete service lifecycle—from conceptualization and design to implementation and operation.
* Identify the growth path and scalability options of a solution and include these in design activities.
* Solution Planning and Design:
* Gather requirements, assess technical feasibility, and design integrated HPC and container solutions that align with business objectives.
* Architect and optimize the technical solutions to meet the requirements of the customer.
* Identify the potential challenges and constraints that impact the solution and project plan.
* Opportunity assessment:
* Respond to the technical sections of RFIs/RFPs and Lead proof-of-concept engagements to a successful conclusion
* Utilize an effective consultative approach to advance opportunities.
* Innovation and Research:
* Stay abreast of emerging technologies, trends, and industry developments related to HPC, Kubernetes, containers, cloud computing, and Security.
* Develop best practices, Accelerators and Show & Tell for HPC and container platform solutions and integrations.
* Customer-centric mindset:
* Strong focus on understanding customer business requirements and solving complex cloud technology issues
* Be the trusted advisor, delight customers, and deliver exceptional customer experiences to drive customer success.
* Communicate complex technical concepts and findings to non-technical stakeholders
* Team Collaboration:
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including system administrators, developers, data scientist and project managers, to ensure successful project delivery.
* Understands the roles and effectively engages other teams and resources within the company
* Mentor and train new team members and lead the way in participation in tech talks, forums, innovation.

**Required Skills**

* Knowledge and experience with Linux System Administration, package management, scheduling, boot procedures/troubleshooting, performance optimization, and networking concepts.
* In-depth knowledge and hands-on experience with HPC technologies, workload schedulers – Slurm, Altair PBS pro, and cluster managers – HPCM, Bright cluster manager.
* In-depth knowledge and hands-on experience with containerization technologies like Docker, Singularity, or Podman.
* In-depth knowledge and hands-on experience with at least two of the container orchestration technologies like CNCF Kubernetes, Red Hat OpenShift, SUSE Rancher RKE/K3S, Canonical charmed kubernetes or HPE Ezmeral Runtime. Good to have
* Good knowledge and hands-on experience with OpenStack cloud solutions.
* Good knowledge and hands-on experience with virtualization technologies like KVM, OpenShift virtualization
* Good knowledge and hands-on experience with at least two various Linux distributions like RHEL, SLES, Ubuntu, Debian.
* Good Knowledge of GPU technologies, NVIDIA GPU operator, NVIDIA vGPU technology
* Good knowledge of HPC networking stack (high speed networking), InfiniBand, Mellanox
* Good experience in performance optimization and health assessment of HPC components

such as operating systems, storage, servers, parallel file systems, schedulers, and container orchestration platforms.
  
  

* Must be good in any of the programming or scripting languages like python, bash
* Good understanding of DNS, TCP/IP, Routing and Load Balancing.
* Knowledge of network protocols like TCP/IP, S3, FTP, NFS, or SMB/CIFS
* Familiarity with microservices architecture, CI/CD pipelines, and DevOps tools.
* Excellent problem-solving abilities, analytical thinking, and communication skills to interact with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Ability to lead technical projects by gathering the requirements, preparing the architecture / design and executing it end to end. Must be able to bring clarity and drive complex projects involving multiple stakeholders.
* Solid business acumen and ability to converse with client on issues and challenges.
* Demonstrates a solid knowledge of the company's breadth of solutions.
* Demonstrates a high-level understanding of all related vendor product roadmaps.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s/master’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, or a related field.
* Proven experience as a Solutions Architect, HPC and Container platform Specialist, or similar role, with expertise in designing and implementing complex solutions.
* Red Hat Certified Specialist in Containers and Kubernetes (RHCSA, RHCE), CNCF certification - CKA, CKAD, CKS is preferred.
* Typically, 6-8 years of experience in delivering complex HPC and container platform projects.

Skills: high performance computing,rhcsa,openshift,cloud,dns,kubernetes,enterprise,linux,hpc,cluster,rhel

a41ebe29.title: Salesforce Field Service Architect
a41ebe29.description:
**Description**
Our Field Service Professional Services team works across technology and business stakeholders to usher customers into the next phase of their business transformation journey and achieve innovative outcomes that craft the future.
  
  
Technical Architect successfully designs and manages the delivery of complex Salesforce solutions for our customers. These technologies include--but are not necessarily limited to Salesforce.com products and APIs, Apex/Visualforce, Lightning, mobile development technologies, and integration/ETL technologies.
  
  
As a core part of this role, you will realize solutions for our customers by focusing on consultancy, technical development & delivery for the customers and partners to solve critically meaningful business challenges using Salesforce’s Field Service Platform (SFS). Salesforce FS product provides FSM solutions for a wide variety of customer verticals and ecosystem(s) like Telecom, Utilities, Oil & Gas, Manufacturing, Finance etc.
  
  
You are both a big picture thinker and in-depth problem solver, your knowledge and skills are both broad and deep. You take pride in designing systems that stand up to high volumes and won't fail at critical points. You have a good mix of technical and enterprise skills when it comes to architecting a solution. The solutions you design are built for the long-term and will scale with the customer's growth plans seamlessly. You have proven experience integrating systems via API’s as well as a strong development background.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Collaborate with client stakeholders to define requirements, deliverables, and set and manage expectations
* Drive Enterprise AI Architecture by designing and integrating scalable predictive and generative AI solutions within custom Salesforce environments, optimizing performance, resource consumption, and platform governor limits
* Lead technical design sessions; architect and document technical solutions aligned with client business objectives; identify gaps between client's current and desired end states, using advanced LLMs like Claude to review architectural assumptions and simulate system edge cases
* Champion an AI-first delivery methodology, utilizing advanced AI tools, developer assistants (e.g., Cursor, Claude), and agentic evaluation frameworks to accelerate implementation across projects
* Translate business requirements into well-architected solutions that best leverage the Salesforce platform
* Provide oversight and governance of Salesforce projects
* Follow and help define coding standards. Lead code reviews during projects to ensure quality and appropriate design patterns are followed
* Manage the technical delivery of custom development, integrations, and data migration elements of a Salesforce implementation
* Maintain a target billable utilization aligned to the role
* Ability to understand a project and deep dive to debug issues
* From time-to-time, the TA may be expected to partake in other pre-sales activities such as discovery and technical deep-dive sessions, Proof-Of-Concept (POC) development with prospects
* Liaise with Salesforce product teams to support client implementations
* Travels to client sites for projects, estimated 50-75%

**Requirements**

* Degree or equivalent proven experience required. Experience will be evaluated based on the core proficiencies for the role (e.g. extracurricular leadership roles, military experience, volunteer roles, work experience, etc.)
* 9-14 years CRM experience with a minimum of 6 years on the Salesforce platform
* Expert level understanding of End-to-End Field Service Implementation
* Good understanding of the Salesforce product suite, including Sales, Service, Marketing, and Community Clouds
* Understanding of systems architecture and ability to design scalable performance-driven solutions
* Understanding of key design patterns and large data volume limitations and best practices
* Understanding of data sharing and visibility considerations and how these play into platform architecture
* Familiarity with platform authentication patterns (SAML, SSO, OAuth)
* Knowledge of data integration tools and experience integrating Salesforce with different business systems (ETL, CPQ, marketing automation, reporting, etc.)
* Strong understanding of environment management, release management, code versioning best practices, and deployment methodologies
* Experience with platform security capabilities (TLS, SSL)
* Expert level experience defining the system architecture landscape, identifying gaps between current and desired end-states, and delivering a comprehensive solution that will enable achievement of the desired business outcomes
* Strong background in design/development of large web-based systems, or complete software product lifecycle exposure
* Active Salesforce certifications or ability to achieve relevant certifications upon hire
