a1d44e2b.title: Application Architect-AWS Cloud Migration
a1d44e2b.description:
**Introduction**
A career in IBM Consulting is built on long-term client relationships and close collaboration worldwide. You’ll work with leading companies across industries, helping them shape their hybrid cloud and AI journeys. With support from our strategic partners, robust IBM technology, and Red Hat, you’ll have the tools to drive meaningful change and accelerate client impact. At IBM Consulting, curiosity fuels success. You’ll be encouraged to challenge the norm, explore new ideas, and create innovative solutions that deliver real results. Our culture of growth and empathy focuses on your long-term career development while valuing your unique skills and experiences.
  
  
**Your Role And Responsibilities**
As an Application Architect specializing in AWS Cloud Migration, you will lead the design and delivery of cloud migration solutions for multi-cloud environments, including AWS, Azure, and ICP. You will guide the development of migration strategies, tools, and network requirements for hybrid cloud platforms.
  
  
**Your Primary Responsibilities Will Include**

* Lead Migration Architecture Design: Develop and implement migration architecture solutions for multi-cloud environments, ensuring seamless integration with AWS and other cloud platforms.
* Design Migration Strategy: Collaborate with the team to create effective migration strategies, selecting the right tools and methods for rehosting, refactoring, rearchitecting, replatforming, and containerization.
* Adopt Migration Methodology: Lead the adoption of migration methodologies, tailoring approaches to client environments and industries, and providing expert guidance on method adoption workshops.
* Provide Technical Expertise: Offer significant contributions to Migration Project Managers on technical elements, including WBS, estimation, migration risk, dependencies, and Minimum Viable Product (MVP).
* Map Client Requirements: Utilize deep knowledge of AWS platform and service catalog to map client platform and application deployment requirements into AWS-specific services and configurations.

**Preferred Education**
Master's Degree
  
  
**Required Technical And Professional Expertise**

* Cloud Migration Solution Design: Experience with designing and delivering cloud migration solutions for multi-cloud environments, including AWS, Azure, and ICP, with a focus on hybrid cloud platforms.
* Migration Strategy Development: Experience in developing effective migration strategies, including selecting the right tools and methods for rehosting, refactoring, rearchitecting, replatforming, and containerization.
* Migration Methodology Adoption: Experience leading the adoption of migration methodologies, tailoring approaches to client environments and industries, and providing expert guidance on method adoption workshops.
* Technical Expertise in Migration: Experience providing significant contributions to Migration Project Managers on technical elements, including WBS, estimation, migration risk, dependencies, and Minimum Viable Product (MVP).
* AWS Platform Knowledge: Deep knowledge of AWS platform and service catalog, with the ability to map client platform and application deployment requirements into AWS-specific services and configurations.

**Preferred Technical And Professional Experience**

* Deep Knowledge of Azure: Experience with Azure platform and service catalog, with the ability to map client platform and application deployment requirements into Azure-specific services and configurations.
* Familiarity with ICP: Exposure to ICP platform and service catalog, with understanding of how to integrate ICP with other cloud platforms.
* Containerization Expertise: Experience with containerization methods and tools, including selecting the right approach for rehosting, refactoring, rearchitecting, replatforming, and containerization.

71030598.title: EY - GDS Consulting - AI And DATA - Databricks Architect - Senior Manager
71030598.description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**EY-Consulting – Data and Analytics – Databricks Architect – Senior Manager**
EY's Consulting Services is a unique, industry-focused business unit that provides a broad range of integrated services that leverage deep industry experience with strong functional and technical capabilities and product knowledge. EY’s financial services practice provides integrated Consulting services to financial institutions and other capital markets participants, including commercial banks, retail banks, investment banks, broker-dealers & asset management firms, and insurance firms from leading Fortune 500 Companies. Within EY’s Consulting Practice, Data and Analytics team solves big, complex issues and capitalize on opportunities to deliver better working outcomes that help expand and safeguard the businesses, now and in the future. This way we help create a compelling business case for embedding the right analytical practice at the heart of client’s decision-making.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
The Senior Delivery Manager & Data Architect is a senior client-facing leader accountable for the end-to-end delivery and architectural integrity of complex data, analytics, cloud, and AI transformation programmes. The role combines delivery governance, commercial ownership, stakeholder leadership, and hands-on architecture oversight to translate business priorities into secure, scalable, reliable, and cost-effective data solutions.
  
  
The incumbent will act as the single point of accountability for delivery outcomes while defining target-state data architectures, engineering standards, governance controls, and transformation roadmaps. The role requires the ability to move confidently between executive discussions, programme governance, solution design, and technical assurance.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Own end-to-end delivery of large, multi-workstream data and analytics programmes from discovery and mobilisation through implementation, transition, and benefits realisation.
* Establish integrated plans, governance forums, delivery cadence, quality gates, dependency management, and executive reporting.
* Manage scope, schedule, budget, capacity, quality, risks, issues, assumptions, and change control; intervene early when delivery deviates from commitments.
* Drive Agile, Scrum, scaled Agile, or hybrid delivery practices appropriate to the client and programme context.
* Lead platform migrations, modernisation initiatives, releases, cutovers, hypercare, and transition to operations with clear readiness and acceptance criteria.
* Maintain delivery transparency using measurable outcomes, milestone health, financial performance, engineering metrics, and value-realisation indicators.
* Define enterprise data strategy, target-state architecture, reference architectures, transition states, and prioritised transformation roadmaps aligned to business and AI objectives.
* Architect modern cloud-native data platforms, including data lakes, lakehouses, warehouses, streaming solutions, data products, semantic layers, APIs, and analytical consumption patterns.
* Lead conceptual, logical, and physical data modelling using dimensional, relational, Data Vault, graph, ontology, and domain-oriented approaches as appropriate.
* Define integration and ingestion patterns for batch, near-real-time, event-driven, CDC, API, and file-based workloads.
* Evaluate platforms, products, and design alternatives; produce architecture decisions, solution blueprints, non-functional requirements, and implementation guardrails.
* Provide architecture assurance across the delivery lifecycle through design reviews, proofs of concept, engineering standards, performance reviews, and technical risk management.
* Ensure solutions meet requirements for scalability, resilience, availability, observability, interoperability, security, privacy, maintainability, and cost optimisation.
* Establish governance principles covering data ownership, stewardship, classification, lineage, metadata, master and reference data, retention, and policy enforcement.
* Embed data quality controls, reconciliation, auditability, privacy-by-design, role-based access, encryption, and regulatory compliance into solution architecture and delivery.
* Partner with cyber security, risk, legal, compliance, and operations teams to ensure controls are demonstrable and audit-ready.
* Build trusted relationships with C-suite sponsors, business leaders, product owners, technology executives, and delivery partners.
* Translate complex business needs into clear solution options, investment cases, roadmaps, and outcome-based delivery plans.
* Facilitate executive workshops, architecture forums, steering committees, and difficult decision-making conversations.
* Own or support proposals, solution shaping, estimates, statements of work, delivery models, contract assumptions, and commercial negotiations.
* Manage programme financials, forecasting, burn, margin, resourcing, vendors, and third-party commitments.
* Identify opportunities for account growth, reusable assets, accelerators, and follow-on transformation initiatives.
* Lead multidisciplinary teams of architects, data engineers, platform engineers, analysts, data scientists, DevOps specialists, quality engineers, and project managers.
* Set clear accountabilities, create a high-performance culture, mentor senior practitioners, and develop succession and capability plans.
* Promote engineering excellence, knowledge sharing, reusable patterns, continuous improvement, and responsible use of data and AI.
* Contribute to hiring, workforce planning, communities of practice, thought leadership, and organisational capability development.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Data Science, or a related discipline.
* Typically 15+ years of technology experience, including substantial experience delivering enterprise data programmes and operating in a lead data or solution architecture capacity.
* Demonstrable ownership of large, complex, multi-team programmes with responsibility for delivery governance, senior stakeholders, budgets, quality, and commercial outcomes.
* Strong experience designing and delivering cloud data platforms on Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud; deep expertise in at least one ecosystem is essential.
* Proven experience with modern data platforms and technologies such as Microsoft Fabric, Azure Data Factory, Azure Databricks, Synapse Analytics, Snowflake, Databricks, Spark, Kafka, cloud object storage, and modern BI tools.
* Advanced knowledge of SQL and strong working understanding of Python or PySpark, data integration, distributed processing, DevOps, CI/CD, infrastructure automation, and observability.
* Solid command of data modelling, metadata management, data quality, master data management, governance, privacy, security, and lifecycle management.
* Experience architecting AI-ready data foundations and integrating machine learning, generative AI, vector, semantic, ontology, or knowledge graph capabilities is desirable.
* Excellent executive communication, consulting, negotiation, facilitation, decision-making, and conflict-resolution skills.

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Cloud architecture or data engineering certification in Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud.
* Microsoft Fabric, Databricks, or Snowflake certification.
* TOGAF, DAMA/CDMP, or an equivalent data or enterprise architecture credential.
* PMP, PRINCE2, SAFe, Scrum, or an equivalent programme or Agile delivery certification.
* ITIL certification is advantageous for roles with service transition or operational accountability.
* Delivery against agreed outcomes, milestones, budget, quality standards, and contractual commitments.
* Architecture compliance, reduction in technical debt, and adoption of reusable standards and patterns.
* Platform reliability, performance, security, data quality, observability, and unit-cost improvement.
* Stakeholder confidence, client satisfaction, benefits realisation, and successful adoption of delivered capabilities.
* Team engagement, capability growth, predictable staffing, and development of future technical and delivery leaders.
* Commercial performance, pipeline contribution, and expansion of trusted client relationships.

**What Working At EY Offers**
At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from start–ups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
  
  
You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
  
  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

96ee7202.title: Brand Solutions | Senior Manager
96ee7202.description:
**About Us**
About OML
  
  
Only Much Louder Entertainment is a market-leading, full-service creative and entertainment business network that has instigated pop culture for over two decades by creating iconic moments across television, digital content, fan experiences, branded entertainment, and in the artist-creator community. Celebrated for creating India's first multi-genre music festival, the NH7 Weekender, Only Much Louder has built India’s independent music and comedy scene from the ground up. We won the first-ever Branded Content and Entertainment Cannes Lion for ‘Dewarists’ and have been the first homegrown content business to have a strong footprint in over 22 countries.
  
  
**Our Businesses Include**

* Move Over: OML’s social & culture marketing agency on a mission to bury the boring. Turning social content into entertainment people actually want to watch, share, engage and talk about. We help brands act like creators and build fandoms, not just followings.
* Hypothesis: One of India’s fastest-growing creator-first & influencer marketing agencies, specializing in data-driven solutions to connect brands with the right audiences.
* OML Talent: OML’s legacy business representing over 90+ of the most influential creators, comedians, writers, and storytellers shaping India’s entertainment landscape.
* OML Studios: India’s premier production house developing original IPs for leading OTT platforms. Also helps brands conceptualise and produce original IPs, manage syndication and licensing.
* EighteenSixtyTwo: Bacardi’s branded content and solutions agency, with campaigns in 20+ countries, delivering top-tier creative and content marketing solutions.
* OML Sports: A creative content studio crafting high-impact ads, social media campaigns, and sportainment content for leading teams and leagues. We bring sports stories to life with innovative formats and audience-first storytelling.

**Role Summary**
We’re looking for an individual with 8 to 10 years of experience to build and bring to life experiential solutions for the brands and platforms we work with. Someone who will manage client partnerships while crafting impact-led brand experiences that help brands land their key objectives and stand out in a crowded experiential space.
  
  
Spearhead strategic vision, creative ideation, and full-spectrum execution—acting as the key bridge between clients, internal cross-functional groups, and external production vendors to achieve flawless, top-tier delivery.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Drive client communication, account strategy, and relationship management.
* Facilitate seamless cross-functional alignment between internal units - including Creative, Content, Production, and Operations - for flawless campaign execution
* Elevate delivery quality, timelines, budget management, and client satisfaction metrics.
* Own key event-led client partnerships and long-term experiential mandates.
* Identify opportunities for scope expansion and organic account growth across live campaigns.
* Contribute actively to scale event formats, new business pitches, and creative experiential proposals.
* Drive excellence in execution, innovation, and experiential storytelling across all client projects.
* Collaborate with OML teams to build high-impact experiential initiatives, IP's and marquee brand engagements..
* Identify strategic opportunities to expand event scopes, formats, and brand experience IPs.
* Develop pitch decks and innovative brand experience solutions.
* Champion execution excellence, inventive ideas, and impact-led brand narratives across all client deliverables.

**Skills**

* 8 to 10 years of experience in event management, experiential marketing, and brand solutions
* Proven ability to manage complexity, tight timelines, production budgets, and cross-functional teams.
* Strong ability to bring ideas alive on decks and pitches
* Strategic thinker with strong commercial awareness and P&L/budget management experience
* Client servicing experience - should be able to manage relationships between brand - agency - vendors
* Time management skills & ability to work collaboratively across the organization
* High ownership mindset with a strong growth orientation and passion for live experiences.
* Presentation skills - should be able to present plans to clients & break down briefs to in-house teams

Why this role?
  
  

* You will shape key client relationships and drive experiential growth for leading global and Indian brands.
* You will operate at the intersection of strategy, creativity, production, and business development.
* You will help build and mentor the next generation of account leaders and event producers.
* You will lead high-impact, memorable live brand activations and culture-defining experiences.

**Our Values**

* We build opportunities for our artists, brands and fans; and it’s important for us to be reliable and efficient
* We demonstrate honesty, excellence and commitment to success
* ‘It’s not my job’ is not part of our vocabulary; we even stuff envelopes
* We make mistakes, but only to learn from them to build resilience
* We take care of ourselves and our colleagues
* We are our own managers
* We are committed to equality and inclusion
* We are mindful of the strain on the Earth's resources and are committed to reversing the trend with our behaviours where possible

Thank you!
  
  
Thank you for taking the time to go through the opportunity we have to offer.
  
  
If you apply, please do not share your photo, age, gender, religion or ethnicity in your resume. You do not even need to share your last name. (We want to eliminate biases on any of these parameters while we decide on our shortlisted candidates)
  
  
We will get in touch with you if your profile gets shortlisted.

2b891423.title: Technical Program Manager III, AWS Infra Supply Chain Automation

0e981108.title: Staff Technical Program Manager, GTM Tech
0e981108.description:
MongoDB is growing and gaining adoption rapidly across the globe with the most demanding and innovative companies and development teams in enterprise software.
  
  
The IT Go-to-Market organization is looking for a seasoned Staff Technical Program Manager to help drive technology initiatives that support Sales, Marketing, and deal strategy with a strong emphasis on high-impact Cross functional GTM and AI initiatives. The team partners closely with Go-to-Market leaders to enable revenue growth, improve seller and marketer productivity, and accelerate deal execution through scalable, data-driven solutions.
  
  
We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Gurugram / Bengaluru for our hybrid working model.
  
  
Position Expectations
  
  

* Proactively keep stakeholders informed, connect inputs across documents and workstreams, identify gaps, and clearly articulate risks, tradeoffs, and recommendations
* Demonstrate expertise in creating concise briefs and presentations tailored to stakeholder needs, enabling effective decision-making at all level
* Excel at tracking workstreams, managing dependencies, and driving tasks to closure, ensuring accountability and timely delivery
* Lead the planning and execution of large, cross-functional programs, including pilots, go-live readiness, enablement, and post-launch stabilization
* Leverage technical acumen and analytical skills to drive technical programs forward and maximize business value delivery
* Recognize patterns in a sea of information and take action accordingly
* Develop a strategic approach to technical program management that balances agility and process. This involves discerning when to provide direct guidance and when to empower teams by establishing clear frameworks and guidelines for ongoing initiatives
* Build strategic partnerships with key stakeholder groups across the organization
* Expand knowledge into new domains as called upon
* Embody MongoDB's core values and leadership principles

The right candidate for this role will be
  
  

* Experienced with 10+ years of working in a PMO and/or engineering organization leading complex cross-functional technical programs
* Experienced with 3+ years of IT and/or engineering background
* Proven experience managing large, complex, technology-enabled programs supporting Go-to-Market (GTM) stakeholders
* Strong understanding of GTM functions, CRM platforms, and Lead-to-Quote processes
* Demonstrated ability to work closely with Product Managers and engineering teams, with a solid grasp of the capabilities, workflows, and processes that drive engineering excellence and productivity
* Skilled at partnering with business stakeholders to break down engineering challenges and translate abstract goals into clear, actionable plans
* Capable of participating in product reviews and design discussions, effectively articulating trade-offs, decisions, outcomes, and next steps
* Adept in use of AI in Program management for reporting, task tracking and day to day operations
* Skilled at communicating across a diverse set of engineers and stakeholders
* Capable of deep user empathy and adept at balancing product goals and engineering constraints to deliver impactful experiences
* Hyper-organized and capable of coordinating across multiple independent work streams and organizations
* A role model for effective execution practices, driven by an attuned sense of priority and urgency
* Able to leverage their experience in program delivery to influence improvements to our tools, operations, architecture
* Trained in working with project tracking software (e.g. Jira, Smartsheet PPM, GSuite etc)
* Familiar with MongoDB or a comparable technology

**About MongoDB**
MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.
  
  
With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including 75% of the Fortune 100 and AI-native startups, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software.
  
  
Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It’s what makes us MongoDB.
  
  
To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we’re committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy, we value our employees’ wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. Learn more about what it’s like to work at MongoDB, and help us make an impact on the world!
  
  
MongoDB is committed to providing any necessary accommodations for individuals with disabilities within our application and interview process. To request an accommodation due to a disability, please inform your recruiter.
  
  
MongoDB is an equal opportunities employer.

14e08c5a.title: Program Manager
14e08c5a.description:
We are on the front line of recruitment, enabling organizations to hire smarter and onboard faster. At First Advantage (Nasdaq: FA), people are at the heart of everything we do. From our customers and partners to our greatest advantage — our team members.
  
  
Say hello to a rewarding career and come join a leading provider of mission-critical background screening solutions to some of the most recognized Fortune 100 and Global 500 brands.
  
  
**About First Advantage**
First Advantage (NASDAQ: FA) is a leading provider of global software and data in the HR technology industry. Enabled by proprietary technology and AI, First Advantage’s platforms, data, and APIs power comprehensive employment background screening, identity solutions, and verification services.
  
  
Headquartered in Atlanta, GA, we have an internationally distributed workforce of about 10,000 employees spanning 17 countries. With a strong emphasis on innovation, automation, and customer success, First Advantage empowers 80,000 organizations to modernize their hiring and onboarding processes on a global scale.
  
  
First Advantage is seeking a Program Manager to lead and govern multiple, interrelated Salesforce initiatives across business units, clouds, and geographies. This role is responsible for translating enterprise priorities into executable roadmaps, managing dependencies across projects, and ensuring consistent delivery standards, financial discipline, and stakeholder alignment.
  
  
The Program Manager operates at both strategic and execution levels, overseeing Salesforce programs that span Sales, Service, Marketing, CPQ, integrations, data, and downstream systems within a highly integrated enterprise ecosystem.
  
  
**What This Role Owns**

* Define and own the program roadmap, milestones, and success metrics aligned to enterprise business goals.
* Provide delivery governance across multiple Salesforce projects, releases, and workstreams.
* Coordinate dependencies across business teams, IT, vendors, and system integrators.
* Ensure consistent program execution through standard planning, reporting, and risk management practices.
* Serve as the primary escalation and decision‑making point for Salesforce program‑level issues.

**Core Responsibilities**

* Develop and maintain integrated program plans covering scope, schedule, budget, risks, dependencies, and resourcing across Salesforce initiatives.
* Lead program‑level governance, including executive steering committees, status reviews, escalation paths, and decision frameworks.
* Oversee multiple Salesforce delivery teams (internal and external), ensuring alignment to roadmap, priorities, and architectural guardrails.
* Manage program financials, including budgeting, forecasting, vendor spend, and benefits tracking.
* Identify, track, and mitigate program‑level risks, issues, and cross‑project dependencies.
* Drive alignment between business stakeholders, product owners, architects, and delivery teams to ensure shared priorities and clear accountability.
* Partner with Salesforce solution and enterprise architects to ensure delivery aligns with platform strategy, security, and scalability standards.
* Ensure disciplined release planning, cutover readiness, and post‑deployment stabilization across Salesforce programs.
* Support organizational change management, including communications, training coordination, and adoption tracking.
* Prepare executive‑level materials including program dashboards, roadmap updates, decision papers, and outcome summaries.

**Required Qualifications**

* 8+ years of experience in program or project management, including significant ownership of enterprise Salesforce implementations.
* Proven experience managing multiple concurrent projects with complex dependencies in a matrixed organization.
* Strong understanding of the Salesforce platform and delivery lifecycle, including releases, integrations, and managed services models.
* Experience managing system integrators and third‑party vendors.
* Demonstrated ability to lead through ambiguity, influence without authority, and align diverse stakeholders.
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills with executive‑level presence.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in regulated, high‑volume, or enterprise B2B environments.
* Exposure to Salesforce Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, CPQ, Marketing Cloud, Data Cloud, or large‑scale CRM transformations.
* Experience with Agile, SAFe, or hybrid delivery models.
* Background in enterprise integrations, data platforms, or customer lifecycle transformation initiatives.
* Program or project management certifications (PgMP, PMP, SAFe, Scrum Master).

**We have great people here and are looking for more. Come join us!**
**Fraud Alert**
First Advantage does
**not**
charge candidates any fees at any stage of the recruitment process. We will never ask you to make a payment, purchase equipment, transfer money, or provide financial account information to obtain employment. If anyone claiming to represent First Advantage requests payment or other financial information, please treat the communication as suspicious and contact us through this website for verification.
  
  
**Follow Us**

* Facebook
* Instagram
* LinkedIn
* X
* YouTube

***Equal Employment Opportunities at First Advantage***
*First Advantage is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to providing a workplace and recruitment process that is free from unlawful discrimination, harassment, and retaliation. Employment decisions at First Advantage are based solely on qualifications, merit, and business needs. We do not discriminate in any aspect of employment on the basis of race, color, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, religion, creed, sex, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, marital or family status, pregnancy, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, veteran or military status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.*

b7f2fd7d.title: Senior Systems Engineer (Pre Sales)
b7f2fd7d.description:
**Company Description**
Arista Networks is an industry leader in data-driven, client-to-cloud networking for large data center, campus and routing environments. Arista is a well-established and profitable company with over $9 billion in revenue. Arista’s award-winning platforms, ranging in Ethernet speeds up to 800G bits per second, redefine scalability, agility, and resilience. Arista is a founding member of the Ultra Ethernet consortium. We have shipped over 20 million cloud networking ports worldwide with CloudVision and EOS, an advanced network operating system. Arista is committed to open standards, and its products are available worldwide directly and through partners.
  
  
At Arista, we value the diversity of thought and perspectives each employee brings. We believe fostering an inclusive environment where individuals from various backgrounds and experiences feel welcome is essential for driving creativity and innovation.
  
  
Our commitment to excellence has earned us several prestigious awards, such as the Great Place to Work Survey for Best Engineering Team and Best Company for Diversity, Compensation, and Work-Life Balance. At Arista, we take pride in our track record of success and strive to maintain the highest quality and performance standards in everything we do.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Who You'll Work With**
When you join Arista as part of the Sales Engineering team, you're not just stepping into a role, you're becoming part of a team of industry experts and technical leaders. Typically reporting to the System Engineering Manager, you'll be working alongside some of the most skilled field engineers in the industry. Our team prides itself on not just understanding the technology but also the business impact and aligning our solutions with the larger goals of our clients. In collaboration with our Product Management and Software Development teams, you will play a pivotal role in steering product developments, offerings, and strategic direction to best serve our customers and prospects. Supported by the expertise of our world class Arista TAC, cutting-edge proof-of-concept resources, and support of the executive team, you are well-positioned to lead and innovate within the industry.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**
We are experiencing tremendous growth and have an immediate need for a collaborative, self-motivated Senior Systems Engineer to partner with our Account teams to provide pre-sales technical systems engineering support for our enterprise/commercial customers in the Western India area.
  
  

* The Systems Engineer is a critical component of the Arista Sales team with the key responsibility of acting as a trusted advisor for our customers to gather requirements and identify opportunities with existing and new customers.
* You will partner with the Arista Account Managers to understand customer pain points and conduct white board network architectural reviews in addition to conducting Arista product presentations of Arista’s Open Networking Data Centre and Cognitive Campus (including Wi-fi) networking solutions, CloudVision (Network Automation), Security (Network Detection & Response), Endpoint Security and Real-time Fabric Monitoring solutions.
* You will architect, design and propose Arista Data Centre & Campus network solutions using leaf-spine architectures (VxLAN, EVPN) and network overlays to capture additional sales.
* Perform hands-on tests to validate customer proof-of-concept setups, Data Centre and/or Campus network designs, and network deployments using new products and features
* Put together design guidelines and recommend improvements to customers for the networks they support
* Partner with Sales Team to respond to RFP/RFQs
* Provide feedback to Product Management and Engineering
* Represent Arista at SDN and Open Networking industry events and conferences
* Keep up-to-date on competitive solutions, products, and services
* Author white papers on technology and product.

**Qualifications**

* BE/BS/CS/CE technical degree required
* Network Industry Certification preferred (e.g. CCIE (R&S), JNCIE)
* You possess a minimum of 10+ years of L2/L3 networking design and implementation experience with a focus on Data Centre and Campus networks.
* You possess expert level expertise in routing and switching including L2/L3 protocols (Cisco, Juniper, Extreme, Aruba)
* Demonstrated work experience as either a Sales Engineer, Solutions Architect, Pre-Sales SE or Network Consulting Engineer preferred
* Previous experience with network overlays preferred.
* Expert knowledge in three or more of the following areas: Ethernet, RSTP/ MSTP, VLANs, IP Routing, TCP/IP, BGP, eBGP, VxLAN, EVPN, Multicast, Spanning Tree, QoS
* Expert-level knowledge of industry-standard CLI
* Experience with SDN and Network Function Virtualization (NFV) highly desired.
* Previous experience building network automation using Python and Ansible desired.
* Knowledge of competitive products, solutions, and services
* Ability to write white papers a plus.

**Additional Information**
Arista stands out as an engineering-centric company. Our leadership, including founders and engineering managers, are all engineers who understand sound software engineering principles and the importance of doing things right.
  
  
We hire globally into our diverse team. At Arista, engineers have complete ownership of their projects. Our management structure is flat and streamlined, and software engineering is led by those who understand it best. We prioritize the development and utilization of test automation tools.
  
  
Our engineers have access to every part of the company, providing opportunities to work across various domains. Arista is headquartered in Santa Clara, California, with development offices in Australia, Canada, India, Ireland, and the US. We consider all our R&D centers equal in stature.
  
  
Join us to shape the future of networking and be part of a culture that values invention, quality, respect, and fun.

a58fd779.title: Senior Principal - Automation Engineer / Architect
a58fd779.description:
GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.  
Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.  
Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges.

**Job Purpose**

The Automation Architect owns the technical design of a DPTF platform, defining the reference architectures, patterns and standards that make solutions secure, scalable and consistent, and guiding engineering teams in applying them. The role provides design assurance across the platform's services, architects for reliability and resilience rather than treating them as later additions, and designs AI into the platform through reference patterns for AI-assisted delivery and intelligent operations. Platforms span cloud, network and digital workplace domains, and the specific platform is set on appointment.

The role sets standards and assures designs; it does not build. Engineering delivery sits with the platform engineering teams, backlog order sits with the Product Owner, domain target architecture and the architecture team sit with the Platform Architecture Director, and enterprise-level standards sit with Enterprise Architecture. Solution designs for major cross-domain initiatives sit with the Solution Architect in Enterprise Architecture.

**Key Responsibilities**

  

* Define reference architectures, patterns and standards for the platform, aligned to DPTF strategy and to enterprise architecture.
* Design AI into the platform, producing reference patterns for AI-assisted delivery and for intelligent, self-healing operations.
* Architect for reliability and resilience by design, so that platform SLOs and error budgets are achievable rather than aspirational.
* Provide design assurance and technical guidance to engineering teams, reviewing designs against the standards before build rather than after.
* Ensure platform solutions are secure and compliant, including GxP requirements where the platform supports regulated activity.
* Evaluate and introduce new technologies, measuring the result against architecture OKRs rather than adopting on vendor claim.
* Set architecture standards that supplier and managed-service solutions must meet, and assure their designs to the same bar as internal work.
* Partner with Enterprise Architecture and Information Security on standards, roadmaps and exceptions.
* Increase pattern reuse across the platform, tracking where teams have adopted a pattern and where they have diverged and why.
* Reduce rework by intervening early in design, and evidence the reduction rather than asserting it.
* Advise the Product Owner and Platform Manager on the architectural consequence of roadmap choices, including technical debt being accepted.
* Hold the boundaries with the Platform Architecture Director on domain target architecture, the Solution Architect on cross-domain initiative designs, and the engineering teams on build.

**Education & Professional Qualifications**

  

* Degree in a technology or engineering discipline, or equivalent practical experience (e.g., Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems).
* Architecture certifications desirable (e.g., TOGAF, or recognised cloud or network architecture certification relevant to the platform).

**Job Experience:**

  

* Typically 15+ years in technology architecture or senior engineering, including at least three years producing reference architectures or standards others build to.
* Deep hands-on depth in the relevant platform domain, whether cloud, network or digital workplace.
* Experience running design assurance or architecture review, including declining designs that did not meet the standard.
* Track record of architecting for reliability and resilience, working to SLOs and error budgets.
* Experience designing secure and compliant solutions, ideally including GxP or another regulated context.
* Experience setting architecture standards that supplier or managed-service solutions had to meet.
* Awareness of AI reference patterns for assisted delivery and intelligent operations.

**Desirable**

  

* Hands-on experience architecting and building AI/agentic systems — LLMs, evaluation pipelines, ML lifecycle — at production scale.
* Experience assessing data readiness (availability, quality, access, labeling) and flagging risks before builds start.
* Working knowledge of at least one pharma value chain area (R&D, manufacturing, or commercial).
* Background spotting reusable patterns across engagements and turning them into shared, durable technical capability.
* Ability to influence engineering teams without line authority, so that patterns are adopted rather than circumvented.
* Judgement about when to grant an architectural exception and when to hold the standard.
* Clear design documentation, since patterns are only reusable if others can follow them.
* Comfort challenging vendor claims and evaluating technology on measured outcome.
* Pragmatism about technical debt, making the cost visible rather than blocking delivery outright.
* Collaborative habit with Enterprise Architecture and Security, whose standards constrain the platform.

**Skills**

Asset Life Cycle Management, Data Integrity, Digital Fluency, Enterprise Architecture (EA), Enterprise IT Architecture, GxP Regulations, Information Security, Lean Management, Manufacturing Technologies, Pharmaceutical Manufacturing, Platform Architecture, Problem Solving, Risk Awareness, Solution Architecture, Standards Compliance

**Why GSK?**

**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.

**Inclusion at GSK:**

As an employer committed to Inclusion, we encourage you to reach out if you need any adjustments during the recruitment process.

Please contact our Recruitment Team at IN.recruitment-adjustments@gsk.com to discuss your needs.

GSK does not accept referrals from employment businesses and/or employment agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site. All employment businesses/agencies are required to contact GSK's commercial and general procurement/human resources department to obtain prior written authorization before referring any candidates to GSK. The obtaining of prior written authorization is a condition precedent to any agreement (verbal or written) between the employment business/ agency and GSK. In the absence of such written authorization being obtained any actions undertaken by the employment business/agency shall be deemed to have been performed without the consent or contractual agreement of GSK. GSK shall therefore not be liable for any fees arising from such actions or any fees arising from any referrals by employment businesses/agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site.

1ec1bf2d.description:
Business Introduction  
GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.  
Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.  
Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges.  
  
**Job Purpose**

The Principal Azure Platform Architect owns the technical design of the Azure Cloud platform, defining the reference architectures, patterns and standards that make solutions secure, scalable and consistent, and guiding engineering teams in applying them. The role provides design assurance across the Azure Cloud and Edge services, architects for reliability and resilience rather than treating them as later additions, and designs AI into the platform through reference patterns for AI-assisted delivery and intelligent operations.

The role sets standards and assures designs; it does not build. Engineering delivery sits with the platform engineering teams, backlog order sits with the Product Owner, domain target architecture and the architecture team sit with the Platform Architecture Director, and enterprise-level standards sit with Enterprise Architecture. Solution designs for major cross-domain initiatives sit with the Solution Architect in Enterprise Architecture.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Define reference architectures, patterns and standards for the platform, aligned to DPTF strategy and to enterprise architecture.
* Design AI into the platform, producing reference patterns for AI-assisted delivery and for intelligent, self-healing operations.
* Architect for reliability and resilience by design, so that platform SLOs and error budgets are achievable rather than aspirational.
* Provide design assurance and technical guidance to engineering teams, reviewing designs against the standards before build rather than after.
* Ensure platform solutions are secure and compliant, including GxP requirements where the platform supports regulated activity.
* Evaluate and introduce new technologies, measuring the result against architecture OKRs rather than adopting on vendor claim.
* Set architecture standards that supplier and managed-service solutions must meet, and assure their designs to the same bar as internal work.
* Partner with Enterprise Architecture and Information Security on standards, roadmaps and exceptions.
* Increase pattern reuse across the platform, tracking where teams have adopted a pattern and where they have diverged and why.
* Reduce rework by intervening early in design, and evidence the reduction rather than asserting it.
* Advise the Product Owner and Platform Manager on the architectural consequence of roadmap choices, including technical debt being accepted.
* Hold the boundaries with the Platform Architecture Director on domain target architecture, the Solution Architect on cross-domain initiative designs, and the engineering teams on build.

**Professional Qualifications**

* Degree in a technology or engineering discipline, or equivalent practical experience (e.g., Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems).
* Architecture certifications desirable (e.g., TOGAF, or recognised cloud or network architecture certification relevant to the platform).

**Area of Specialisation**

* Platform architecture in the relevant domain, covering reference architecture, patterns, standards and design assurance.
* Security and resilience by design, including AI reference patterns and GxP considerations where applicable.

**Related Experience Required**

* Overall 15 years and typically 6-8 years in technology architecture or senior engineering, including at least three years producing reference architectures or standards others build to.
* Proven experience as an Azure Cloud Architect
* Knowledge of networking, security, and compliance in cloud environments
* Experience deploying, configuring and managing services in Azure Cloud Platform including AI Services
* Experience running design assurance or architecture review, including declining designs that did not meet the standard.
* Track record of architecting for reliability and resilience, working to SLOs and error budgets.
* Experience designing secure and compliant solutions, ideally including GxP or another regulated context.
* Experience setting architecture standards that supplier or managed-service solutions had to meet.
* Awareness of AI reference patterns for assisted delivery and intelligent operations.

**Skills/Background**

* Ability to influence engineering teams without line authority, so that patterns are adopted rather than circumvented.
* Judgement about when to grant an architectural exception and when to hold the standard.
* Clear design documentation, since patterns are only reusable if others can follow them.
* Comfort challenging vendor claims and evaluating technology on measured outcome.
* Pragmatism about technical debt, making the cost visible rather than blocking delivery outright.
* Collaborative habit with Enterprise Architecture and Security, whose standards constrain the platform.

**Skills**

API Management, Automation Technology, Cloud Architectures, Cloud Financial Operations, Containerization, Database Management, Design Assurance, DevOps, Disaster Recovery (DR), Edge Computing, Infrastructure As Code (IaC), Kubernetes, Microsoft Azure Architecture, Networking Concepts, Performance Optimizations, Reference Architectures, Security Compliance, Serverless Computing, System Monitors, Virtualization

**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. 5ec5337b.title: Cloud Migration Lead Engineer
5ec5337b.description:
**Req ID:** 395338
  
  
NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now.
  
  
We are currently seeking a Cloud Migration Lead Engineer to join our team in HR, Haryāna (IN-HR), India (IN).
  
  
Cloud Migration Engineer – AWS / Azure
  
  
**Experience:** 6+ years in IT infrastructure, including 2+ years of hands-on cloud migration or cloud infrastructure experience.
  
  
Role Summary
  
  
We are looking for hands-on Cloud Migration Engineers to execute enterprise workload migrations, primarily to AWS, with Microsoft Azure experience considered an advantage.
  
  
This is an execution-focused engineering position. The successful candidate must have practical experience migrating production servers or applications from on-premises or virtualized environments to public cloud platforms.
  
  
We are particularly interested in engineers with strong Windows/Linux infrastructure backgrounds who have participated directly in migration projects.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
•
  
  
Execute server and workload migrations from on-premises, VMware, and other cloud environments to AWS.
  
•
  
  
Configure and operate AWS Application Migration Service (MGN) and other migration tools.
  
•
  
  
Perform source server assessments, agent installation, replication configuration, and migration readiness checks.
  
•
  
  
Execute test migrations, validate replicated workloads, and troubleshoot migration issues.
  
•
  
  
Participate in migration wave planning and technical cutover preparation.
  
•
  
  
Perform production cutovers, post-migration validation, and hypercare activities.
  
•
  
  
Troubleshoot operating system, networking, storage, DNS, Active Directory, and application connectivity issues.
  
•
  
  
Support migration runbook creation, technical documentation, and rollback procedures.
  
•
  
  
Collaborate with Technical Leads, Cloud Foundation Engineers, and customer application owners.
  
•
  
  
Identify opportunities to automate repetitive migration activities and improve migration efficiency.
  
  
Mandatory Technical Skills
  
  
•
  
  
Hands-on experience migrating Windows and/or Linux servers to AWS or another public cloud.
  
•
  
  
Practical experience with AWS EC2, EBS, VPC, security groups, and basic IAM.
  
•
  
  
Experience with AWS MGN, Azure Migrate, VMware HCX, RiverMeadow, or comparable server migration technologies.
  
•
  
  
Strong Windows Server and/or Linux administration and troubleshooting experience.
  
•
  
  
Knowledge of VMware vSphere or similar virtualization technologies.
  
•
  
  
Understanding of DNS, TCP/IP, routing, firewalls, and basic network troubleshooting.
  
•
  
  
Familiarity with server replication, testing, cutover, rollback, and post-migration validation.
  
•
  
  
Experience troubleshooting infrastructure and operating system issues.
  
•
  
  
Ability to follow migration runbooks and execute production changes safely.
  
  
Nice-to-Have Skills
  
  
•
  
  
Microsoft Azure VM migration experience and Azure Migrate.
  
•
  
  
AWS Transform, RiverMeadow, CloudHedge, or other migration accelerators.
  
•
  
  
PowerShell, Bash, Python, or automation scripting.
  
•
  
  
Terraform, Ansible, or basic Infrastructure as Code experience.
  
•
  
  
Active Directory, Group Policy, and Windows infrastructure services.
  
•
  
  
SQL Server, Oracle, or other database migration exposure.
  
•
  
  
AWS networking, VPN, Direct Connect, or hybrid connectivity.
  
•
  
  
AWS IAM, cloud security, or operational monitoring.
  
•
  
  
Experience with application dependency mapping and migration discovery.
  
•
  
  
AWS Certified Solutions Architect Associate, SysOps Administrator, or equivalent certification.
  
  
Expected Outcomes
  
  
•
  
  
Independently execute assigned migration tasks and migration waves.
  
•
  
  
Deliver successful server migrations with minimal rework.
  
•
  
  
Identify and resolve replication, cutover, and post-migration issues.
  
•
  
  
Contribute to reusable migration procedures and automation.
  
•
  
  
Support predictable, repeatable, high-volume migration delivery.
  
  
**Critical selection criterion:** Candidates must demonstrate direct involvement in real server or workload migrations. General cloud operations, monitoring, or infrastructure support experience alone is insufficient.

NTT DATA is a $30 billion business and technology services leader, serving 75% of the Fortune Global 100. We are committed to accelerating client success and positively impacting society through responsible innovation. We are one of the world's leading AI and digital infrastructure providers, with unmatched capabilities in enterprise-scale AI, cloud, security, connectivity, data centers and application services. our consulting and Industry solutions help organizations and society move confidently and sustainably into the digital future. Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

* Grow the team to expand new capabilities that extend beyond the immediate project.
* Set and communicate team priorities that support the broader organization's goals. Align strategy, processes, and decision-making across teams. Evolve the technical roadmap to meet anticipated future requirements and infrastructure needs.

10003c79.title: Senior Principal - Portfolio Manager, Cloud Platforms
10003c79.description:
Business Introduction
  
  
GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.
  
  
Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.
  
  
Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges.
  
  
**Job Purpose**
The Portfolio Manager manages the Cloud & Hosting Platforms demand and portfolio of work, sequencing delivery against strategy, capacity and dependencies, and giving domain leaders a clear view of what is being delivered and when. The role runs lean portfolio management across Cloud, Edge and Modern Engineering platforms, steers with flow metrics and OKR progress rather than fixed plans, and tracks benefits realisation after delivery.
  
  
The role orchestrates rather than decides. It owns the portfolio process, the prioritisation framework, the reporting and the transparency, and it coaches and challenges on delivery discipline. Prioritisation calls, roadmap content and value commitments remain with the Platform Manager and the Product Owners. Enterprise portfolio consolidation sits with the Investment Planning & Performance Director, and domain cost and forecasting sit with the Tech Finance Manager.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Run lean portfolio management for the domain, managing incoming demand through a single route rather than several informal ones.
* Own the prioritisation framework the domain applies, so that decisions taken by the Platform Manager and Product Owners are made on a consistent basis.
* Sequence delivery against strategy, capacity and cross-platform dependencies, surfacing conflicts early enough to be resolved.
* Link every item of work in the portfolio to strategy and to domain OKRs, and track the outcome with a named metric.
* Steer the portfolio with flow metrics and OKR progress, and act on the signal rather than only reporting it.
* Provide portfolio reporting, forecasting and transparency to domain leaders and into the enterprise portfolio.
* Use AI tooling to accelerate portfolio analysis, dependency detection, forecasting and reporting, reviewing AI-assisted output before publication.
* Track benefits and value realisation after delivery, and feed what actually landed back into future prioritisation.
* Coordinate supplier and managed-service demand within the portfolio, so partner capacity is planned rather than assumed.
* Run the domain portfolio governance forums, setting agenda, evidence pack and follow-up actions.
* Coach delivery teams and Product Owners on portfolio discipline, so that transparency improves at source rather than through chasing.
* Hold the boundaries with the Platform Manager on prioritisation decisions, the Tech Finance Manager on cost and forecasting, and the Investment Planning & Performance Director on enterprise portfolio consolidation.

**Education & Professional Qualifications**

* Degree in a technology, engineering or business discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
* Portfolio or agile certifications desirable (e.g., SAFe Lean Portfolio Management, Management of Portfolios, or a recognised agile certification).

**Area of Specialisation**

* Portfolio and demand management, covering intake, prioritisation frameworks, sequencing and dependency management.
* Lean portfolio practice, covering flow metrics, OKR tracking and benefits realisation.

**Experience Required**

* Overall 15 years and typically 6-8 years in portfolio management, PMO or delivery management, including at least two years with domain or programme-level portfolio responsibility.
* Experience in Cloud, Infrastructure & Engineering portfolio strategy and planning
* Practical experience of lean or agile portfolio management rather than traditional project portfolio reporting alone.
* Experience managing demand intake and holding a single route against pressure to bypass it.
* Track record sequencing work against capacity and dependencies, and surfacing conflicts before they became delivery failures.
* Experience steering with flow metrics and OKR progress rather than percentage complete.
* Experience tracking benefits realisation after delivery, including where benefits did not materialise.
* Exposure to AI or analytics tooling applied to portfolio analysis, forecasting or dependency detection.

**Skills/Background**

* Ability to hold a demand route when senior stakeholders would prefer to bypass it.
* Dependency instinct, spotting the cross-platform collision before it lands in a delivery report.
* Clear reporting that leads to a decision rather than to a discussion.
* Comfort challenging delivery teams on transparency without owning their delivery.
* Discipline in a recurring cycle, since portfolio credibility depends on consistency.
* Coaching instinct, since portfolio quality improves at source rather than through chasing.

#AGTech
  
  
**Skills**
API Management, Artificial Intelligence Planning, Automation Technology, Benefits Accounting, Cloud Architectures, Cloud Financial Operations, Cloud Platform, Containerization, Database Management, DevOps, Disaster Recovery (DR), Edge Computing, Infrastructure As Code (IaC), Lean Agile, Networking Concepts, Performance Optimizations, Portfolio Management, Serverless Computing, System Monitors, Virtualization
  
  
**Why GSK?**
**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**
GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.
  
  
People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.
  
  
**Inclusion at GSK:**
As an employer committed to Inclusion, we encourage you to reach out if you need any adjustments during the recruitment process.
  
  
Please contact our Recruitment Team at IN.recruitment-adjustments@gsk.com to discuss your needs.
  
  
**Important notice to Employment businesses/ Agencies**
GSK does not accept referrals from employment businesses and/or employment agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site. All employment businesses/agencies are required to contact GSK's commercial and general procurement/human resources department to obtain prior written authorization before referring any candidates to GSK. The obtaining of prior written authorization is a condition precedent to any agreement (verbal or written) between the employment business/ agency and GSK. In the absence of such written authorization being obtained any actions undertaken by the employment business/agency shall be deemed to have been performed without the consent or contractual agreement of GSK. GSK shall therefore not be liable for any fees arising from such actions or any fees arising from any referrals by employment businesses/agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site.
  
  
It has come to our attention that the names of GlaxoSmithKline or GSK or our group companies are being used in connection with bogus job advertisements or through unsolicited emails asking candidates to make some payments for recruitment opportunities and interview. Please be advised that such advertisements and emails are not connected with the GlaxoSmithKline group in any way.
  
  
**GlaxoSmithKline does not charge any fee whatsoever for recruitment process. Please do not make payments to any individuals / entities in connection with recruitment with any GlaxoSmithKline (or GSK) group company at any worldwide location. Even if they claim that the money is refundable.**
If you come across unsolicited email from email addresses not ending in gsk.com or job advertisements which state that you should contact an email address that does not end in “gsk.com”, you should disregard the same and inform us by emailing askus@gsk.com, so that we can confirm to you if the job is genuine.

b93c0048.title: Payroll Transformation Solution Owner - VOIS
b93c0048.description:
**Who We Are**
VOIS (Vodafone Intelligent Solutions) is a strategic arm of Vodafone Group Plc, creating value for customers by delivering intelligent solutions through Talent, Technology & Transformation.
  
  
As the largest shared services organisation in the global telco industry with 30,000 FTE, our portfolio of next-generation solutions and services are designed in partnership with customers across Vodafone Group, local markets, and partner markets to simplify and drive growth. With our strategic partner Accenture, we work alongside our Vodafone customers, other Telco and tech companies to drive transformation, meet the challenges of our industry and ensure we stay relevant and resilient. This partnership is a unique, industry-first model which brings together the best of in-house and 3rd party capability.
  
  
We work with customers across 28 countries from 10 VOIS locations: Albania, Egypt, Hungary, India, Romania, Spain, Turkey, UK, Germany, Ireland, and with a network of teams in Czech Republic, Italy, Greece, and Portugal.
  
  
#VOIS #BeUnrivalled #CreateTheFuture
  
  
**About This Role**
We are seeking a Payroll Transformation Solution Owner to lead the delivery and continuous improvement of enterprise payroll solutions. You will be accountable for business outcomes, product backlog priorities, cross-market alignment and the effective implementation of SAP SuccessFactors Employee Central Payroll.
  
  
The role requires end-to-end ownership of payroll transformation, from future-state process design and requirements definition through testing, cutover, go-live and early-life support. You will work across multiple markets, balancing global standards with local statutory and operational requirements, including those relevant to Germany, Portugal and South Africa
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Own the payroll transformation workstream and product backlog, aligning priorities with business objectives, statutory obligations, delivery milestones and measurable value.Provide functional leadership for SAP SuccessFactors Employee Central Payroll or a comparable enterprise payroll platform.Define future-state payroll processes that balance global standards with market-specific statutory and operational requirements.Lead, coach and coordinate team members and cross-functional contributors, establishing clear accountability for deliverables.Partner with Product Managers, market payroll teams, HR, Finance, Technology, implementation partners and other stakeholders to agree requirements, decisions and delivery plans.Guide requirements through design, build, testing, cutover, go-live and early-life support.Proactively manage delivery risks, dependencies, controls and decisions.Ensure that data quality, information security, auditability, payroll controls, integrations and operational readiness are addressed throughout the solution lifecycle.Drive payroll simplification, standardisation, automation and continuous improvement while maintaining a positive employee and stakeholder experience.Apply JIRA and SAFe Agile practices to backlog management, sprint planning, Program Increment planning, progress tracking and transparent reporting.Explain complex payroll matters clearly and support informed decision-making among senior stakeholders and market teams

**Who You Are**
You have strong implementation experience in SAP SuccessFactors Employee Central Payroll, including responsibility for end-to-end delivery.You bring payroll implementation experience covering Germany, Portugal and South Africa, together with an understanding of country-specific statutory and payroll requirements.You have demonstrated leadership and people-management capability, including coaching, work allocation, performance support and delivery governance.You understand end-to-end payroll processes and their dependencies on Employee Central, Time and Attendance, Benefits, Finance and external service providers.You can manage stakeholders, negotiate effectively and support decisions within complex, multi-market environments.You can translate business needs into clear requirements and practical solution outcomes while maintaining appropriate controls and compliance.You have experience managing delivery partners and cross-functional teams through testing, cutover, go-live, stabilisation and continuous improvement.You are proficient in JIRA and have working knowledge of SAFe Agile or comparable delivery methodologies.You bring strong analytical, problem-solving, planning and risk-management skills.You hold a bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Human Resources, Business, Finance or a related discipline.You have experience leading teams or managing a significant payroll solution or transformation workstream.You have worked within enterprise-scale, multi-country HR or payroll transformation programmes.
  
  
**Not a perfect fit?**
Concerned you may not meet every requirement? Vodafone is committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. If you are excited about this role but your experience does not align exactly with every aspect of the job description, you are encouraged to apply. You may be the right candidate for this or another opportunity, and the recruitment team will support you in exploring where your skills fit best.
  
  
**What's In It For You**
The opportunity to shape a multi-country payroll transformation and influence future-state payroll services.Ownership across the full solution lifecycle, including design, implementation, go-live, stabilisation and continuous improvement.Collaboration with payroll, HR, Finance and Technology specialists, market teams and implementation partners.Exposure to enterprise-scale SAP SuccessFactors Employee Central Payroll delivery in a complex international environment.The opportunity to lead teams, guide senior stakeholder decisions and deliver measurable improvements through standardisation and automation.
  
  
**What Skills You Will Learn**
Advanced product ownership and backlog prioritisation within an enterprise payroll environment.Multi-country payroll solution design and statutory requirement management.Practical application of SAFe Agile, sprint planning and Program Increment planning.Enterprise payroll controls, integration governance, data quality and operational-readiness management.Cross-market stakeholder engagement and delivery-partner governance.Leadership across testing, cutover, go-live, early-life support and continuous improvement.Approaches for simplifying, standardising and automating global payroll services.
  
  
**VOIS Equal Opportunity Employer Commitment**
Vodafone recognises and celebrates the value of diversity in building a workforce that reflects the customers and communities it serves. No form of discrimination is tolerated. This includes, but is not limited to, discrimination based on race, colour, age, veteran status, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, pregnancy, maternity or parental status, ethnicity, disability, religion or belief, political affiliation, trade union membership, nationality, citizenship, indigenous status, medical condition, HIV status, neurodiversity, social origin, cultural background, marital or civil partnership status, or socio-economic background.
  
  
**Join Us**
At Vodafone, we’re working hard to build a better future. A more connected, inclusive and sustainable world. As a dynamic global community, it's our human spirit, together with technology, that empowers us to achieve this.
  
  
We challenge and innovate in order to connect people, businesses, and communities across the world. Delighting our customers and earning their loyalty drive us, and we experiment, learn fast and get it done, together.
  
  
With us, you can truly be yourself and belong, share inspiration, embrace new opportunities, thrive, and make a real difference.
  
  
**Alert**
Apply for Vodafone jobs only through the official Vodafone Careers website to avoid job scams and fraud.” #JDEnhancedByTARA
